```go
package core

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

type defineIn struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

type defineOut struct {
	Done string `json:"done"`
}

// defineMutator is a Mutator and nothing more.
type defineMutator struct{}

func (defineMutator) Plan(_ context.Context, _ Env, in defineIn) (PlanOutcome, error) {
	return PlanOutcome{StateHash: "plan " + in.Name}, nil
}

func (defineMutator) Apply(_ context.Context, _ Env, in defineIn) (defineOut, error) {
	return defineOut{"apply " + in.Name}, nil
}

func (defineMutator) Verify(_ context.Context, _ Env, in defineIn, out defineOut) error {
	if out.Done != "apply "+in.Name && out.Done != "task "+in.Name {
		return errors.New("not done")
	}
	return nil
}

func (defineMutator) Snapshot(_ context.Context, _ Env, in defineIn) ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(in.Name), nil
}

func (defineMutator) Revert(context.Context, Env, []byte) (RevertOutcome, error) {
	return RevertOutcome{}, nil
}

func (defineMutator) Task(_ context.Context, env Env, in defineIn) (defineOut, error) {
	return defineOut{"task " + in.Name + " of " + env.ChangeID}, nil
}

// defineHandlers adds every optional lifecycle handler to defineMutator; each
// answer carries what it was given, so a test sees it passed through.
type defineHandlers struct{ defineMutator }

func (defineHandlers) Observe(_ context.Context, env Env, e Effect) (Observation, error) {
	return Observation{Resource: e.Resource + "@" + env.ChangeID, Matches: e.Seq}, nil
}

func (defineHandlers) Resolved(_ context.Context, _ *sql.Tx, e Effect, resolution string) error {
	return errors.New(resolution + " " + e.Resource)
}

func (defineHandlers) Inverse(_ context.Context, _ Env, e Effect) (InverseResult, error) {
	return InverseResult{Resource: "undo " + e.Resource}, nil
}

func (defineHandlers) Recover(_ context.Context, env Env) (RecoveryOutcome, error) {
	return RecoveryOutcome{State: RecoveryRolledBack, Reason: env.ChangeID}, nil
}

type defineComposer struct{}

func (defineComposer) Steps(_ context.Context, _ Env, in defineIn) ([]Step, error) {
	return []Step{{ID: "one", Action: ActionRef{"other.item.add", 1}, Input: json.RawMessage(`{"name":"` + in.Name + `"}`)}}, nil
}

func (defineComposer) Output(_ context.Context, _ Env, in defineIn, steps map[string]json.RawMessage) (defineOut, error) {
	return defineOut{in.Name + " " + string(steps["one"])}, nil
}

func TestDefineFindsLifecycleHandlers(t *testing.T) {
	spec := ActionSpec{Name: "demo.item.add", Version: 1, Class: ClassCompensable, Side: SideAgent, LockKeys: []string{"demo"}}
	tests := []struct {
		name  string
		def   ActionDef
		found bool
	}{
		{"mutating without handlers", DefineMutating[defineIn, defineOut](spec, defineMutator{}), false},
		{"mutating with handlers", DefineMutating[defineIn, defineOut](spec, defineHandlers{}), true},
		{"revertible without handlers", DefineRevertible[defineIn, defineOut](spec, defineMutator{}), false},
		{"revertible with handlers", DefineRevertible[defineIn, defineOut](spec, defineHandlers{}), true},
		{"task without handlers", DefineTask[defineIn, defineOut](spec, defineMutator{}), false},
		{"task with handlers", DefineTask[defineIn, defineOut](spec, defineHandlers{}), true},
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	env := Env{ChangeID: "c1"}
	e := Effect{ChangeID: "c1", Seq: 3, Kind: EffectModify, Resource: "demo.item:a"}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := tt.def.Handler
			if !tt.found {
				if h.Observe != nil || h.Resolved != nil || h.Inverse != nil || h.Recover != nil {
					t.Fatalf("handlers found on a handler without them: %+v", h)
				}
				return
			}
			if h.Observe == nil || h.Resolved == nil || h.Inverse == nil || h.Recover == nil {
				t.Fatalf("a handler was not found: %+v", h)
			}
			if obs, err := h.Observe(ctx, env, e); err != nil || obs.Resource != "demo.item:a@c1" || obs.Matches != 3 {
				t.Errorf("Observe = %+v, %v", obs, err)
			}
			if err := h.Resolved(ctx, nil, e, ResolutionAccept); err == nil || err.Error() != "accept demo.item:a" {
				t.Errorf("Resolved = %v", err)
			}
			if res, err := h.Inverse(ctx, env, e); err != nil || res.Resource != "undo demo.item:a" {
				t.Errorf("Inverse = %+v, %v", res, err)
			}
			if out, err := h.Recover(ctx, env); err != nil || out.State != RecoveryRolledBack || out.Reason != "c1" {
				t.Errorf("Recover = %+v, %v", out, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDefineComposite(t *testing.T) {
	def := DefineComposite[defineIn, defineOut](ActionSpec{
		Name: "demo.stack.deploy", Version: 2, Side: SideAgent, LockKeys: []string{"demo"}, Unwind: UnwindReverse,
	}, defineComposer{})
	s, h := def.Spec, def.Handler
	if s.Class != ClassComposite || s.Side != SideController || s.Unwind != UnwindReverse ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(s.LockKeys, []string{"composite:demo"}) {
		t.Errorf("spec = %+v, want a controller-side composite holding composite:demo", s)
	}
	if h.Plan != nil || h.Apply != nil || h.Verify != nil || h.Read != nil || h.Task != nil {
		t.Errorf("a composite has a mutator handler: %+v", h)
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	steps, err := h.Steps(ctx, Env{}, json.RawMessage(`{"name":"web"}`))
	if err != nil || len(steps) != 1 || steps[0].ID != "one" || string(steps[0].Input) != `{"name":"web"}` {
		t.Errorf("Steps = %+v, %v", steps, err)
	}
	out, err := h.Output(ctx, Env{}, json.RawMessage(`{"name":"web"}`), map[string]json.RawMessage{"one": json.RawMessage(`{"id":1}`)})
	if err != nil || string(out) != `{"done":"web {\"id\":1}"}` {
		t.Errorf("Output = %s, %v", out, err)
	}
}

func TestDefineTask(t *testing.T) {
	spec := ActionSpec{Name: "demo.package.install", Version: 1, Class: ClassIrreversible, Side: SideAgent,
		LockKeys: []string{"demo"}, ApplyTimeout: 15 * time.Minute}
	def := DefineTask[defineIn, defineOut](spec, defineMutator{})
	s, h := def.Spec, def.Handler
	if !s.Task || !s.LongRunning || s.Class != ClassIrreversible || s.ApplyTimeout != 15*time.Minute {
		t.Errorf("spec = %+v, want a long-running irreversible task action", s)
	}
	if h.Apply != nil || h.Task == nil || h.Plan == nil || h.Verify == nil || h.Snapshot != nil || h.Revert != nil {
		t.Fatalf("handler = %+v, want Plan, Task and Verify only", h)
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	out, err := h.Task(ctx, Env{ChangeID: "c7"}, json.RawMessage(`{"name":"x"}`))
	if err != nil || string(out) != `{"done":"task x of c7"}` {
		t.Errorf("Task = %s, %v", out, err)
	}
	if plan, err := h.Plan(ctx, Env{}, json.RawMessage(`{"name":"x"}`)); err != nil || plan.StateHash != "plan x" {
		t.Errorf("Plan = %+v, %v", plan, err)
	}
	if err := h.Verify(ctx, Env{}, json.RawMessage(`{"name":"x"}`), json.RawMessage(`{"done":"task x"}`)); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("Verify: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestDefinedHandlersRefuseInputOfAnotherType(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	bad := json.RawMessage(`{"name":"x","extra":true}`)
	composite := DefineComposite[defineIn, defineOut](ActionSpec{Name: "demo.stack.deploy", Version: 1, Unwind: UnwindForward}, defineComposer{}).Handler
	task := DefineTask[defineIn, defineOut](ActionSpec{Name: "demo.package.install", Version: 1, Class: ClassCompensable}, defineMutator{}).Handler
	calls := map[string]func() error{
		"composite steps":  func() error { _, err := composite.Steps(ctx, Env{}, bad); return err },
		"composite output": func() error { _, err := composite.Output(ctx, Env{}, bad, nil); return err },
		"task":             func() error { _, err := task.Task(ctx, Env{}, bad); return err },
		"task plan":        func() error { _, err := task.Plan(ctx, Env{}, bad); return err },
		"task verify":      func() error { return task.Verify(ctx, Env{}, bad, json.RawMessage(`{}`)) },
	}
	for name, call := range calls {
		var coded *errcode.Error
		if err := call(); !errors.As(err, &coded) || coded.Code != errcode.InvalidInput {
			t.Errorf("%s: err = %v, want %s", name, err, errcode.InvalidInput)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
func erasedPlan[In any](plan func(ctx context.Context, env Env, in In) (PlanOutcome, error)) func(context.Context, Env, json.RawMessage) (PlanOutcome, error) {
	return func(ctx context.Context, env Env, raw json.RawMessage) (PlanOutcome, error) {
		in, err := decode[In](raw)
		if err != nil {
			return PlanOutcome{}, err
		}
		return plan(ctx, env, in)
	}
}

func erasedRun[In, Out any](run func(ctx context.Context, env Env, in In) (Out, error)) func(context.Context, Env, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	return func(ctx context.Context, env Env, raw json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
		in, err := decode[In](raw)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out, err := run(ctx, env, in)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return encode(out)
	}
}

func erasedVerify[In, Out any](verify func(ctx context.Context, env Env, in In, out Out) error) func(context.Context, Env, json.RawMessage, json.RawMessage) error {
	return func(ctx context.Context, env Env, rawIn, rawOut json.RawMessage) error {
		in, err := decode[In](rawIn)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var out Out
		if err := json.Unmarshal(rawOut, &out); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("decode output for verify: %w", err)
		}
		return verify(ctx, env, in, out)
	}
}

// findHandlers fills the optional lifecycle handlers h implements, found by
// type assertion as Uninstaller is on a Module. Effects and observations
// travel unchanged, so the methods are used as they are.
func findHandlers(eh *ErasedHandler, h any) {
	if o, ok := h.(Observer); ok {
		eh.Observe = o.Observe
	}
	if r, ok := h.(Resolver); ok {
		eh.Resolved = r.Resolved
	}
	if u, ok := h.(Undoer); ok {
		eh.Inverse = u.Inverse
	}
	if r, ok := h.(Recoverer); ok {
		eh.Recover = r.Recover
	}
}
```

```go
// DefineComposite declares a composite: Class composite, Side controller,
// LockKeys ["composite:<module>"], spec.Unwind kept. It has no Plan, Apply or
// Verify handler; the engine plans, applies and recovers it from Steps.
func DefineComposite[In, Out any](spec ActionSpec, h Composer[In, Out]) ActionDef {
	module, _, _ := strings.Cut(spec.Name, ".")
	spec.Class, spec.Side = ClassComposite, SideController
	spec.LockKeys = []string{"composite:" + module}
	return ActionDef{
		Spec: spec, InputType: typeOf[In](), OutputType: typeOf[Out](),
		Handler: ErasedHandler{
			Steps: func(ctx context.Context, env Env, raw json.RawMessage) ([]Step, error) {
				in, err := decode[In](raw)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				return h.Steps(ctx, env, in)
			},
			Output: func(ctx context.Context, env Env, raw json.RawMessage, steps map[string]json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
				in, err := decode[In](raw)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				out, err := h.Output(ctx, env, in, steps)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				return encode(out)
			},
		},
	}
}

// DefineTask declares a task action, whose host sequences run in transient
// units, and sets Task and LongRunning. spec.Class stays the caller's:
// compensable or irreversible. It has a Task handler in place of Apply. A
// handler that also implements Observer, Resolver, Undoer or Recoverer gets
// the matching handler; without a Recoverer the engine's task sequence is
// all the recovery there is.
func DefineTask[In, Out any](spec ActionSpec, h TaskMutator[In, Out]) ActionDef {
	spec.Task, spec.LongRunning = true, true
	eh := ErasedHandler{Plan: erasedPlan(h.Plan), Task: erasedRun(h.Task), Verify: erasedVerify(h.Verify)}
	findHandlers(&eh, h)
	return ActionDef{Spec: spec, InputType: typeOf[In](), OutputType: typeOf[Out](), Handler: eh}
}
```

```go
// revertible declares name with the lock key name and the repair action
// regRepairName(name), which regRepairOf declares.
func revertible(name string, side Side) ActionDef {
	return DefineRevertible[echoIn, echoOut](ActionSpec{
		Name: name, Version: 1, Side: side, LockKeys: []string{name}, RepairedBy: regRepairName(name),
	}, echo{})
}

// regRepairName is "<module>.<noun>.repair" for the action "<module>.<noun>.<verb>".
func regRepairName(name string) string { return name[:strings.LastIndex(name, ".")] + ".repair" }

// regRepairOf is the irreversible repair action of the revertible action rev,
// on its side and with its lock keys.
func regRepairOf(rev ActionDef) ActionDef {
	return DefineMutating[echoIn, echoOut](ActionSpec{
		Name: rev.Spec.RepairedBy, Version: 1, Class: ClassIrreversible, Side: rev.Spec.Side, LockKeys: rev.Spec.LockKeys,
	}, echo{})
}

// regUndoEcho is echo with an undo handler.
type regUndoEcho struct{ echo }

func (regUndoEcho) Observe(context.Context, Env, Effect) (Observation, error) {
	return Observation{}, nil
}

func (regUndoEcho) Inverse(context.Context, Env, Effect) (InverseResult, error) {
	return InverseResult{}, nil
}

// regRecoverEcho is echo with a module recovery handler.
type regRecoverEcho struct{ echo }

func (regRecoverEcho) Recover(context.Context, Env) (RecoveryOutcome, error) {
	return RecoveryOutcome{}, nil
}

// regTaskEcho is the handler of a task action.
type regTaskEcho struct{ echo }

func (regTaskEcho) Task(_ context.Context, _ Env, in echoIn) (echoOut, error) {
	return echoOut{"applied " + in.Name}, nil
}

// regComposer is the handler of a composite action over input In.
type regComposer[In any] struct{}

func (regComposer[In]) Steps(context.Context, Env, In) ([]Step, error) { return nil, nil }

func (regComposer[In]) Output(context.Context, Env, In, map[string]json.RawMessage) (echoOut, error) {
	return echoOut{}, nil
}

type regSecretIn struct {
	Key string `json:"key" secret:"true"`
}

type regNestedSecretIn struct {
	Items []struct {
		Auth *regSecretIn `json:"auth"`
	} `json:"items"`
}

func regCompensable(name string, spec ActionSpec, h Mutator[echoIn, echoOut]) ActionDef {

}

func regComposite(name string, unwind Unwind) ActionDef {
```

Add these declarations directly before `func checkAction`:

```go
// maxSyncApplyTimeout is the longest ApplyTimeout an action may declare
// without LongRunning: a synchronous apply must answer before the API
// servers' 60 s write timeout.
const maxSyncApplyTimeout = 45 * time.Second

// checkRepairedBy checks a revertible action's repair action (spec 1.3): every
// registered version of it belongs to the same module and side, is a mutating
// action that is neither a task action nor has a recovery handler, and locks
// no key the revertible action does not hold, because its repair change runs
// under the revertible change's locks.
func (r *Registry) checkRepairedBy(a ActionDef) []error {
	ref, name := a.Ref(), a.Spec.RepairedBy
	module, _, _ := strings.Cut(a.Spec.Name, ".")
	if !r.names[name] {
		return []error{fmt.Errorf("action %s: repair action %q is not registered", ref, name)}
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(name, module+".") {
		return []error{fmt.Errorf("action %s: repair action %s is not of module %s", ref, name, module)}
	}
	var errs []error
	for _, rep := range r.actions {
		if rep.Spec.Name != name {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case rep.Spec.Side != a.Spec.Side:
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("action %s: repair action %s runs on side %s, not %s", ref, rep.Ref(), rep.Spec.Side, a.Spec.Side))
		case rep.Spec.Class != ClassCompensable && rep.Spec.Class != ClassIrreversible:
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("action %s: repair action %s is %s, want compensable or irreversible", ref, rep.Ref(), rep.Spec.Class))
		case rep.Spec.Task:
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("action %s: repair action %s is a task action", ref, rep.Ref()))
		case rep.Handler.Recover != nil:
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("action %s: repair action %s has a recovery handler", ref, rep.Ref()))
		}
		for _, key := range rep.Spec.LockKeys {
			if !slices.Contains(a.Spec.LockKeys, key) {
				errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("action %s: repair action %s takes lock %s, which %s does not hold", ref, rep.Ref(), key, ref))
			}
		}
	}
	return errs
}

// hasSecretField reports whether t, or a type it contains, has a field
// tagged secret:"true".
func hasSecretField(t reflect.Type, seen map[reflect.Type]bool) bool {
	if seen[t] {
		return false
	}
	seen[t] = true
	switch t.Kind() {
	case reflect.Pointer, reflect.Slice, reflect.Array, reflect.Map:
		return hasSecretField(t.Elem(), seen)
	case reflect.Struct:
		for i := range t.NumField() {
			f := t.Field(i)
			if f.Tag.Get("secret") == "true" || hasSecretField(f.Type, seen) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

// checkLifecycle applies the lifecycle declaration rules of spec 1.3 that
// one action can be checked against alone.
func checkLifecycle(moduleID string, a ActionDef) error {
	s, h := a.Spec, a.Handler
	ref := a.Ref()
	compositeKey := "composite:" + moduleID
	undoes := h.Inverse != nil
	compensations := 0
	for _, set := range []bool{undoes, s.CompensatedBy != "", s.ForwardOnly} {
		if set {
			compensations++
		}
	}
	switch {
	case s.Class == ClassComposite && s.Side != SideController:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: composite actions are controller-side", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassComposite && (h.Steps == nil || h.Output == nil):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a composite action has Steps and Output handlers", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassComposite && s.Unwind != UnwindReverse && s.Unwind != UnwindForward:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a composite action declares Unwind reverse or forward", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassComposite && !slices.Equal(s.LockKeys, []string{compositeKey}):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a composite action holds exactly the lock key %s", ref, compositeKey)
	case s.Class == ClassComposite && hasSecretField(a.InputType, map[reflect.Type]bool{}):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a composite action's input has no secret field", ref)
	case s.Class != ClassComposite && slices.ContainsFunc(s.LockKeys, func(k string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(k, "composite:") }):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: only composite actions declare a composite:* lock key", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassCompensable && compensations != 1:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a compensable action declares exactly one of an undo handler, CompensatedBy or ForwardOnly", ref)
	case s.ForwardOnly && !s.Converges:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a ForwardOnly action must declare Converges", ref)
	case undoes && (s.Class != ClassCompensable || len(s.LockKeys) == 0):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: an undo handler needs a compensable action with at least one lock key", ref)
	case s.ApplyTimeout > maxSyncApplyTimeout && !s.LongRunning:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: an ApplyTimeout above %s requires LongRunning", ref, maxSyncApplyTimeout)
	case s.Task && s.Class != ClassCompensable && s.Class != ClassIrreversible:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a task action is compensable or irreversible", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassRevertible && s.RepairedBy == "":
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a revertible action names its repair action in RepairedBy", ref)
	case s.Class != ClassRevertible && s.RepairedBy != "":
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: only revertible actions name a repair action", ref)
	case s.Task && (s.Side != SideAgent || len(s.LockKeys) == 0 || s.ApplyTimeout <= 0):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a task action is agent-side with lock keys and an ApplyTimeout", ref)
	case s.Task && (h.Apply != nil || h.Task == nil):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a task action has a Task handler and no Apply", ref)
	case !s.Task && h.Task != nil:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: only task actions have a Task handler", ref)
	case s.Class != ClassComposite && (h.Steps != nil || h.Output != nil):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: only composite actions have Steps and Output handlers", ref)
	}
	return nil
}
```

Replace `checkAction` with:

```go
func checkAction(moduleID string, a ActionDef) error {
	s, h := a.Spec, a.Handler
	ref := a.Ref()
	switch {
	case !actionNamePattern.MatchString(s.Name) || !strings.HasPrefix(s.Name, moduleID+"."):
		return fmt.Errorf("action %q must match %s and start with %q", s.Name, actionNamePattern, moduleID+".")
	case s.Version < 1:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: version must be at least 1", s.Name)
	case s.Side != SideController && s.Side != SideAgent:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: unknown side %q", ref, s.Side)
	case s.BreakGlass && s.Side != SideController:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: break-glass actions are controller-side", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassRevertible && s.Side != SideAgent:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: revertible actions are agent-side; controller-side actions have no revert timer", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassRevertible && s.Side == SideAgent && len(s.LockKeys) == 0:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a revertible agent action declares at least one lock key, so an update's reservation holds it off", ref)
	case s.Class != ClassCompensable && s.CompensatedBy != "":
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: only compensable actions name a compensating action", ref)
	case s.Class == ClassRead && len(s.LockKeys) > 0:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: read actions take no locks", ref)
	}
	if err := checkLifecycle(moduleID, a); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	switch s.Class {
	case ClassRead:
		if h.Read == nil || h.Plan != nil || h.Apply != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a read action has only a Read handler", ref)
		}
	case ClassCompensable, ClassIrreversible:
		// checkLifecycle already required Task instead of Apply for a task action.
		if h.Read != nil || h.Plan == nil || (h.Apply == nil && h.Task == nil) || h.Verify == nil || h.Snapshot != nil || h.Revert != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a %s action has Plan, Apply and Verify handlers only", ref, s.Class)
		}
	case ClassRevertible:
		if h.Read != nil || h.Plan == nil || h.Apply == nil || h.Verify == nil || h.Snapshot == nil || h.Revert == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a revertible action has Plan, Apply, Verify, Snapshot and Revert handlers", ref)
		}
	case ClassComposite:
		if h.Read != nil || h.Plan != nil || h.Apply != nil || h.Verify != nil || h.Snapshot != nil || h.Revert != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("action %s: a composite action has Steps and Output handlers only", ref)
		}
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("action %s: unknown class %q", ref, s.Class)
	}
	return nil
}
```

The `case s.Class == ClassCompensable && s.CompensatedBy == ""` row is gone: `checkLifecycle` now requires exactly one of an undo handler, `CompensatedBy` or `ForwardOnly`. The `RepairedBy` input's `{}` rule is Task 20's (`lifecycle.New`), not the registry's.

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/coretest"
)

// The fixture module "jfx" journals its effects. Its host is jstore, a map of
// item names to StateDocs; Version is a revision every write bumps. Its
// compensable actions create, modify and delete one item and have an undo
// handler; jfx.item.set is revertible; jfx.item.slow is LongRunning.
// Input flags choose locality and make a call fail, hang or misbehave.

var (
	refJCreate = core.ActionRef{Name: "jfx.item.create", Version: 1}
	refJModify = core.ActionRef{Name: "jfx.item.modify", Version: 1}
	refJDelete = core.ActionRef{Name: "jfx.item.delete", Version: 1}
	refJSet    = core.ActionRef{Name: "jfx.item.set", Version: 1}    // revertible
	refJSlow   = core.ActionRef{Name: "jfx.item.slow", Version: 1}   // compensable, LongRunning
	refJRepair = core.ActionRef{Name: "jfx.item.repair", Version: 1} // jfx.item.set's RepairedBy
)

// jfxCommitWait is the CommitWait of every remote jfx call.
const jfxCommitWait = 2 * time.Minute

type jIn struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	Value  string `json:"value,omitempty"`
	Secret string `json:"secret,omitempty" secret:"true"`
	// Local and InverseLocal declare the forward and inverse calls local.
	Local        bool `json:"local,omitempty"`
	InverseLocal bool `json:"inverseLocal,omitempty"`
	// FailBeforeCall fails after Intend without making the call; with
	// Definite the handler records Skipped and fails with a Definite error.
	FailBeforeCall bool `json:"failBeforeCall,omitempty"`
	Definite       bool `json:"definite,omitempty"`
	// FailAfterCall makes the call, then fails before Made.
	FailAfterCall bool `json:"failAfterCall,omitempty"`
	// HangApply blocks after Intend, before the call, until ctx is done or
	// the test opens the item's gate; HangVerify blocks Verify until the gate
	// opens, ignoring ctx.
	HangApply  bool `json:"hangApply,omitempty"`
	HangVerify bool `json:"hangVerify,omitempty"`
	// ObserveErr makes every observation of the item fail.
	ObserveErr bool `json:"observeErr,omitempty"`
	// InverseFail and InverseDefinite make the inverse fail without writing,
	// the second with a Definite error. InverseCreates makes the undo of a
	// deletion recreate the item under the new identity "<name>~r".
	InverseFail     bool `json:"inverseFail,omitempty"`
	InverseDefinite bool `json:"inverseDefinite,omitempty"`
	InverseCreates  bool `json:"inverseCreates,omitempty"`
	// Allowed is the item's Observation.Allowed.
	Allowed []string `json:"allowed,omitempty"`
	// Candidates makes a creation's call create the item twice, as a
	// retried provider call can, so its recovery identity matches two.
	Candidates bool `json:"candidates,omitempty"`
}

type jOut struct {
	Resource string `json:"resource"`
	Token    string `json:"token" secret:"true"`
}

type jRepairIn struct {
	Name    string `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Value   string `json:"value,omitempty"`
	Fail    bool   `json:"fail,omitempty"`
	Outcome string `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
}

type jRepairOut struct {
	RepairOutcome string `json:"repairOutcome"`
}

// jSaw is one handler call as jstore recorded it.
type jSaw struct {
	Call, ChangeID string
	CallCtx        core.CallContext
	Journal        bool // Env.Effects was set
}

type jstore struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	docs map[string]core.StateDoc
	rev  int
	// flags are the jIn flags of the last apply of each item, which Observe
	// and Inverse read: neither gets the input.
	flags map[string]jIn
	gates map[string]chan struct{}
	// entered receives an item name each time a hang starts.
	entered chan string
	saw     []jSaw
	// guardFails makes jfx.item.set's lockout guard fail on the state its
	// change left (spec 1.2's connectivity exception).
	guardFails bool
	// cancelled counts hung applies whose ctx ended.
	cancelled int
}

func newJStore() *jstore {
	return &jstore{docs: map[string]core.StateDoc{}, flags: map[string]jIn{}, gates: map[string]chan struct{}{},
		entered: make(chan string, 16)}
}

func (s *jstore) record(call string, env core.Env) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.saw = append(s.saw, jSaw{Call: call, ChangeID: env.ChangeID, CallCtx: env.Call, Journal: env.Effects != nil})
}

// calls returns the recorded calls named call.
func (s *jstore) calls(call string) []jSaw {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	var out []jSaw
	for _, c := range s.saw {
		if c.Call == call {
			out = append(out, c)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// doc is the state of a stored value: State {"value": v}, Version the
// revision of the write.
func (s *jstore) doc(value string) core.StateDoc {
	s.rev++
	return core.StateDoc{
		State:   json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"value":%q}`, value)),
		Version: json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"rev":%d}`, s.rev)),
	}
}

// put stores value under name, as a write outside Darkpanel does.
func (s *jstore) put(name, value string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.docs[name] = s.doc(value)
}

// get returns the stored doc of name, or {"state": null}.
func (s *jstore) get(name string) core.StateDoc {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.getLocked(name)
}

func (s *jstore) getLocked(name string) core.StateDoc {
	if d, ok := s.docs[name]; ok {
		return d
	}
	return core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
}

func (s *jstore) setFlags(in jIn) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.flags[in.Name] = in
}

func (s *jstore) flagsOf(name string) jIn {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.flags[strings.TrimSuffix(name, "~r")]
}

func (s *jstore) gate(name string) chan struct{} {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.gates[name] == nil {
		s.gates[name] = make(chan struct{})
	}
	return s.gates[name]
}

// open releases every hang on name.
func (s *jstore) open(name string) { close(s.gate(name)) }

// waitEntered waits until a hang on name started.
func (s *jstore) waitEntered(t *testing.T, name string) {
	t.Helper()
	select {
	case got := <-s.entered:
		if got != name {
			t.Fatalf("hang started on %s, want %s", got, name)
		}
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatalf("no hang started on %s", name)
	}
}

func jIdentity(name string) string { return "jfx.item:" + name }

// jName is the item name of a jfx resource; a creation's "?<name>" too.
func jName(resource string) string {
	return strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(resource, "jfx.item:"), "?")
}

// jObserver observes jstore items for every jfx action.
type jObserver struct{ s *jstore }

func (o jObserver) Observe(_ context.Context, env core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.Observation, error) {
	o.s.record("Observe", env)
	name := jName(e.Resource)
	if e.State == core.EffectUndoing || e.State == core.EffectUndone {
		switch {
		case e.UndoResource != "":
			name = jName(e.UndoResource)
		case e.InverseRecovery != nil:
			name = e.InverseRecovery.Value
		}
	}
	flags := o.s.flagsOf(name)
	if flags.ObserveErr {
		return core.Observation{}, errors.New("observe failed")
	}
	o.s.mu.Lock()
	defer o.s.mu.Unlock()
	obs := core.Observation{Matches: 1, Resource: jIdentity(name), Exclusive: true, Allowed: flags.Allowed}
	if e.Kind != core.EffectCreate || !strings.Contains(e.Resource, ":?") {
		obs.Current = o.s.getLocked(name)
		return obs, nil
	}
	var keys []string
	for k := range o.s.docs {
		if k == name || strings.HasPrefix(k, name+"#") {
			keys = append(keys, k)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(keys)
	obs.Matches, obs.Resource, obs.Current = len(keys), "", core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
	for _, k := range keys {
		obs.Candidates = append(obs.Candidates, core.Candidate{Resource: jIdentity(k), State: o.s.docs[k]})
	}
	if len(keys) == 1 {
		obs.Resource, obs.Current = jIdentity(keys[0]), o.s.docs[keys[0]]
	}
	return obs, nil
}

// jMutator is the forward half of every journaling jfx action; kind is the
// effect each apply journals.
type jMutator struct {
	jObserver
	kind core.EffectKind
}

func (m jMutator) Plan(_ context.Context, env core.Env, in jIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	m.s.record("Plan", env)
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{{Op: "+", Text: in.Name + "=" + in.Value}}, StateHash: "jfx"}, nil
}

func (m jMutator) Apply(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, in jIn) (jOut, error) {
	m.s.record("Apply", env)
	m.s.setFlags(in)
	eff := core.Effect{
		Kind: m.kind, Resource: jIdentity(in.Name), Local: in.Local, InverseLocal: in.InverseLocal,
		Before: m.s.get(in.Name), After: &core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"value":%q}`, in.Value))},
	}
	if !in.Local {
		eff.CommitWait = jfxCommitWait
	}
	switch m.kind {
	case core.EffectCreate:
		eff.Resource = "jfx.item:?" + in.Name
		eff.Recovery = &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name", Value: in.Name}
		eff.Before = core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
	case core.EffectDelete:
		eff.After = &core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
		eff.InverseRecovery = &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name", Value: in.Name}
	}
	var secret []byte
	if in.Secret != "" {
		secret = []byte(in.Secret)
	}
	seq, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, eff, secret)
	if err != nil {
		return jOut{}, err
	}
	switch {
	case in.FailBeforeCall && in.Definite:
		if err := env.Effects.Skipped(ctx, seq); err != nil {
			return jOut{}, err
		}
		return jOut{}, core.Definite(errors.New("refused before the call"))
	case in.FailBeforeCall:
		return jOut{}, errors.New("failed before the call")
	case in.HangApply:
		m.s.entered <- in.Name
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			m.s.mu.Lock()
			m.s.cancelled++
			m.s.mu.Unlock()
			return jOut{}, ctx.Err()
		case <-m.s.gate(in.Name):
		}
	}
	m.s.mu.Lock()
	switch m.kind {
	case core.EffectDelete:
		delete(m.s.docs, in.Name)
	default:
		m.s.docs[in.Name] = m.s.doc(in.Value)
		if in.Candidates {
			m.s.docs[in.Name+"#2"] = m.s.doc(in.Value)
		}
	}
	post := m.s.getLocked(in.Name)
	m.s.mu.Unlock()
	if in.FailAfterCall {
		return jOut{}, errors.New("failed after the call")
	}
	if err := env.Effects.Made(ctx, seq, jIdentity(in.Name), post); err != nil {
		return jOut{}, err
	}
	return jOut{Resource: jIdentity(in.Name), Token: "tok-" + in.Name}, nil
}

func (m jMutator) Verify(_ context.Context, env core.Env, in jIn, _ jOut) error {
	m.s.record("Verify", env)
	if in.HangVerify {
		m.s.entered <- in.Name
		<-m.s.gate(in.Name)
	}
	want := core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
	if m.kind != core.EffectDelete {
		want.State = json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"value":%q}`, in.Value))
	}
	if got := m.s.get(in.Name); !stateEqual(got, want) {
		return fmt.Errorf("item %s is %s, want %s", in.Name, got.State, want.State)
	}
	return nil
}

// jUndoer is a compensable jfx action with an undo handler.
type jUndoer struct{ jMutator }

func (u jUndoer) Inverse(_ context.Context, env core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.InverseResult, error) {
	u.s.record("Inverse", env)
	name := jName(e.Resource)
	flags := u.s.flagsOf(name)
	switch {
	case flags.InverseDefinite:
		return core.InverseResult{}, core.Definite(errors.New("inverse refused"))
	case flags.InverseFail:
		return core.InverseResult{}, errors.New("inverse failed")
	}
	u.s.mu.Lock()
	defer u.s.mu.Unlock()
	if e.UndoTo == nil || string(e.UndoTo.State) == "null" {
		delete(u.s.docs, name)
		return core.InverseResult{}, nil
	}
	var st struct {
		Value string `json:"value"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(e.UndoTo.State, &st); err != nil {
		return core.InverseResult{}, err
	}
	if e.Kind == core.EffectDelete && flags.InverseCreates {
		u.s.docs[name+"~r"] = u.s.doc(st.Value)
		return core.InverseResult{Resource: jIdentity(name + "~r")}, nil
	}
	u.s.docs[name] = u.s.doc(st.Value)
	return core.InverseResult{}, nil
}

// jSnap is jfx.item.set's snapshot: the item before the apply.
type jSnap struct {
	Name    string        `json:"name"`
	Doc     core.StateDoc `json:"doc"`
	Present bool          `json:"present"`
}

// jReverter is jfx.item.set: a revertible modify of one item whose Revert
// follows spec 1.2's precedence rule, with jstore.guardFails as its lockout
// guard.
type jReverter struct{ jMutator }

func (r jReverter) Snapshot(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in jIn) ([]byte, error) {
	r.s.mu.Lock()
	defer r.s.mu.Unlock()
	d, ok := r.s.docs[in.Name]
	return json.Marshal(jSnap{Name: in.Name, Doc: d, Present: ok})
}

func (r jReverter) Revert(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, snapshot []byte) (core.RevertOutcome, error) {
	r.s.record("Revert", env)
	var snap jSnap
	if err := json.Unmarshal(snapshot, &snap); err != nil {
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, err
	}
	effects, err := env.Effects.List(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, err
	}
	r.s.mu.Lock()
	defer r.s.mu.Unlock()
	restore := func() {
		if snap.Present {
			r.s.docs[snap.Name] = r.s.doc(jValue(snap.Doc))
		} else {
			delete(r.s.docs, snap.Name)
		}
	}
	override := func() core.RevertOutcome {
		out := core.RevertOutcome{Override: true, Detail: json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"overwritten":%q}`, snap.Name))}
		for _, eff := range effects {
			cur := r.s.getLocked(snap.Name)
			out.Effects = append(out.Effects, core.EffectOutcome{Seq: eff.Seq, State: core.EffectUnresolved,
				Reason: core.ReasonConflict, Current: &cur})
		}
		restore()
		return out
	}
	for _, eff := range effects {
		if eff.State != core.EffectUnresolved {
			continue
		}
		if r.s.guardFails {
			return override(), nil
		}
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("effect %d is unresolved", eff.Seq)
	}
	var out core.RevertOutcome
	left := false
	for _, eff := range effects {
		if eff.State != core.EffectMade {
			continue
		}
		cur := r.s.getLocked(snap.Name)
		if !docEqual(cur, *eff.Post) {
			left = true
			out.Effects = append(out.Effects, core.EffectOutcome{Seq: eff.Seq, State: core.EffectUnresolved,
				Reason: core.ReasonConflict, Current: &cur})
			continue
		}
		restore()
		out.Effects = append(out.Effects, core.EffectOutcome{Seq: eff.Seq, State: core.EffectUndone})
	}
	if left && r.s.guardFails {
		return override(), nil
	}
	return out, nil
}

// jValue is the value of a jfx StateDoc.
func jValue(d core.StateDoc) string {
	var st struct {
		Value string `json:"value"`
	}
	_ = json.Unmarshal(d.State, &st)
	return st.Value
}

// jRepairer is jfx.item.repair: it sets an item when Name is given and
// reports Outcome ("restored" when empty) as its repairOutcome.
type jRepairer struct{ s *jstore }

func (r jRepairer) Plan(_ context.Context, env core.Env, in jRepairIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	r.s.record("Plan", env)
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{{Op: "+", Text: "repair " + in.Name}}, StateHash: "jfx-repair"}, nil
}

func (r jRepairer) Apply(_ context.Context, env core.Env, in jRepairIn) (jRepairOut, error) {
	r.s.record("Apply", env)
	if in.Fail {
		return jRepairOut{}, errors.New("repair failed")
	}
	if in.Name != "" {
		r.s.put(in.Name, in.Value)
	}
	if in.Outcome == "" {
		in.Outcome = core.RepairRestored
	}
	return jRepairOut{RepairOutcome: in.Outcome}, nil
}

func (r jRepairer) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, jRepairIn, jRepairOut) error { return nil }

// jfxOptions configure the jfx module of one fixture.
type jfxOptions struct {
	applyTimeout time.Duration // every jfx action's ApplyTimeout; 0 keeps the default
}

type jfxModule struct {
	s    *jstore
	opts jfxOptions
}

func (m jfxModule) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	spec := func(ref core.ActionRef, class core.Class) core.ActionSpec {
		return core.ActionSpec{Name: ref.Name, Version: 1, Class: class, Side: core.SideAgent,
			LockKeys: []string{"jfx"}, ApplyTimeout: m.opts.applyTimeout}
	}
	mut := func(kind core.EffectKind) jMutator { return jMutator{jObserver{m.s}, kind} }
	set := spec(refJSet, core.ClassRevertible)
	set.RepairedBy = refJRepair.Name
	slow := spec(refJSlow, core.ClassCompensable)
	slow.LongRunning = true
	repair := spec(refJRepair, core.ClassCompensable)
	repair.ForwardOnly, repair.Converges = true, true
	return core.Manifest{ID: "jfx", Version: 1, Actions: []core.ActionDef{
		core.DefineMutating(spec(refJCreate, core.ClassCompensable), jUndoer{mut(core.EffectCreate)}),
		core.DefineMutating(spec(refJModify, core.ClassCompensable), jUndoer{mut(core.EffectModify)}),
		core.DefineMutating(spec(refJDelete, core.ClassCompensable), jUndoer{mut(core.EffectDelete)}),
		core.DefineMutating(slow, jUndoer{mut(core.EffectModify)}),
		core.DefineRevertible(set, jReverter{mut(core.EffectModify)}),
		core.DefineMutating(repair, jRepairer{m.s}),
	}}
}

// jfixture is a fixture whose registry holds fix and jfx.
type jfixture struct {
	*fixture
	store *jstore
}

func newJFixture(t *testing.T, opts jfxOptions) *jfixture {
	t.Helper()
	h, s := &fixHost{items: map[string]string{}}, newJStore()
	reg, err := core.NewRegistry(fixModule{h}, jfxModule{s, opts})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f := &fixture{
		t: t, host: h, reg: reg, path: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "agent.db"),
		clock: coretest.NewFakeClock(time.Date(2026, 10, 21, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)),
	}
	f.open()
	return &jfixture{fixture: f, store: s}
}

// waitState polls a change until it is in state, for up to ten seconds, and
// returns its view.
func (f *fixture) waitState(changeID, state string) core.ChangeView {
	f.t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for {
		v, err := f.eng.Change(context.Background(), changeID)
		if err != nil {
			f.t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if v.State == state {
			return v
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			f.t.Fatalf("change %s is %s, want %s", changeID, v.State, state)
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// changeOf returns the id of the change of plan planID.
func (f *fixture) changeOf(planID string) string {
	f.t.Helper()
	var id string
	if err := f.db.Read().QueryRow("SELECT id FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", planID).Scan(&id); err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return id
}

// effects lists a change's effects from the database.
func (f *jfixture) effects(changeID string) []core.Effect {
	f.t.Helper()
	effs, err := loadEffects(context.Background(), f.db.Read(), changeID)
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return effs
}

// effectStates lists a change's effects as "<seq>:<state>[/<reason>]".
func (f *jfixture) effectStates(changeID string) []string {
	f.t.Helper()
	var out []string
	for _, e := range f.effects(changeID) {
		s := fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", e.Seq, e.State)
		if e.Reason != "" {
			s += "/" + e.Reason
		}
		out = append(out, s)
	}
	return out
}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"

// journalOf applies jfx.item.modify of item "a" locally, so its change has
// effect 1 made, and returns the change id and an Env whose journal is that
// change's.
func (f *jfixture) journalOf() (string, core.Env) {
	f.t.Helper()
	v := f.apply(alice, f.plan(alice, refJModify, `{"name":"a","value":"1","local":true}`).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	if v.State != core.StateCompleted {
		f.t.Fatalf("state = %s, want completed", v.State)
	}
	def, _ := f.reg.Action(refJModify)
	return v.ID, f.eng.changeEnv(alice, def, v.ID, core.CallContext{})
}

func modifyEffect(name string) core.Effect {
	return core.Effect{
		Kind: core.EffectModify, Resource: jIdentity(name), Local: true,
		Before: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"value":"0"}`)},
		After:  &core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"value":"1"}`)},
	}
}

func TestEffectJournalTransitions(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})
	ctx := context.Background()
	id, env := f.journalOf()
	post := core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"value":"1"}`)}

	made, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, modifyEffect("b"), nil)
	if err != nil || made != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("Intend = %d, %v; want seq 2", made, err)
	}
	if err := env.Effects.Made(ctx, made, jIdentity("b"), post); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Made: %v", err)
	}
	skipped, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, modifyEffect("c"), nil)
	if err != nil || skipped != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("Intend = %d, %v; want seq 3", skipped, err)
	}
	if err := env.Effects.Skipped(ctx, skipped); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Skipped: %v", err)
	}
	if got, want := f.effectStates(id), []string{"1:made", "2:made", "3:skipped"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("effects = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}

	illegal := []struct {
		name string
		call func() error
	}{
		{"made twice", func() error { return env.Effects.Made(ctx, made, jIdentity("b"), post) }},
		{"skipped after made", func() error { return env.Effects.Skipped(ctx, made) }},
		{"made after skipped", func() error { return env.Effects.Made(ctx, skipped, jIdentity("c"), post) }},
		{"skipped twice", func() error { return env.Effects.Skipped(ctx, skipped) }},
		{"unknown seq", func() error { return env.Effects.Skipped(ctx, 9) }},
	}
	for _, c := range illegal {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			before := f.effects(id)
			if err := c.call(); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("the transition was accepted")
			}
			if after := f.effects(id); !reflect.DeepEqual(after, before) {
				t.Errorf("a refused transition wrote: %+v, was %+v", after, before)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEffectJournalMadeChecksItsArguments(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})
	ctx := context.Background()
	_, env := f.journalOf()
	seq, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, modifyEffect("b"), nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	post := core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"value":"1"}`)}
	for name, call := range map[string]func() error{
		"resource without identity": func() error { return env.Effects.Made(ctx, seq, "jfx.item", post) },
		"resource not yet created":  func() error { return env.Effects.Made(ctx, seq, "jfx.item:?b", post) },
		"post not JSON": func() error {
			return env.Effects.Made(ctx, seq, jIdentity("b"), core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{`)})
		},
	} {
		if err := call(); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("%s: Made accepted it", name)
		}
	}
}

func TestIntendValidatesTheEffect(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})
	ctx := context.Background()
	_, env := f.journalOf()
	create := func() core.Effect {
		return core.Effect{
			Kind: core.EffectCreate, Resource: "jfx.item:?n", Recovery: &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name", Value: "n"},
			Before: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")},
		}
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		edit func(*core.Effect)
		want string
	}{
		{"unknown kind", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Kind = "rename" }, "effect kind"},
		{"resource without identity", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Resource = "jfx.item" }, "<module>.<noun>:<identity>"},
		{"resource noun with a dash", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Resource = "jfx.it-em:?n" }, "<module>.<noun>:<identity>"},
		{"creation without recovery", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Recovery = nil }, "declares its Recovery"},
		{"modify with recovery", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Kind, e.Resource = core.EffectModify, "jfx.item:n" }, "only a creation"},
		{"creation resource not its recovery", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Resource = "jfx.item:?m" }, "jfx.item:?<recovery value>"},
		{"creation resource already named", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Resource = "jfx.item:n" }, "jfx.item:?<recovery value>"},
		{"modify of an object not yet created", func(e *core.Effect) {
			e.Kind, e.Resource, e.Recovery = core.EffectModify, "jfx.item:?n", nil
		}, "not yet created"},
		{"negative commit wait", func(e *core.Effect) { e.CommitWait = -time.Second }, "negative CommitWait"},
		{"unknown recovery kind", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Recovery.Kind = "guess" }, "recovery identity"},
		{"empty inverse recovery value", func(e *core.Effect) { e.InverseRecovery = &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name"} }, "recovery identity"},
		{"before without state", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Before = core.StateDoc{} }, "Before.State"},
		{"before version not JSON", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Before.Version = json.RawMessage(`{`) }, "Before.Version"},
		{"creation before not null", func(e *core.Effect) { e.Before.State = json.RawMessage(`{"value":"0"}`) }, `{"state": null}`},
		{"after not JSON", func(e *core.Effect) { e.After = &core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`[`)} }, "After.State"},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			eff := create()
			c.edit(&eff)
			_, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, eff, nil)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), c.want) {
				t.Fatalf("Intend error = %v, want one containing %q", err, c.want)
			}
		})
	}
	if seq, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, create(), nil); err != nil || seq != 2 {
		t.Errorf("a valid creation: Intend = %d, %v; want seq 2", seq, err)
	}
}

func TestEffectSecretSealing(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})
	ctx := context.Background()
	id, env := f.journalOf()
	first, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, modifyEffect("b"), []byte("token-b"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, modifyEffect("c"), []byte("token-c"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, err := env.Effects.Secret(ctx, first); err != nil || string(got) != "token-b" {
		t.Errorf("Secret(%d) = %q, %v; want token-b", first, got, err)
	}
	var raw []byte
	if err := f.db.Read().QueryRow("SELECT secret_ct FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = ?", id, first).Scan(&raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if strings.Contains(string(raw), "token-b") {
		t.Error("the secret is stored in clear")
	}
	// A ciphertext moved to another effect no longer opens: the associated
	// data binds it to its change and seq.
	if _, err := f.db.Writer().Exec("UPDATE core_effects SET secret_ct = ? WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = ?", raw, id, second); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := env.Effects.Secret(ctx, second); err == nil {
		t.Error("a secret sealed for another effect opened")
	}
	if _, err := env.Effects.Secret(ctx, 1); err == nil {
		t.Error("Secret of an effect without one succeeded")
	}
}

func TestTerminalEffectClearsItsSecret(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})
	ctx := context.Background()
	id, env := f.journalOf()

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := env.Effects.Made(ctx, kept, jIdentity("b"), core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"value":"1"}`)}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gone, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, modifyEffect("c"), []byte("gone"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := env.Effects.Skipped(ctx, gone); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, err := env.Effects.Secret(ctx, kept); err != nil || string(got) != "kept" {
		t.Errorf("made effect secret = %q, %v; want it kept", got, err)
	}
	if n := f.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = ? AND secret_ct IS NULL", id, gone); n != 1 {
		t.Error("a skipped effect kept its secret")
	}
}

	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})

	}
	made := []core.EffectState{core.EffectMade}
	undoTo := core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`null`)}
	refused := []struct {
		name string
		from []core.EffectState
		u    effectUpdate
	}{
		{"not in from", []core.EffectState{core.EffectIntended}, effectUpdate{State: core.EffectSkipped}},
		{"made to skipped", made, effectUpdate{State: core.EffectSkipped}},
		{"made to accepted", made, effectUpdate{State: core.EffectAccepted}},
		{"unresolved without a reason", made, effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUnresolved}},
		{"undoing with a reason", made, effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUndoing, Reason: core.ReasonConflict}},
	}
	for _, c := range refused {

	if eff.State != core.EffectUnresolved || eff.Reason != core.ReasonUncertain || !stateEqual(*eff.UndoTo, undoTo) ||
		string(eff.Current.State) != `{"value":"x"}` || eff.Post == nil {

func TestCanonicalJSON(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct{ in, want string }{
		{`{"b":1,"a":2}`, `{"a":2,"b":1}`},
		{` { "a" : [ 1.0 , 1e2, 2.50 ] } `, `{"a":[1,100,2.5]}`},
		{`{"z":{"y":true,"x":null}}`, `{"z":{"x":null,"y":true}}`},
		{``, `null`},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		got, err := canonicalJSON(json.RawMessage(c.in))
		if err != nil || string(got) != c.want {
			t.Errorf("canonicalJSON(%q) = %s, %v; want %s", c.in, got, err, c.want)
		}
	}
	if _, err := canonicalJSON(json.RawMessage(`{`)); err == nil {
		t.Error("canonicalJSON accepted invalid JSON")
	}
}

func TestStateDocComparisons(t *testing.T) {
	doc := func(state, version string) core.StateDoc {
		return core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(state), Version: json.RawMessage(version)}
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name         string
		a, b         core.StateDoc
		equal, state bool
	}{
		{"same", doc(`{"v":1}`, `{"r":1}`), doc(`{ "v" : 1.0 }`, `{"r":1}`), true, true},
		{"version differs", doc(`{"v":1}`, `{"r":1}`), doc(`{"v":1}`, `{"r":2}`), false, true},
		{"state differs", doc(`{"v":1}`, `{"r":1}`), doc(`{"v":2}`, `{"r":1}`), false, false},
		{"no version and null version", doc(`null`, ``), doc(`null`, `null`), true, true},
		{"invalid JSON", doc(`{`, ``), doc(`{`, ``), false, false},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		if got := docEqual(c.a, c.b); got != c.equal {
			t.Errorf("%s: docEqual = %v, want %v", c.name, got, c.equal)
		}
		if got := stateEqual(c.a, c.b); got != c.state {
			t.Errorf("%s: stateEqual = %v, want %v", c.name, got, c.state)
		}
	}
	before := doc(`{"v":1}`, `{"r":7}`)
	if got := undoTo(core.Effect{Kind: core.EffectModify, Before: before}); string(got.State) != `{"v":1}` || got.Version != nil {
		t.Errorf("undoTo(modify) = %+v, want Before without Version", got)
	}
	if got := undoTo(core.Effect{Kind: core.EffectCreate, Before: before}); string(got.State) != "null" || got.Version != nil {
		t.Errorf("undoTo(create) = %+v, want {\"state\": null}", got)
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the journal**

Create `internal/core/lifecycle/effects.go`:

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
)

// queryer is a *sql.DB or a *sql.Tx.
type queryer interface {
	QueryContext(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (*sql.Rows, error)
	QueryRowContext(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) *sql.Row
}

// effectResourcePattern is "<module>.<noun>:<identity>" (spec 1.1 and 1.2).
var effectResourcePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9]*:.+$`)

// effectNext lists, per state, the states an effect may move to (spec 1.2,
// effect states). Every non-terminal state may also become abandoned.
var effectNext = map[core.EffectState][]core.EffectState{
	core.EffectIntended:   {core.EffectMade, core.EffectSkipped, core.EffectUnresolved, core.EffectAbandoned},
	core.EffectMade:       {core.EffectUnresolved, core.EffectUndoing, core.EffectAbandoned},
	core.EffectUndoing:    {core.EffectUndone, core.EffectMade, core.EffectUnresolved, core.EffectAbandoned},
	core.EffectUnresolved: {core.EffectAccepted, core.EffectMade, core.EffectSkipped, core.EffectAbandoned},
}

// effectTerminal reports whether s ends an effect.
func effectTerminal(s core.EffectState) bool {
	switch s {
	case core.EffectSkipped, core.EffectUndone, core.EffectAccepted, core.EffectAbandoned:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// effectSecretAD is the associated data of an effect's sealed secret (ADR 0005).
func effectSecretAD(changeID string, seq int) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("core_effects.secret_ct.%s.%d", changeID, seq)
}

// changeEnv is the Env of every handler call of a change: the engine's base,
// the caller, the change and its call context, and the change's effects
// journal.
func (e *Engine) changeEnv(p core.Principal, def core.ActionDef, changeID string, call core.CallContext) core.Env {
	env := e.env(p)
	env.ChangeID = changeID
	env.Call = call
	env.Effects = &effectJournal{e: e, def: def, changeID: changeID}
	return env
}

// effectJournal is core.EffectJournal over core_effects for one change. Each
// method is one committed write, so a journaled effect is durable before the
// call it announces is made.
type effectJournal struct {
	e        *Engine
	def      core.ActionDef
	changeID string
}

// Intend records eff as intended. The engine assigns ChangeID, Seq, State
// and CommitBy and ignores what the handler set there and in the fields only
// the engine writes.
func (j *effectJournal) Intend(ctx context.Context, eff core.Effect, secret []byte) (int, error) {
	if j.def.Handler.Observe == nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s journals an effect but has no Observer", j.def.Ref())
	}
	if err := checkIntended(eff); err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s: %w", j.def.Ref(), err)
	}
	recovery, err := nullableJSON(eff.Recovery)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	inverseRecovery, err := nullableJSON(eff.InverseRecovery)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	before, err := json.Marshal(eff.Before)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: encode effect before: %w", err)
	}
	after, err := nullableJSON(eff.After)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	now := j.e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()
	var commitBy any
	if !eff.Local {
		commitBy = formatTime(now.Add(eff.CommitWait))
	}
	var seq int
	err = j.e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx,
			"SELECT coalesce(max(seq), 0) + 1 FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ?", j.changeID).Scan(&seq); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var sealed []byte
		if len(secret) > 0 {
			var err error
			if sealed, err = j.e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Seal(effectSecretAD(j.changeID, seq), secret); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("seal effect secret: %w", err)
			}
		}
		created := formatTime(now)
		_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`INSERT INTO core_effects (change_id, seq, kind, resource, recovery_json, local, inverse_local,
			 commit_wait_ns, commit_by, inverse_recovery_json, before_json, after_json, state, secret_ct,
			 created_at, updated_at)
			 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
			j.changeID, seq, string(eff.Kind), eff.Resource, recovery, eff.Local, eff.InverseLocal,
			int64(eff.CommitWait), commitBy, inverseRecovery, string(before), after,
			string(core.EffectIntended), sealed, created, created)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: intend effect of change %s: %w", j.changeID, err)
	}
	return seq, nil
}

// checkIntended validates what a handler declares at Intend.
func checkIntended(eff core.Effect) error {
	switch eff.Kind {
	case core.EffectCreate, core.EffectModify, core.EffectDelete:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("effect kind %q, want create, modify or delete", eff.Kind)
	}
	if !effectResourcePattern.MatchString(eff.Resource) {
		return fmt.Errorf("effect resource %q, want <module>.<noun>:<identity>", eff.Resource)
	}
	noun, identity, _ := strings.Cut(eff.Resource, ":")
	switch {
	case eff.Kind == core.EffectCreate && eff.Recovery == nil:
		return errors.New("a creation declares its Recovery identity")
	case eff.Kind != core.EffectCreate && eff.Recovery != nil:
		return errors.New("only a creation declares a Recovery identity")
	case eff.Kind == core.EffectCreate && eff.Resource != noun+":?"+eff.Recovery.Value:
		return fmt.Errorf("a creation's resource is %s:?<recovery value>, not %s", noun, eff.Resource)
	case eff.Kind != core.EffectCreate && strings.HasPrefix(identity, "?"):
		return fmt.Errorf("resource %s names an object not yet created", eff.Resource)
	case eff.CommitWait < 0:
		return errors.New("a negative CommitWait")
	}
	for _, id := range []*core.RecoveryID{eff.Recovery, eff.InverseRecovery} {
		if id != nil && (!slices.Contains([]string{"name", "marker", "idempotency"}, id.Kind) || id.Value == "") {
			return fmt.Errorf("recovery identity %+v, want kind name, marker or idempotency and a value", *id)
		}
	}
	if err := checkDoc("Before", &eff.Before); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if eff.Kind == core.EffectCreate && !bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(eff.Before.State), []byte("null")) {
		return errors.New(`a creation's Before is {"state": null}`)
	}
	return checkDoc("After", eff.After)
}

// checkDoc refuses a StateDoc whose State is missing or either part is not
// JSON. A nil doc passes.
func checkDoc(name string, d *core.StateDoc) error {
	switch {
	case d == nil:
		return nil
	case !json.Valid(d.State):
		return fmt.Errorf("effect %s.State is not a JSON value", name)
	case len(d.Version) > 0 && !json.Valid(d.Version):
		return fmt.Errorf("effect %s.Version is not a JSON value", name)
	}
	return nil
}

// nullableJSON encodes v, storing a nil pointer as NULL.
func nullableJSON[T any](v *T) (any, error) {
	if v == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: encode %T: %w", v, err)
	}
	return string(b), nil
}

// Made records that the call of effect seq succeeded: resource names the
// object it acted on and post is its state now.
func (j *effectJournal) Made(ctx context.Context, seq int, resource string, post core.StateDoc) error {
	if _, identity, _ := strings.Cut(resource, ":"); !effectResourcePattern.MatchString(resource) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, "?") {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s: made resource %q, want <module>.<noun>:<identity>", j.def.Ref(), resource)
	}
	if err := checkDoc("Post", &post); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s: %w", j.def.Ref(), err)
	}
	return j.write(ctx, seq, effectUpdate{State: core.EffectMade, Resource: &resource, Post: &post})
}

// Skipped records that the call of effect seq was not made or committed
// nothing.
func (j *effectJournal) Skipped(ctx context.Context, seq int) error {
	return j.write(ctx, seq, effectUpdate{State: core.EffectSkipped})
}

func (j *effectJournal) write(ctx context.Context, seq int, u effectUpdate) error {
	err := j.e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		return setEffect(ctx, tx, j.e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now(), j.changeID, seq, []core.EffectState{core.EffectIntended}, u)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: record effect %d of change %s: %w", seq, j.changeID, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// List returns the change's effects in seq order.
func (j *effectJournal) List(ctx context.Context) ([]core.Effect, error) {
	return loadEffects(ctx, j.e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), j.changeID)
}

// Secret opens the sealed secret of effect seq. An effect without one, or
// whose secret was cleared, answers an error.
func (j *effectJournal) Secret(ctx context.Context, seq int) ([]byte, error) {
	var ct []byte
	err := j.e.cfg.Base.DB.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx,
		"SELECT secret_ct FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = ?", j.changeID, seq).Scan(&ct)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: change %s has no effect %d", j.changeID, seq)
	case err != nil:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read secret of effect %d of change %s: %w", seq, j.changeID, err)
	case ct == nil:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: effect %d of change %s holds no secret", seq, j.changeID)
	}
	secret, err := j.e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(effectSecretAD(j.changeID, seq), ct)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open secret of effect %d of change %s: %w", seq, j.changeID, err)
	}
	return secret, nil
}

// effectUpdate is one engine-written transition of an effect. Nil pointers
// and empty strings keep the stored value, except Reason, which is always
// written: only an unresolved effect has one.
type effectUpdate struct {
	State                  core.EffectState
	Reason                 string
	Resource               *string
	Post, UndoTo, Current  *core.StateDoc
	CommitBy               *time.Time
	UndoResource           *string
	Resolution, ResolvedBy string
	ResolvedAt             *time.Time
}

// setEffect writes an engine transition inside tx and refuses one 1.2's table
// does not allow; a terminal state clears secret_ct. The effect must be in
// one of from.
func setEffect(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, now time.Time, changeID string, seq int, from []core.EffectState, u effectUpdate) error {
	var cur string
	err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT state FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = ?", changeID, seq).Scan(&cur)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: change %s has no effect %d", changeID, seq)
	case err != nil:
		return err
	}
	state := core.EffectState(cur)
	switch {
	case !slices.Contains(from, state) || !slices.Contains(effectNext[state], u.State):
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: effect %d of change %s cannot move from %s to %s", seq, changeID, state, u.State)
	case (u.State == core.EffectUnresolved) != (u.Reason != ""):
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: effect %d of change %s: only an unresolved effect has a reason", seq, changeID)
	}
	docs := make([]any, 3)
	for i, d := range []*core.StateDoc{u.Post, u.UndoTo, u.Current} {
		if docs[i], err = nullableJSON(d); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	var commitBy, resolvedAt, resolution, resolvedBy any
	if u.CommitBy != nil {
		commitBy = formatTime(*u.CommitBy)
	}
	if u.ResolvedAt != nil {
		resolvedAt = formatTime(*u.ResolvedAt)
	}
	if u.Resolution != "" {
		resolution, resolvedBy = u.Resolution, u.ResolvedBy
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx,
		`UPDATE core_effects SET state = ?, reason = ?, resource = coalesce(?, resource),
		 post_json = coalesce(?, post_json), undo_to_json = coalesce(?, undo_to_json),
		 current_json = coalesce(?, current_json), commit_by = coalesce(?, commit_by),
		 undo_resource = coalesce(?, undo_resource), resolution = coalesce(?, resolution),
		 resolved_by = coalesce(?, resolved_by), resolved_at = coalesce(?, resolved_at),
		 secret_ct = CASE WHEN ? THEN NULL ELSE secret_ct END, updated_at = ?
		 WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = ?`,
		string(u.State), u.Reason, u.Resource, docs[0], docs[1], docs[2], commitBy, u.UndoResource,
		resolution, resolvedBy, resolvedAt, effectTerminal(u.State), formatTime(now), changeID, seq)
	return err
}

const effectColumns = `change_id, seq, kind, resource, recovery_json, local, inverse_local, commit_wait_ns,
	commit_by, inverse_recovery_json, undo_resource, before_json, after_json, post_json, undo_to_json,
	current_json, state, reason, resolution, resolved_by, resolved_at`

// loadEffects returns a change's effects in seq order.
func loadEffects(ctx context.Context, q queryer, changeID string) ([]core.Effect, error) {
	rows, err := q.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT "+effectColumns+" FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ? ORDER BY seq", changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: list effects of change %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = rows.Close() }()
	out := []core.Effect{}
	for rows.Next() {
		eff, err := scanEffect(rows)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: list effects of change %s: %w", changeID, err)
		}
		out = append(out, eff)
	}
	return out, rows.Err()
}

func scanEffect(s scanner) (core.Effect, error) {
	var eff core.Effect
	var kind, state, before string
	var commitWait int64
	var recovery, commitBy, inverseRecovery, after, post, undoTo, current, resolvedAt sql.NullString
	if err := s.Scan(&eff.ChangeID, &eff.Seq, &kind, &eff.Resource, &recovery, &eff.Local, &eff.InverseLocal,
		&commitWait, &commitBy, &inverseRecovery, &eff.UndoResource, &before, &after, &post, &undoTo,
		&current, &state, &eff.Reason, &eff.Resolution, &eff.ResolvedBy, &resolvedAt); err != nil {
		return eff, err
	}
	eff.Kind, eff.State, eff.CommitWait = core.EffectKind(kind), core.EffectState(state), time.Duration(commitWait)
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(before), &eff.Before); err != nil {
		return eff, err
	}
	for _, f := range []struct {
		raw sql.NullString
		dst any
	}{{recovery, &eff.Recovery}, {inverseRecovery, &eff.InverseRecovery}, {after, &eff.After},
		{post, &eff.Post}, {undoTo, &eff.UndoTo}, {current, &eff.Current}} {
		if !f.raw.Valid {
			continue
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(f.raw.String), f.dst); err != nil {
			return eff, err
		}
	}
	for _, f := range []struct {
		raw sql.NullString
		dst *time.Time
	}{{commitBy, &eff.CommitBy}, {resolvedAt, &eff.ResolvedAt}} {
		if !f.raw.Valid {
			continue
		}
		t, err := parseTime(f.raw.String)
		if err != nil {
			return eff, err
		}
		*f.dst = t
	}
	return eff, nil
}

// canonicalJSON re-encodes raw with object keys sorted, no insignificant
// whitespace and numbers as encoding/json writes a float64, so two documents
// that mean the same compare equal as bytes. Empty input is null.
func canonicalJSON(raw json.RawMessage) ([]byte, error) {
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(raw)) == 0 {
		return []byte("null"), nil
	}
	var v any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &v); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: canonical JSON: %w", err)
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: canonical JSON: %w", err)
	}
	return b, nil
}

// jsonEqual compares two JSON values canonically; a value that is not JSON
// equals nothing.
func jsonEqual(a, b json.RawMessage) bool {
	ca, errA := canonicalJSON(a)
	cb, errB := canonicalJSON(b)
	return errA == nil && errB == nil && bytes.Equal(ca, cb)
}

// docEqual is "Equal" of spec 1.2: State and Version equal.
func docEqual(a, b core.StateDoc) bool {
	return jsonEqual(a.State, b.State) && jsonEqual(a.Version, b.Version)
}

// stateEqual is "State-equal" of spec 1.2: State equal.
func stateEqual(a, b core.StateDoc) bool { return jsonEqual(a.State, b.State) }

// undoTo is the state an inverse must leave: Before with Version cleared, and
// for a creation the absence of the object.
func undoTo(eff core.Effect) core.StateDoc {
	if eff.Kind == core.EffectCreate {
		return core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
	}
	return core.StateDoc{State: eff.Before.State}
}

// effectView is an effect as callers see it, never its secret.
func effectView(eff core.Effect) core.EffectView {
	v := core.EffectView{
		ChangeID: eff.ChangeID, Seq: eff.Seq, Kind: eff.Kind, Resource: eff.Resource, Local: eff.Local,
		InverseLocal: eff.InverseLocal, State: eff.State, Reason: eff.Reason, Before: eff.Before, After: eff.After,
		Post: eff.Post, UndoTo: eff.UndoTo, UndoResource: eff.UndoResource, Current: eff.Current,
		Resolution: eff.Resolution, ResolvedBy: eff.ResolvedBy,
	}
	if !eff.CommitBy.IsZero() {
		t := eff.CommitBy
		v.CommitBy = &t
	}
	if !eff.ResolvedAt.IsZero() {
		t := eff.ResolvedAt
		v.ResolvedAt = &t
	}
	return v
}
```

```go
// runRevert runs the action's Revert with the change's stored snapshot.
func (e *Engine) runRevert(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) (core.RevertOutcome, error) {
	var action string
	var version int
	var ct []byte
	if err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx,
		"SELECT action, version, snapshot_ct FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", changeID).
		Scan(&action, &version, &ct); err != nil {
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read snapshot of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	ref := core.ActionRef{Name: action, Version: version}
	def, ok := e.cfg.Registry.Action(ref)
	if !ok {
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: action %s is not registered", ref)
	}
	snapshot, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(snapshotAD(changeID), ct)
	if err != nil {
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open snapshot of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	env := e.changeEnv(p, def, changeID, core.CallContext{})
	var out core.RevertOutcome
	err = e.protect(ref, "Revert", func() error {
		var err error
		out, err = def.Handler.Revert(ctx, env, snapshot)
		return err
	})
	return out, err
}
```

Decisions this task fixes:
- Every apply runs on `goRun` once its intent is persisted. `Apply` waits for the result, for `Config.SyncAnswer` on the clock, or for the run goroutine to end without a result (a handler that stopped its goroutine); the last two answer the change as stored (`applying`).
- A handler error counts as `core.deadline_exceeded` only when the action's deadline (not shutdown) ended its context. An Apply and Verify that both return nil after the deadline complete the change: the work is done and verified.
- `cleanupCall(def)` (handler calls after the apply ended, bounded by the action's `ApplyTimeout`) sits beside L2 `cleanup` (transactions, bounded by `CleanupTxTimeout`).
- `goRun` after `Close` runs `f` on the caller's goroutine, where the run context is already cancelled, so no goroutine outlives `Close`.

```go
func TestAVerifyIgnoringItsDeadlineKeepsTheChange(t *testing.T) {
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"

// applyInBackground applies planID as alice on a goroutine and returns the
// channel its view arrives on.
func (f *jfixture) applyInBackground(planID string) <-chan core.ChangeView {
	out := make(chan core.ChangeView, 1)
	go func() {
		v, err := f.eng.Apply(context.Background(), alice, planID, core.ApplyOptions{})
		if err != nil {
			f.t.Error(err)
		}
		out <- v
	}()
	return out
}

func TestApplyPastItsDeadlineFails(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{applyTimeout: 100 * time.Millisecond})
	v := f.apply(alice, f.plan(alice, refJModify, `{"name":"a","value":"1","local":true,"hangApply":true}`).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	if v.State != core.StateFailed || v.Error == nil || v.Error.Code != string(errcode.DeadlineExceeded) ||
		!strings.Contains(v.Error.Message, "jfx.item.modify/v1 did not finish within 100ms") {
		t.Errorf("change = %+v (error %+v), want failed with core.deadline_exceeded", v, v.Error)
	}
	if f.store.cancelled != 1 {
		t.Errorf("cancelled applies = %d, want the handler's context cancelled", f.store.cancelled)
	}
	if got := f.phases(); len(got) != 1 || got[0] != "apply/error/core.deadline_exceeded" {
		t.Errorf("journal = %v", got)
	}
}

func TestLongRunningApplyAnswersAtOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})
	v := f.apply(alice, f.plan(alice, refJSlow, `{"name":"a","value":"1","local":true,"hangApply":true}`).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	if v.State != core.StateApplying || v.Output != nil {
		t.Fatalf("answer = %+v, want the applying change", v)
	}
	f.store.waitEntered(t, "a")
	f.store.open("a")
	if done := f.waitState(v.ID, core.StateCompleted); string(done.Output) != `{"resource":"jfx.item:a","token":"[redacted]"}` {
		t.Errorf("output = %s, want the redacted output", done.Output)
	}
}

func TestSynchronousApplyAnswersAtSyncAnswer(t *testing.T) {
	f := newJFixture(t, jfxOptions{})
	if f.eng.cfg.SyncAnswer != SyncAnswer || SyncAnswer != 50*time.Second {
		t.Fatalf("SyncAnswer = %v (engine %v), want 50s", SyncAnswer, f.eng.cfg.SyncAnswer)
	}
	answer := f.applyInBackground(f.plan(alice, refJModify, `{"name":"a","value":"1","local":true,"hangApply":true}`).PlanID)
	f.store.waitEntered(t, "a")
	f.clock.Advance(SyncAnswer - time.Second)
	select {
	case v := <-answer:
		t.Fatalf("answered %+v before SyncAnswer", v)
	case <-time.After(50 * time.Millisecond):
	}
	f.clock.Advance(time.Second)
	v := <-answer
	if v.State != core.StateApplying {
		t.Fatalf("answer = %+v, want the applying change", v)
	}
	f.store.open("a")
	f.waitState(v.ID, core.StateCompleted)
}

func TestSealedInputIsKeptUntilTheChangeIsFinished(t *testing.T) {

	answer := f.applyInBackground(f.plan(alice, refJModify, `{"name":"a","value":"1","local":true,"hangApply":true}`).PlanID)
```

```go
	Base   core.Env

	SyncAnswer time.Duration
}

// Deadlines of spec 1.3.
const (
	// DefaultApplyTimeout is the budget of an action that declares no
	// ApplyTimeout, shared by its Apply and Verify.
	DefaultApplyTimeout = 30 * time.Second
	// SyncAnswer is how long Apply waits for a synchronous action. It stays
	// below the API servers' 60 s write timeout, so the answer always fits.
	SyncAnswer = 50 * time.Second
	// CleanupTxTimeout bounds a recording transaction that runs after the
	// action's own deadline.
	CleanupTxTimeout = 30 * time.Second
	// RecoveryVerifyBound is how long startup recovery waits for a Verify.
	RecoveryVerifyBound = 30 * time.Second
)
```

Replace `Close` and add the helpers after it:

```go
// Close stops every armed revert timer and arms no new one. A change whose
// timer was stopped stays pending until the next start's Recover reverts it.
// Close then cancels every in-process apply, as process shutdown does, and
// waits for each to record its result and for a running timer revert.
func (e *Engine) Close() {
	e.timerMu.Lock()
	e.closed = true
	for id, t := range e.timers {
		t.Stop()
		delete(e.timers, id)
	}
	// Unlock before waiting: a running revert takes timerMu in stopTimer.
	e.timerMu.Unlock()
	e.stopRun()
	e.inflight.Wait()
	e.runs.Wait()
}

// goRun runs f on a goroutine that Close waits for. After Close it runs f on
// the caller's goroutine instead, where f finds the run context cancelled.
func (e *Engine) goRun(f func()) {
	e.timerMu.Lock()
	if e.closed {
		e.timerMu.Unlock()
		f()
		return
	}
	e.runs.Add(1)
	e.timerMu.Unlock()
	go func() {
		defer e.runs.Done()
		f()
	}()
}

// applyTimeout is def's budget for Apply and Verify together.
func (e *Engine) applyTimeout(def core.ActionDef) time.Duration {
	if def.Spec.ApplyTimeout > 0 {
		return def.Spec.ApplyTimeout
	}
	return DefaultApplyTimeout
}

// cleanup is the context of a recording transaction after a handler call: it
// outlives the run context's cancellation, bounded by CleanupTxTimeout.
func (e *Engine) cleanup() (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
	return context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(e.runCtx), CleanupTxTimeout)
}

// cleanupCall is the context of a handler call made after the apply ended,
// such as a revert: it outlives the run context's cancellation, bounded by
// def's ApplyTimeout.
func (e *Engine) cleanupCall(def core.ActionDef) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
	return context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(e.runCtx), e.applyTimeout(def))
}
```
