```go
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/coretest"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// The test module "ufx" journals one effect per operation over ufxStore, a
// map of named objects, and implements Observer, Undoer and Resolver over
// it. Knobs on the store make an inverse or an observation misbehave and
// set an observation's candidates and allowed resolutions. The tests of
// undo, resolution, release, repair and secret purges use it.

const ufxKey = "ufx"

var (
	refUfx      = core.ActionRef{Name: "ufx.item.change", Version: 1} // compensable with an undo handler
	refUfxReset = core.ActionRef{Name: "ufx.item.reset", Version: 1}  // compensable and forward only: no undo handler
)

type ufxObject struct {
	value string
	rev   int
}

type ufxValue struct {
	Value string `json:"value"`
}

type ufxStore struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	objects map[string]ufxObject
	revs    int
	// inverse sets how Inverse treats an object: "definite" refuses with a
	// Definite error, "fail" fails before writing, "fail-after-write"
	// restores and then fails, "noop" returns without writing, and ""
	// restores.
	inverse     map[string]string
	observeErr  map[string]bool
	candidates  map[string][]core.Candidate
	allowed     map[string][]string
	onObserve   func() // runs at the start of every Observe, without mu held
	resolvedErr error
	resolved    []string // "<change id>/<seq>=<resolution> <state>" for every Resolved call
}

func newUfxStore() *ufxStore {
	return &ufxStore{
		objects: map[string]ufxObject{}, inverse: map[string]string{}, observeErr: map[string]bool{},
		candidates: map[string][]core.Candidate{}, allowed: map[string][]string{},
	}
}

// set writes value to the object id, or deletes it when value is empty.
// Every write gives the object a new revision.
func (s *ufxStore) set(id, value string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.setLocked(id, value)
}

func (s *ufxStore) setLocked(id, value string) {
	if value == "" {
		delete(s.objects, id)
		return
	}
	s.revs++
	s.objects[id] = ufxObject{value: value, rev: s.revs}
}

func (s *ufxStore) get(id string) (string, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o, ok := s.objects[id]
	return o.value, ok
}

func ufxState(value string) json.RawMessage {
	b, err := json.Marshal(ufxValue{Value: value})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return b
}

// docLocked is the object's StateDoc: the value is State, the revision is
// Version, and an absent object is {"state": null}.
func (s *ufxStore) docLocked(id string) core.StateDoc {
	o, ok := s.objects[id]
	if !ok {
		return core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
	}
	return core.StateDoc{State: ufxState(o.value), Version: json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"rev":%d}`, o.rev))}
}

func (s *ufxStore) hash() string {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	m := map[string]string{}
	for id, o := range s.objects {
		m[id] = fmt.Sprintf("%s@%d", o.value, o.rev)
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(m)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

// ufxIdentity is the object an effect names: the object the inverse left
// once the effect is undoing or undone, else the effect's resource.
func ufxIdentity(e core.Effect) string {
	r := e.Resource
	if (e.State == core.EffectUndoing || e.State == core.EffectUndone) && e.UndoResource != "" {
		r = e.UndoResource
	}
	return strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(r, "ufx.item:"), "?")
}

type ufxOp struct {
	ID            string `json:"id"`
	Value         string `json:"value,omitempty"`         // "" deletes the object
	Remote        bool   `json:"remote,omitempty"`        // the forward call is not Local
	InverseRemote bool   `json:"inverseRemote,omitempty"` // the inverse is not InverseLocal
}

type ufxIn struct {
	Ops []ufxOp `json:"ops"`
}

type ufxOut struct {
	Seqs []int `json:"seqs"`
}

// effect is the journal entry of op, taken before the call.
func (s *ufxStore) effect(op ufxOp) core.Effect {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	_, exists := s.objects[op.ID]
	after := core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}
	if op.Value != "" {
		after.State = ufxState(op.Value)
	}
	eff := core.Effect{
		Kind: core.EffectModify, Resource: "ufx.item:" + op.ID, Local: !op.Remote, InverseLocal: !op.InverseRemote,
		Before: s.docLocked(op.ID), After: &after,
	}
	switch {
	case !exists:
		eff.Kind, eff.Resource = core.EffectCreate, "ufx.item:?"+op.ID
		eff.Recovery = &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name", Value: op.ID}
	case op.Value == "":
		eff.Kind = core.EffectDelete
		eff.InverseRecovery = &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name", Value: op.ID}
	}
	if op.Remote || op.InverseRemote {
		eff.CommitWait = 2 * time.Minute
	}
	return eff
}

type ufxHandler struct{ s *ufxStore }

func (h ufxHandler) Plan(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in ufxIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	diff := make([]core.DiffLine, 0, len(in.Ops))
	for _, op := range in.Ops {
		diff = append(diff, core.DiffLine{Op: "+", Text: op.ID + "=" + op.Value})
	}
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: diff, StateHash: h.s.hash()}, nil
}

func (h ufxHandler) Apply(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, in ufxIn) (ufxOut, error) {
	var out ufxOut
	for _, op := range in.Ops {
		seq, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, h.s.effect(op), nil)
		if err != nil {
			return out, err
		}
		h.s.mu.Lock()
		h.s.setLocked(op.ID, op.Value)
		post := h.s.docLocked(op.ID)
		h.s.mu.Unlock()
		if err := env.Effects.Made(ctx, seq, "ufx.item:"+op.ID, post); err != nil {
			return out, err
		}
		out.Seqs = append(out.Seqs, seq)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (h ufxHandler) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, ufxIn, ufxOut) error { return nil }

func (h ufxHandler) Observe(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.Observation, error) {
	h.s.mu.Lock()
	hook := h.s.onObserve
	h.s.mu.Unlock()
	if hook != nil {
		hook()
	}
	id := ufxIdentity(e)
	h.s.mu.Lock()
	defer h.s.mu.Unlock()
	if h.s.observeErr[id] {
		return core.Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("ufx: cannot observe %s", id)
	}
	obs := core.Observation{Current: h.s.docLocked(id), Matches: 1, Exclusive: true, Allowed: h.s.allowed[id]}
	if _, ok := h.s.objects[id]; ok {
		obs.Resource = "ufx.item:" + id
	} else if e.Kind == core.EffectCreate {
		obs.Matches = 0
	}
	if c := h.s.candidates[id]; len(c) > 0 {
		obs.Matches, obs.Candidates, obs.Resource = len(c), c, ""
	}
	return obs, nil
}

func (h ufxHandler) Inverse(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.InverseResult, error) {
	id := ufxIdentity(e)
	h.s.mu.Lock()
	defer h.s.mu.Unlock()
	mode := h.s.inverse[id]
	switch mode {
	case "definite":
		return core.InverseResult{}, core.Definite(fmt.Errorf("ufx: the inverse of %s was refused", id))
	case "fail":
		return core.InverseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("ufx: the inverse of %s failed", id)
	case "noop":
		return core.InverseResult{}, nil
	}
	if e.UndoTo == nil {
		return core.InverseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("ufx: effect %d has no UndoTo", e.Seq)
	}
	var v ufxValue
	if err := json.Unmarshal(e.UndoTo.State, &v); err != nil {
		return core.InverseResult{}, err
	}
	h.s.setLocked(id, v.Value)
	if mode == "fail-after-write" {
		return core.InverseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("ufx: the inverse of %s failed after its write", id)
	}
	var res core.InverseResult
	if e.Kind == core.EffectDelete {
		res.Resource = "ufx.item:" + id
	}
	return res, nil
}

func (h ufxHandler) Resolved(_ context.Context, _ *sql.Tx, e core.Effect, resolution string) error {
	h.s.mu.Lock()
	defer h.s.mu.Unlock()
	h.s.resolved = append(h.s.resolved, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d=%s %s", e.ChangeID, e.Seq, resolution, e.State))
	return h.s.resolvedErr
}

type ufxResetIn struct {
	ID string `json:"id"`
}

type ufxResetOut struct{}

type ufxResetHandler struct{ s *ufxStore }

func (h ufxResetHandler) Plan(context.Context, core.Env, ufxResetIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	return core.PlanOutcome{StateHash: h.s.hash()}, nil
}

func (h ufxResetHandler) Apply(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in ufxResetIn) (ufxResetOut, error) {
	h.s.set(in.ID, "reset")
	return ufxResetOut{}, nil
}

func (h ufxResetHandler) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, ufxResetIn, ufxResetOut) error { return nil }

type ufxModule struct{ s *ufxStore }

func (m ufxModule) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	return core.Manifest{ID: "ufx", Version: 1, Actions: []core.ActionDef{
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refUfx.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: []string{ufxKey},
		}, ufxHandler{m.s}),
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refUfxReset.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent,
			LockKeys: []string{ufxKey}, ForwardOnly: true, Converges: true,
		}, ufxResetHandler{m.s}),
	}}
}

type ufxFixture struct {
	*fixture
	store *ufxStore
}

// newUfx returns an agent engine whose registry holds only the ufx module.
func newUfx(t *testing.T) *ufxFixture {
	t.Helper()
	s := newUfxStore()
	reg, err := core.NewRegistry(ufxModule{s})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f := &fixture{
		t: t, reg: reg, path: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "agent.db"),
		clock: coretest.NewFakeClock(time.Date(2026, 10, 17, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)),
	}
	f.open()
	return &ufxFixture{fixture: f, store: s}
}

// change plans and applies ops as alice and returns the completed change.
func (u *ufxFixture) change(ops ...ufxOp) core.ChangeView {
	u.t.Helper()
	in, err := json.Marshal(ufxIn{Ops: ops})
	if err != nil {
		u.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	v := u.apply(alice, u.plan(alice, refUfx, string(in)).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	if v.State != core.StateCompleted {
		u.t.Fatalf("change = %+v, want completed", v)
	}
	return v
}

// sqlExec runs one statement, for tests that shape a change the way a crash
// or another mechanism would have left it.
func (f *fixture) sqlExec(query string, args ...any) {
	f.t.Helper()
	err := f.db.Write(context.Background(), func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		_, err := tx.Exec(query, args...)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatalf("%s: %v", query, err)
	}
}

// setNeedsRepair puts a change in needs_repair, unowned and holding the
// locks of keys, as a failed change that kept its locks is.
func (f *fixture) setNeedsRepair(changeID string, keys ...string) {
	f.t.Helper()
	f.sqlExec(`UPDATE core_changes SET state = ?, recovery_owner = '', error_code = ?, error_message = 'set by the test'
		WHERE id = ?`, core.StateNeedsRepair, string(errcode.NeedsRepair), changeID)
	for _, k := range keys {
		f.sqlExec(`INSERT INTO core_locks (key, owner) VALUES (?, ?)
			ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET owner = excluded.owner`, k, changeID)
	}
}

// setEffectState moves effect seq of a change to state with reason,
// bypassing the engine's transition rules.
func (f *fixture) setEffectState(changeID string, seq int, state core.EffectState, reason string) {
	f.t.Helper()
	f.sqlExec("UPDATE core_effects SET state = ?, reason = ? WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = ?",
		string(state), reason, changeID, seq)
}

// putEffect inserts effect seq of a change in state with reason, for a
// journal shape no handler made.
func (f *fixture) putEffect(changeID string, seq int, state core.EffectState, reason string) {
	f.t.Helper()
	now := formatTime(f.clock.Now())
	f.sqlExec(`INSERT INTO core_effects (change_id, seq, kind, resource, local, inverse_local, before_json, state,
		reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'modify', ?, 1, 1, '{"state":null}', ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
		changeID, seq, fmt.Sprintf("test.item:%d", seq), string(state), reason, now, now)
}

// journalEffect reads effect seq of a change.
func (f *fixture) journalEffect(changeID string, seq int) core.Effect {
	f.t.Helper()
	effs, err := loadEffects(context.Background(), f.db.Read(), changeID)
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, e := range effs {
		if e.Seq == seq {
			return e
		}
	}
	f.t.Fatalf("change %s has no effect %d", changeID, seq)
	return core.Effect{}
}

// settled waits until a change has left undoing: an undo records its
// outcome on its own goroutine.
func (f *fixture) settled(changeID string) core.ChangeView {
	f.t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for {
		v, err := f.eng.Change(context.Background(), changeID)
		if err != nil {
			f.t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if v.State != core.StateUndoing {
			return v
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			f.t.Fatalf("change %s is still undoing", changeID)
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// wantRefusal fails unless err carries code and its detail contains part.
func wantRefusal(t *testing.T, err error, code errcode.Code, part string) {
	t.Helper()
	wantCode(t, err, code)
	if d := errcode.From(err).Detail; !strings.Contains(d, part) {
		t.Fatalf("detail = %q, want it to contain %q", d, part)
	}
}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

func TestUndoUndoesTheLastChangesNewestFirst(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUfx(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	first := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "1"})
	second := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2"}, ufxOp{ID: "b", Value: "x"})

	_, err := u.eng.Undo(ctx, bob, first.ID, nil)
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.UndoConflict, "lock ufx was taken by a later change")

	v, err := u.eng.Undo(ctx, bob, second.ID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v.State != core.StateUndoing || v.Owner != core.OwnerUndo {
		t.Fatalf("undo answered %s owned by %q, want undoing owned by undo", v.State, v.Owner)
	}
	if v = u.settled(second.ID); v.State != core.StateReverted || v.Owner != "" {
		t.Fatalf("after the undo: %s owned by %q, want reverted and unowned", v.State, v.Owner)
	}
	for seq := 1; seq <= 2; seq++ {
		if s := u.journalEffect(second.ID, seq).State; s != core.EffectUndone {
			t.Errorf("effect %d is %s, want undone", seq, s)
		}
	}
	if got, ok := u.store.get("a"); !ok || got != "1" {
		t.Errorf("object a = %q (present %v), want 1", got, ok)
	}
	if _, ok := u.store.get("b"); ok {
		t.Error("object b is still there")
	}

	if _, err := u.eng.Undo(ctx, bob, first.ID, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("undo of the first change once the second was undone: %v", err)
	}
	if v = u.settled(first.ID); v.State != core.StateReverted {
		t.Fatalf("first change = %s, want reverted", v.State)
	}
	if _, ok := u.store.get("a"); ok {
		t.Error("object a is still there")
	}
	if n := u.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_locks"); n != 0 {
		t.Errorf("locks = %d, want none", n)
	}
	if n := u.count("SELECT coalesce(max(epoch), 0) FROM core_lock_epochs WHERE key = ?", ufxKey); n != 0 {
		t.Errorf("epoch of %s = %d, want 0 once both changes gave theirs back", ufxKey, n)
	}
	want := []string{"apply/ok", "apply/ok", "undo/ok", "undo/ok", "undo/ok", "undo/ok"}
	if got := u.phases(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("journal = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}

	v, err = u.eng.Undo(ctx, bob, second.ID, nil)
	if err != nil || v.State != core.StateReverted {
		t.Fatalf("a repeated undo = %s, %v; want the reverted change", v.State, err)
	}
	if n := len(u.phases()); n != len(want) {
		t.Errorf("a repeated undo journaled %d entries", n-len(want))
	}
}

func TestUndoStopsAtAConflict(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUfx(t)
	c := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "1"}, ufxOp{ID: "b", Value: "1"})
	u.store.set("b", "changed")
	if _, err := u.eng.Undo(context.Background(), bob, c.ID, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	v := u.settled(c.ID)
	if v.State != core.StateNeedsRepair || v.Error == nil || v.Error.Code != string(errcode.NeedsRepair) {
		t.Fatalf("change = %s with error %+v, want needs_repair with core.needs_repair", v.State, v.Error)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(v.Error.Message, "effect 2") {
		t.Errorf("message %q does not name effect 2", v.Error.Message)
	}
	b := u.journalEffect(c.ID, 2)
	if b.State != core.EffectUnresolved || b.Reason != core.ReasonConflict || b.Current == nil ||
		!strings.Contains(string(b.Current.State), "changed") {
		t.Errorf("effect 2 = %s (%s), current %v; want unresolved conflict observing the changed value", b.State, b.Reason, b.Current)
	}
	if s := u.journalEffect(c.ID, 1).State; s != core.EffectMade {
		t.Errorf("effect 1 = %s, want made: an earlier effect is never undone past a conflict", s)
	}
	if got, _ := u.store.get("a"); got != "1" {
		t.Errorf("object a = %q, want 1", got)
	}
	if n := u.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_locks WHERE owner = ?", c.ID); n != 1 {
		t.Errorf("locks held by the change = %d, want 1: needs_repair keeps them", n)
	}
	if got := u.phases(); got[len(got)-1] != "undo/error/core.needs_repair" {
		t.Errorf("journal = %v, want it to end with undo/error/core.needs_repair", got)
	}
}

func TestUndoStopsAtAnAcceptedEffect(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUfx(t)
	c := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "1"}, ufxOp{ID: "b", Value: "1"}, ufxOp{ID: "d", Value: "1"})
	u.sqlExec(`UPDATE core_effects SET state = ?, resolution = ?, current_json = post_json
		WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = 2`, string(core.EffectAccepted), core.ResolutionAccept, c.ID)
	if _, err := u.eng.Undo(context.Background(), bob, c.ID, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v := u.settled(c.ID); v.State != core.StateKept {
		t.Fatalf("change = %s, want kept", v.State)
	}
	want := map[int]core.EffectState{1: core.EffectMade, 2: core.EffectAccepted, 3: core.EffectUndone}
	for seq, s := range want {
		if got := u.journalEffect(c.ID, seq).State; got != s {
			t.Errorf("effect %d = %s, want %s", seq, got, s)
		}
	}
	if _, ok := u.store.get("d"); ok {
		t.Error("object d, the newest effect, was not undone")
	}
	if got, _ := u.store.get("a"); got != "1" {
		t.Errorf("object a = %q, want 1: effects before the accepted one stay", got)
	}
	if n := u.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_locks"); n != 0 {
		t.Errorf("locks = %d, want none: kept releases them", n)
	}
	if n := u.count("SELECT coalesce(max(epoch), 0) FROM core_lock_epochs WHERE key = ?", ufxKey); n != 1 {
		t.Errorf("epoch = %d, want 1: a kept change gives nothing back", n)
	}
}

func TestUndoInverseOutcomes(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		before string // the object's value before the change; "" when absent
		op     ufxOp
		mode   string
		state  core.EffectState
		reason string
		change string
		value  string // the object's value after the undo; "" when absent
	}{
		{"a local inverse", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2"}, "", core.EffectUndone, "", core.StateReverted, "1"},
		{"an inverse that recreates a deleted object", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a"}, "", core.EffectUndone, "", core.StateReverted, "1"},
		{"the undo of a creation", "", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2"}, "", core.EffectUndone, "", core.StateReverted, ""},
		{"a definite refusal", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2"}, "definite", core.EffectMade, "", core.StateNeedsRepair, "2"},
		{"a local inverse failing before its write", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2"}, "fail", core.EffectMade, "", core.StateNeedsRepair, "2"},
		{"a local inverse failing after its write", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2"}, "fail-after-write",
			core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonAmbiguous, core.StateNeedsRepair, "1"},
		{"an inverse that changed nothing", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2"}, "noop",
			core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonConflict, core.StateNeedsRepair, "2"},
		{"a remote inverse failing", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2", InverseRemote: true}, "fail",
			core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonUncertain, core.StateNeedsRepair, "2"},
		{"a remote inverse refused definitely", "1", ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2", InverseRemote: true}, "definite",
			core.EffectMade, "", core.StateNeedsRepair, "2"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			u := newUfx(t)
			if tc.before != "" {
				u.store.set("a", tc.before)
			}
			c := u.change(tc.op)
			u.store.inverse["a"] = tc.mode
			u.clock.Advance(time.Minute)
			if _, err := u.eng.Undo(context.Background(), bob, c.ID, nil); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			v := u.settled(c.ID)
			eff := u.journalEffect(c.ID, 1)
			if eff.State != tc.state || eff.Reason != tc.reason || v.State != tc.change {
				t.Fatalf("effect %s (%q), change %s; want effect %s (%q), change %s",
					eff.State, eff.Reason, v.State, tc.state, tc.reason, tc.change)
			}
			got, ok := u.store.get("a")
			if got != tc.value || ok != (tc.value != "") {
				t.Errorf("object a = %q (present %v), want %q", got, ok, tc.value)
			}
			if tc.op.Value == "" && eff.UndoResource != "ufx.item:a" {
				t.Errorf("UndoResource = %q, want the recreated object ufx.item:a", eff.UndoResource)
			}
			if tc.op.InverseRemote && tc.state == core.EffectUnresolved &&
				!eff.CommitBy.Equal(u.clock.Now().Add(2*time.Minute)) {
				t.Errorf("CommitBy = %v, want the inverse's start plus CommitWait", eff.CommitBy)
			}
			wantLocks := 0
			if tc.change == core.StateNeedsRepair {
				wantLocks = 1
				if v.Error == nil || v.Error.Code != string(errcode.NeedsRepair) {
					t.Errorf("error = %+v, want core.needs_repair", v.Error)
				}
			}
			if n := u.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_locks WHERE owner = ?", c.ID); n != wantLocks {
				t.Errorf("locks held = %d, want %d", n, wantLocks)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestUndoResumesAnInterruptedInverse(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name          string
		inverseRemote bool
		found         string // the object's value at the restart; "" leaves it as the change made it
		state         core.EffectState
		reason        string
		change        string
		value         string
	}{
		{"the inverse had finished", false, "1", core.EffectUndone, "", core.StateReverted, "1"},
		{"the inverse had not run", false, "", core.EffectUndone, "", core.StateReverted, "1"},
		{"the object changed since", false, "9", core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonAmbiguous, core.StateNeedsRepair, "9"},
		{"a remote inverse", true, "1", core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonUncertain, core.StateNeedsRepair, "1"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			u := newUfx(t)
			u.store.set("a", "1")
			c := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "2", InverseRemote: tc.inverseRemote})
			// The process died while the inverse ran: the effect is undoing
			// and the change kept its locks.
			u.sqlExec(`UPDATE core_effects SET state = ?, undo_to_json = '{"state":{"value":"1"}}'
				WHERE change_id = ? AND seq = 1`, string(core.EffectUndoing), c.ID)
			u.setNeedsRepair(c.ID, ufxKey)
			if tc.found != "" {
				u.store.set("a", tc.found)
			}
			u.restart()
			u.recoverAll()
			if _, err := u.eng.Undo(context.Background(), bob, c.ID, nil); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			v := u.settled(c.ID)
			eff := u.journalEffect(c.ID, 1)
			if eff.State != tc.state || eff.Reason != tc.reason || v.State != tc.change {
				t.Fatalf("effect %s (%q), change %s; want effect %s (%q), change %s",
					eff.State, eff.Reason, v.State, tc.state, tc.reason, tc.change)
			}
			if got, _ := u.store.get("a"); got != tc.value {
				t.Errorf("object a = %q, want %q", got, tc.value)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestUndoRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name  string
		setup func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView)
		code  errcode.Code
		part  string
	}{
		{"an unresolved effect", func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.setNeedsRepair(c.ID, ufxKey)
			u.setEffectState(c.ID, 1, core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonUncertain)
		}, errcode.NeedsRepair, "resolve its effects first"},
		{"a recovery handler that has not finished", func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.setNeedsRepair(c.ID, ufxKey)
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_retry = 1 WHERE id = ?", c.ID)
		}, errcode.NeedsRepair, "repair it: its recovery handler has not finished"},
		{"an owned change", func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_owner = ? WHERE id = ?", core.OwnerResolve, c.ID)
		}, errcode.ChangeBusy, "owned by resolve"},
		{"a step of a composite", func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET parent_change_id = 'COMPOSITE1' WHERE id = ?", c.ID)
		}, errcode.ChangeBusy, "COMPOSITE1"},
		{"a repair change", func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec(`UPDATE core_plans SET repairs = 'TARGET1'
				WHERE id = (SELECT plan_id FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?)`, c.ID)
		}, errcode.ChangeBusy, "TARGET1"},
		{"an abandoned change", func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET state = ? WHERE id = ?", core.StateAbandoned, c.ID)
		}, errcode.ChangeNotPending, "abandoned"},
		{"a lock another owner holds", func(u *ufxFixture, _ core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("INSERT INTO core_locks (key, owner) VALUES (?, 'someone')", ufxKey)
		}, errcode.LockHeld, "someone"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			u := newUfx(t)
			c := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "1"})
			tc.setup(u, c)
			before := u.state(c.ID)
			_, err := u.eng.Undo(context.Background(), bob, c.ID, nil)
			wantRefusal(t, err, tc.code, tc.part)
			if s := u.state(c.ID); s != before {
				t.Errorf("state = %s after the refusal, want %s", s, before)
			}
			if got, _ := u.store.get("a"); got != "1" {
				t.Errorf("object a = %q, want 1", got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestUndoRefusesWhatItCannotUndo(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUfx(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	reset := u.apply(alice, u.plan(alice, refUfxReset, `{"id":"a"}`).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	_, err := u.eng.Undo(ctx, bob, reset.ID, nil)
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.ChangeNotPending, "no undo handler")
	_, err = u.eng.Undo(ctx, bob, "NOPE", nil)
	wantCode(t, err, errcode.ChangeNotFound)
}
```

Create `internal/core/lifecycle/undo.go`:

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

const phaseUndo = "undo"

// changeFacts is what the operator routes (undo, resolve, release and
// repair) check before they act on a change.
type changeFacts struct {
	id, planID, action, state, owner string
	parent                           string // the composite this change is a step of; "" for a top-level change
	repairs                          string // the change this repair change repairs; "" otherwise
	class                            core.Class
	version                          int
	retry                            bool
}

func (f changeFacts) ref() core.ActionRef { return core.ActionRef{Name: f.action, Version: f.version} }

// loadFacts reads a change together with its plan's repairs column. A
// missing change is change.not_found.
func loadFacts(ctx context.Context, q queryer, changeID string) (changeFacts, error) {
	f := changeFacts{id: changeID}
	var class string
	var parent, repairs sql.NullString
	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx,
		`SELECT c.plan_id, c.action, c.version, c.class, c.state, c.recovery_owner, c.parent_change_id,
		 c.recovery_retry, p.repairs
		 FROM core_changes c JOIN core_plans p ON p.id = c.plan_id WHERE c.id = ?`, changeID).
		Scan(&f.planID, &f.action, &f.version, &class, &f.state, &f.owner, &parent, &f.retry, &repairs)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return f, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("no change %s", changeID))
	case err != nil:
		return f, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read change %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	f.class, f.parent, f.repairs = core.Class(class), parent.String, repairs.String
	return f, nil
}

// unresolvedCount counts the unresolved effects of a change and, with
// repairs set, those of its failed repair changes too.
func unresolvedCount(ctx context.Context, q queryer, changeID string, repairs bool) (int, error) {
	query := "SELECT count(*) FROM core_effects WHERE state = ? AND (change_id = ?"
	args := []any{string(core.EffectUnresolved), changeID}
	if repairs {
		query += ` OR change_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM core_changes c JOIN core_plans p ON p.id = c.plan_id
		 WHERE p.repairs = ? AND c.state = ?)`
		args = append(args, changeID, core.StateFailed)
	}
	query += ")"
	var n int
	if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, query, args...).Scan(&n); err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: count unresolved effects of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	return n, nil
}

// journalChange appends a journal entry for a change inside tx. The entry
// carries input when it is set, and the change's stored redacted input
// otherwise.
func (e *Engine) journalChange(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, now time.Time, changeID string, p core.Principal,
	phase, result, errCode string, input json.RawMessage) error {
	var action, stored string
	var version int
	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT action, version, input_json FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", changeID).
		Scan(&action, &version, &stored); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read change %s for the journal: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	if input == nil {
		input = json.RawMessage(stored)
	}
	return e.cfg.Journal.Append(ctx, tx, core.JournalEntry{
		At: now, Actor: p.Actor, Action: action, Version: version, Phase: phase, ChangeID: changeID,
		Input: input, Result: result, ErrorCode: errCode, Source: p.Source,
	})
}

// observeCall runs the action's Observe for one effect under the action's
// ApplyTimeout.
func (e *Engine) observeCall(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, def core.ActionDef, eff core.Effect) (core.Observation, error) {
	if def.Handler.Observe == nil {
		return core.Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s has no Observe handler", def.Ref())
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, e.applyTimeout(def))
	defer cancel()
	var obs core.Observation
	err := e.protect(def.Ref(), "Observe", func() error {
		var err error
		obs, err = def.Handler.Observe(ctx, env, eff)
		return err
	})
	return obs, err
}

// inverseCall runs the action's Inverse for one effect under the action's
// ApplyTimeout.
func (e *Engine) inverseCall(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, def core.ActionDef, eff core.Effect) (core.InverseResult, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, e.applyTimeout(def))
	defer cancel()
	var res core.InverseResult
	err := e.protect(def.Ref(), "Inverse", func() error {
		var err error
		res, err = def.Handler.Inverse(ctx, env, eff)
		return err
	})
	return res, err
}

// Undo undoes a compensable change from its effects journal, newest effect
// first (spec 1.2, Undo of a change). It answers the change in undoing as
// soon as the claim is committed and runs the undo on its own goroutine; a
// change already reverted is answered as it is. call is set only when a
// composite undoes its own step.
func (e *Engine) Undo(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	e.applyMu.Lock()
	v, def, started, err := e.claimUndo(ctx, p, changeID, call)
	e.applyMu.Unlock()
	if err != nil || !started {
		return v, err
	}
	e.goRun(func() { e.finishUndo(p, def, changeID) })
	return v, nil
}

// claimUndo is the claim of spec 1.2: the checks, the locks without a new
// epoch (a needs_repair change still holds them), state undoing with owner
// undo, and the journal entry, in one transaction. started is false when
// the change was already reverted.
func (e *Engine) claimUndo(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ChangeView, core.ActionDef, bool, error) {
	var v core.ChangeView
	var def core.ActionDef
	started := false
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		f, err := loadFacts(ctx, tx, changeID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if def, err = e.action(f.ref()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := undoRefusal(ctx, tx, f, def, call); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if f.state != core.StateReverted {
			key, err := windowOpen(ctx, tx, changeID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if key != "" {
				return errcode.New(errcode.UndoConflict, fmt.Sprintf("lock %s was taken by a later change", key))
			}
			if _, err := takeLocks(ctx, tx, changeID, def.Spec.LockKeys, false); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			now := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()
			if err := claim(ctx, tx, now, changeID, "", core.OwnerUndo, f.state, core.StateUndoing); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := e.journalChange(ctx, tx, now, changeID, p, phaseUndo, resultOK, "", nil); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			started = true
		}
		v, err = scanChange(tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT "+changeColumns+" FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", changeID))
		return err
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	if err != nil && !errors.As(err, &coded) {
		err = fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: undo %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	return v, def, started && err == nil, err
}

// undoRefusal applies the eligibility rules of spec 1.2 in order. It
// answers nil for a change that may be undone and for one already
// reverted.
func undoRefusal(ctx context.Context, q queryer, f changeFacts, def core.ActionDef, call *core.CallContext) error {
	n, err := unresolvedCount(ctx, q, f.id, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	switch {
	case n > 0:
		return errcode.New(errcode.NeedsRepair,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s has an unresolved effect: resolve its effects first", f.id))
	case f.retry:
		return errcode.New(errcode.NeedsRepair,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s: repair it: its recovery handler has not finished", f.id))
	case f.owner != "":
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy, fmt.Sprintf("change %s is owned by %s", f.id, f.owner))
	case f.parent != "" && f.state != core.StateNeedsRepair && (call == nil || call.ParentChangeID != f.parent):
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s is a step of composite %s; undo or repair the composite", f.id, f.parent))
	case f.repairs != "":
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s repairs change %s; repair or release change %s", f.id, f.repairs, f.repairs))
	case f.class != core.ClassCompensable || def.Handler.Inverse == nil:
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf("change %s has no undo handler", f.id))
	}
	switch f.state {
	case core.StateReverted, core.StateCompleted, core.StateFailed, core.StateInterrupted, core.StateNeedsRepair:
		return nil
	}
	return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf(
		"change %s is %s; only a completed, failed, interrupted or needs_repair change is undone", f.id, f.state))
}

// finishUndo runs a claimed undo and records its outcome. A shutdown that
// cancels the run leaves the change undoing, and the next start resumes
// it from the journal.
func (e *Engine) finishUndo(p core.Principal, def core.ActionDef, changeID string) {
	ctx := e.runCtx
	call, err := changeCall(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), changeID)
	if err != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Error("lifecycle: undo: read the call context", "change", changeID, "error", err)
		return
	}
	runErr := e.undoRun(ctx, e.changeEnv(p, def, changeID, call), def, changeID)
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Info("lifecycle: undo stopped by shutdown; the next start resumes it", "change", changeID)
		return
	}
	if runErr != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Error("lifecycle: undo run", "change", changeID, "error", runErr)
	}
	sctx, cancel := e.cleanup()
	defer cancel()
	if _, err := e.undoSettle(sctx, p, changeID); err != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Error("lifecycle: undo settle", "change", changeID, "error", err)
	}
}

// undoRun is the run of spec 1.2: newest effect first, it stops at the
// first effect that does not end undone or skipped, so an earlier effect
// is never undone while a later one is in doubt or kept. It writes effect
// states only, each in its own committed transaction before the act it
// announces.
func (e *Engine) undoRun(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, def core.ActionDef, changeID string) error {
	effs, err := loadEffects(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read effects of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	slices.SortFunc(effs, func(a, b core.Effect) int { return b.Seq - a.Seq })
	for _, eff := range effs {
		done, err := e.undoEffect(ctx, env, def, eff)
		if err != nil || !done {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// undoEffect undoes one effect and reports whether it ended undone or
// skipped. An accepted, unresolved or abandoned effect stops the run.
func (e *Engine) undoEffect(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, def core.ActionDef, eff core.Effect) (bool, error) {
	switch eff.State {
	case core.EffectUndone, core.EffectSkipped:
		return true, nil
	case core.EffectMade:
		return e.runInverse(ctx, env, def, eff)
	case core.EffectUndoing:
		next, err := e.resumeInverse(ctx, env, def, eff)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		if err := e.writeEffect(ctx, eff, core.EffectUndoing, next); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		switch next.State {
		case core.EffectUndone:
			return true, nil
		case core.EffectMade:
			eff.State = core.EffectMade
			return e.runInverse(ctx, env, def, eff)
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

// resumeInverse decides an effect a cut-off undo left undoing. Only an
// InverseLocal inverse can be judged by observing it: a remote one may
// still commit.
func (e *Engine) resumeInverse(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, def core.ActionDef, eff core.Effect) (effectUpdate, error) {
	uncertain := effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUnresolved, Reason: core.ReasonUncertain}
	if !eff.InverseLocal {
		return uncertain, nil
	}
	obs, err := e.observeCall(ctx, env, def, eff)
	if err != nil {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return effectUpdate{}, ctx.Err()
		}
		return uncertain, nil
	}
	cur := obs.Current
	switch {
	case eff.UndoTo != nil && stateEqual(cur, *eff.UndoTo):
		return effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUndone}, nil
	case eff.Post != nil && docEqual(cur, *eff.Post):
		return effectUpdate{State: core.EffectMade}, nil
	}
	return effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUnresolved, Reason: core.ReasonAmbiguous, Current: &cur}, nil
}

// runInverse undoes one made effect and reports whether it ended undone.
func (e *Engine) runInverse(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, def core.ActionDef, eff core.Effect) (bool, error) {
	obs, err := e.observeCall(ctx, env, def, eff)
	if err != nil {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return false, ctx.Err()
		}
		// Nothing is written yet: the effect stays made, the change goes to
		// needs_repair, and the operator can run the undo again.
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: undo could not observe an effect",
			"change", eff.ChangeID, "seq", eff.Seq, "error", err)
		return false, nil
	}
	if eff.Post == nil || !docEqual(obs.Current, *eff.Post) {
		cur := obs.Current
		return false, e.writeEffect(ctx, eff, core.EffectMade,
			effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUnresolved, Reason: core.ReasonConflict, Current: &cur})
	}
	to := undoTo(eff)
	u := effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUndoing, UndoTo: &to}
	if !eff.InverseLocal {
		by := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now().Add(eff.CommitWait)
		u.CommitBy = &by
	}
	if err := e.writeEffect(ctx, eff, core.EffectMade, u); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	eff.State, eff.UndoTo = core.EffectUndoing, &to
	res, invErr := e.inverseCall(ctx, env, def, eff)
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return false, ctx.Err()
	}
	if invErr != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: an inverse failed", "change", eff.ChangeID, "seq", eff.Seq, "error", invErr)
	}
	next, err := e.afterInverse(ctx, env, def, eff, res, invErr)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return next.State == core.EffectUndone, e.writeEffect(ctx, eff, core.EffectUndoing, next)
}

// afterInverse maps an inverse's result to the effect's next state (the
// undoing rows of spec 1.2's effect state table). It errs only when the
// run is being shut down.
func (e *Engine) afterInverse(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, def core.ActionDef, eff core.Effect,
	res core.InverseResult, invErr error) (effectUpdate, error) {
	uncertain := effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUnresolved, Reason: core.ReasonUncertain}
	switch {
	case invErr != nil && core.IsDefinite(invErr):
		return effectUpdate{State: core.EffectMade}, nil
	case invErr != nil && !eff.InverseLocal:
		return uncertain, nil
	}
	if res.Resource != "" {
		eff.UndoResource = res.Resource
	}
	next := uncertain
	obs, err := e.observeCall(ctx, env, def, eff)
	switch {
	case err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil:
		return effectUpdate{}, ctx.Err()
	case err != nil:
	case invErr == nil && stateEqual(obs.Current, *eff.UndoTo):
		next = effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUndone}
	case invErr == nil:
		cur := obs.Current
		next = effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUnresolved, Reason: core.ReasonConflict, Current: &cur}
	case eff.Post != nil && docEqual(obs.Current, *eff.Post):
		next = effectUpdate{State: core.EffectMade}
	default:
		cur := obs.Current
		next = effectUpdate{State: core.EffectUnresolved, Reason: core.ReasonAmbiguous, Current: &cur}
	}
	if res.Resource != "" {
		r := res.Resource
		next.UndoResource = &r
	}
	return next, nil
}

// writeEffect commits one effect transition from the state from.
func (e *Engine) writeEffect(ctx context.Context, eff core.Effect, from core.EffectState, u effectUpdate) error {
	return e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		return setEffect(ctx, tx, e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now(), eff.ChangeID, eff.Seq, []core.EffectState{from}, u)
	})
}

// undoSettle records an undo run's outcome in one transaction and clears
// the owner (spec 1.2, Settle): reverted when every effect is undone or
// skipped, kept when the run stopped at an accepted effect after undoing
// every later one, and needs_repair, with the locks kept, otherwise.
func (e *Engine) undoSettle(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	effs, err := loadEffects(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read effects of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	none := ""
	tr := transition{
		from: core.StateUndoing, to: core.StateReverted, release: true, giveBack: true, owner: &none,
		phase: phaseUndo, result: resultOK, actor: p.Actor, source: p.Source,
	}
	stop := undoStop(effs)
	switch {
	case stop == nil:
	case stop.State == core.EffectAccepted:
		tr.to, tr.giveBack = core.StateKept, false
	default:
		tr.to, tr.release, tr.giveBack, tr.keepLocks, tr.result = core.StateNeedsRepair, false, false, true, resultError
		tr.err = &core.ChangeError{Code: string(errcode.NeedsRepair), Message: undoStopMessage(effs, *stop)}
	}
	return e.transition(ctx, changeID, tr)
}

// undoStop is the newest effect that is neither undone nor skipped, or nil
// when the undo left none.
func undoStop(effs []core.Effect) *core.Effect {
	var stop *core.Effect
	for i := range effs {
		s := effs[i].State
		if s != core.EffectUndone && s != core.EffectSkipped && (stop == nil || effs[i].Seq > stop.Seq) {
			stop = &effs[i]
		}
	}
	return stop
}

// undoStopMessage names where an undo stopped and every effect left
// unresolved.
func undoStopMessage(effs []core.Effect, stop core.Effect) string {
	msg := fmt.Sprintf("the undo stopped at effect %d (%s), which is %s", stop.Seq, stop.Resource, stop.State)
	var unresolved []string
	for _, eff := range effs {
		if eff.State == core.EffectUnresolved {
			unresolved = append(unresolved, fmt.Sprintf("%d %s (%s)", eff.Seq, eff.Resource, eff.Reason))
		}
	}
	if len(unresolved) > 0 {
		msg += "; unresolved effects: " + strings.Join(unresolved, ", ")
	}
	return msg
}
```

Create `internal/core/lifecycle/resolve.go`:

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

const phaseResolve = "resolve"

// effectOf reads one effect of a change; a missing one is not_found.
func effectOf(ctx context.Context, q queryer, changeID string, seq int) (core.Effect, error) {
	effs, err := loadEffects(ctx, q, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.Effect{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read effects of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	for _, eff := range effs {
		if eff.Seq == seq {
			return eff, nil
		}
	}
	return core.Effect{}, errcode.New(errcode.NotFound, fmt.Sprintf("change %s has no effect %d", changeID, seq))
}

// allowedResolutions is Observation.Allowed, or both resolutions when the
// module allows every one.
func allowedResolutions(obs core.Observation) []string {
	if obs.Allowed == nil {
		return []string{core.ResolutionAccept, core.ResolutionReconcile}
	}
	return slices.Clone(obs.Allowed)
}

// Observe previews an effect for its resolution (spec 1.2, Resolving an
// unresolved effect): it calls the action's Observe and answers the
// effect, the observation and the resolutions the module allows. It
// changes nothing.
func (e *Engine) Observe(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int) (core.ObserveResult, error) {
	q := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read()
	f, err := loadFacts(ctx, q, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ObserveResult{}, err
	}
	def, err := e.action(f.ref())
	if err != nil {
		return core.ObserveResult{}, err
	}
	eff, err := effectOf(ctx, q, changeID, seq)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ObserveResult{}, err
	}
	call, err := changeCall(ctx, q, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ObserveResult{}, err
	}
	obs, err := e.observeCall(ctx, e.changeEnv(p, def, changeID, call), def, eff)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ObserveResult{}, err
	}
	return core.ObserveResult{
		Effect: effectView(eff),
		Observation: core.ObservationView{
			Current: obs.Current, Resource: obs.Resource, Matches: obs.Matches,
			Candidates: nonNil(obs.Candidates), Exclusive: obs.Exclusive,
		},
		Allowed: allowedResolutions(obs),
	}, nil
}

// Resolve records the operator's resolution of an unresolved effect. It
// claims owner resolve on the change that holds the locks (the change, or
// the target of a failed repair change), observes the effect, and records
// the outcome, the module's Resolved bookkeeping, the journal entry and the
// end of the claim in one transaction. A resolution never writes to the
// host.
func (e *Engine) Resolve(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int, req core.ResolveRequest) (core.EffectView, error) {
	if req.Resolution != core.ResolutionAccept && req.Resolution != core.ResolutionReconcile {
		return core.EffectView{}, &errcode.Error{
			Code: errcode.InvalidInput, Detail: "a resolution is accept or reconcile",
			Fields: []errcode.FieldError{{Path: "/resolution", Message: "must be accept or reconcile"}},
		}
	}
	e.applyMu.Lock()
	holder, def, eff, err := e.claimResolve(ctx, changeID, seq)
	e.applyMu.Unlock()
	if err != nil {
		return core.EffectView{}, err
	}
	// The claim is committed: whatever happens to the request, the claim
	// must end in a recorded outcome or a released owner.
	ctx = context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
	v, err := e.recordResolution(ctx, p, holder, def, eff, req)
	if err != nil {
		e.endResolveClaim(holder)
		return core.EffectView{}, err
	}
	return v, nil
}

// claimResolve checks that the effect may be resolved now and claims owner
// resolve on the change that holds the locks, in one transaction.
func (e *Engine) claimResolve(ctx context.Context, changeID string, seq int) (changeFacts, core.ActionDef, core.Effect, error) {
	var holder changeFacts
	var def core.ActionDef
	var eff core.Effect
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		f, err := loadFacts(ctx, tx, changeID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if def, err = e.action(f.ref()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if eff, err = effectOf(ctx, tx, changeID, seq); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if eff.State != core.EffectUnresolved {
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending,
				fmt.Sprintf("effect %d of change %s is %s, not unresolved", seq, changeID, eff.State))
		}
		holder = f
		switch {
		case f.state == core.StateNeedsRepair:
		case f.state == core.StateFailed && f.repairs != "":
			if holder, err = loadFacts(ctx, tx, f.repairs); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if holder.state != core.StateNeedsRepair {
				return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf(
					"change %s repairs change %s, which is %s, not needs_repair", changeID, holder.id, holder.state))
			}
		default:
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf(
				"change %s is %s; only the effects of a change in needs_repair are resolved", changeID, f.state))
		}
		now := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()
		if now.Before(eff.CommitBy) {
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy, fmt.Sprintf(
				"the call may still commit until %s", eff.CommitBy.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)))
		}
		return claim(ctx, tx, now, holder.id, "", core.OwnerResolve, holder.state, holder.state)
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	if err != nil && !errors.As(err, &coded) {
		err = fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: claim the resolution of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	return holder, def, eff, err
}

// recordResolution observes the effect and records the resolution's
// outcome. Any error rolls the record back; the caller then ends the
// claim.
func (e *Engine) recordResolution(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, holder changeFacts, def core.ActionDef,
	eff core.Effect, req core.ResolveRequest) (core.EffectView, error) {
	call, err := changeCall(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), eff.ChangeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.EffectView{}, err
	}
	obs, err := e.observeCall(ctx, e.changeEnv(p, def, eff.ChangeID, call), def, eff)
	if err != nil {
		return core.EffectView{}, err
	}
	u, err := resolution(eff, obs, req)
	if err != nil {
		return core.EffectView{}, err
	}
	now := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()
	u.Resolution, u.ResolvedBy, u.ResolvedAt = req.Resolution, p.Actor, &now
	entry, err := json.Marshal(resolveEntry{Seq: eff.Seq, Resolution: req.Resolution, Resource: req.Resource})
	if err != nil {
		return core.EffectView{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: encode the resolution: %w", err)
	}
	var v core.EffectView
	err = e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		if err := setEffect(ctx, tx, now, eff.ChangeID, eff.Seq, []core.EffectState{core.EffectUnresolved}, u); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		after, err := effectOf(ctx, tx, eff.ChangeID, eff.Seq)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if def.Handler.Resolved != nil {
			if err := e.protect(def.Ref(), "Resolved", func() error {
				return def.Handler.Resolved(ctx, tx, after, req.Resolution)
			}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if err := e.journalChange(ctx, tx, now, eff.ChangeID, p, phaseResolve, resultOK, "", entry); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := claim(ctx, tx, now, holder.id, core.OwnerResolve, "", holder.state, holder.state); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		v = effectView(after)
		return nil
	})
	return v, err
}

// resolveEntry is the journal input of a resolution.
type resolveEntry struct {
	Seq        int    `json:"seq"`
	Resolution string `json:"resolution"`
	Resource   string `json:"resource,omitempty"`
}

// resolution is the outcome table of spec 1.2: accept keeps what is there;
// reconcile skips an effect whose object is back in its undo state, and
// otherwise records what is there as made, after the operator picked one
// of several candidates.
func resolution(eff core.Effect, obs core.Observation, req core.ResolveRequest) (effectUpdate, error) {
	allowed := allowedResolutions(obs)
	if !slices.Contains(allowed, req.Resolution) {
		return effectUpdate{}, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput, fmt.Sprintf(
			"resolution %s is not allowed for effect %d; allowed: %s", req.Resolution, eff.Seq, strings.Join(allowed, ", ")))
	}
	cur := obs.Current
	if req.Resolution == core.ResolutionAccept {
		return effectUpdate{State: core.EffectAccepted, Current: &cur}, nil
	}
	if stateEqual(cur, undoTo(eff)) {
		return effectUpdate{State: core.EffectSkipped}, nil
	}
	resource, post := obs.Resource, obs.Current
	switch {
	case eff.Kind == core.EffectCreate && obs.Matches > 1:
		i := slices.IndexFunc(obs.Candidates, func(c core.Candidate) bool { return c.Resource == req.Resource })
		if req.Resource == "" || i < 0 {
			return effectUpdate{}, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput, fmt.Sprintf(
				"the identity matches %d objects; name one of the candidates as the resource", obs.Matches))
		}
		resource, post = obs.Candidates[i].Resource, obs.Candidates[i].State
	case req.Resource != "" && req.Resource != obs.Resource:
		return effectUpdate{}, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput,
			fmt.Sprintf("resource %s is not the observed object", req.Resource))
	}
	u := effectUpdate{State: core.EffectMade, Post: &post}
	if resource != "" {
		u.Resource = &resource
	}
	return u, nil
}

// endResolveClaim gives back a resolution's claim after a refusal or a
// failure, under the cleanup bound so a cancelled request still ends it.
func (e *Engine) endResolveClaim(holder changeFacts) {
	ctx, cancel := e.cleanup()
	defer cancel()
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		return claim(ctx, tx, e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now(), holder.id, core.OwnerResolve, "", holder.state, holder.state)
	})
	if err != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Error("lifecycle: end a resolution's claim", "change", holder.id, "error", err)
	}
}
```

```go
func TestReleaseAbandonsTheChange(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUfx(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	c := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "1"}, ufxOp{ID: "b", Value: "1"}, ufxOp{ID: "d", Value: "1"})
	u.setEffectState(c.ID, 2, core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonUncertain)
	u.setEffectState(c.ID, 3, core.EffectUndone, "")
	u.setNeedsRepair(c.ID, ufxKey)
	reason := strings.Repeat("é", maxReasonLength) // characters, not bytes, count

	res, err := u.eng.Release(ctx, bob, c.ID, reason, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if res.Change.State != core.StateAbandoned || res.Change.Owner != "" {
		t.Errorf("change = %s owned by %q, want abandoned", res.Change.State, res.Change.Owner)
	}
	var seqs []int
	for _, ev := range res.Abandoned {
		if ev.State != core.EffectAbandoned || ev.ChangeID != c.ID {
			t.Errorf("abandoned effect = %+v", ev)
		}
		seqs = append(seqs, ev.Seq)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(seqs, []int{1, 2}) {
		t.Errorf("abandoned seqs = %v, want [1 2]: the undone effect is terminal already", seqs)
	}
	want := map[int]core.EffectState{1: core.EffectAbandoned, 2: core.EffectAbandoned, 3: core.EffectUndone}
	for seq, s := range want {
		if got := u.journalEffect(c.ID, seq).State; got != s {
			t.Errorf("effect %d = %s, want %s", seq, got, s)
		}
	}
	if n := u.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_locks"); n != 0 {
		t.Errorf("locks = %d, want none", n)
	}
	e := u.lastEntry()
	if e.Phase != phaseRelease || e.Result != resultOK || e.Actor != bob.Actor || e.ChangeID != c.ID ||
		!strings.Contains(string(e.Input), `"reason":"é`) {
		t.Errorf("journal entry = %+v, want a release by bob carrying the reason", e)
	}
	journaled := len(u.phases())

	again, err := u.eng.Release(ctx, bob, c.ID, "again", nil)
	if err != nil || again.Change.State != core.StateAbandoned || again.Abandoned == nil || len(again.Abandoned) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a repeated release = %+v, %v; want the abandoned change and no effects", again, err)
	}
	if n := len(u.phases()); n != journaled {
		t.Errorf("a repeated release journaled %d entries", n-journaled)
	}
}

func TestReleaseRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		setup  func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView)

		reason string

	}{
		{name: "a repair change", setup: func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_plans SET repairs = 'TARGET1' WHERE id = (SELECT plan_id FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?)", c.ID)
		}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "release change TARGET1"},
		{name: "a step of a composite", setup: func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET parent_change_id = 'COMPOSITE1' WHERE id = ?", c.ID)
		}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "release the composite"},
		{name: "a step released by an operator with its parent's call", setup: func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET parent_change_id = 'COMPOSITE1' WHERE id = ?", c.ID)
		}, call: &core.CallContext{ParentChangeID: "COMPOSITE1"}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "release the composite"},
		{name: "an owned change", setup: func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_owner = ? WHERE id = ?", core.OwnerResolve, c.ID)
		}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "owned by resolve"},
		{name: "an owned repair change", setup: func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("DELETE FROM core_locks")
			r := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "r", Value: "1"})
			u.setNeedsRepair(c.ID, ufxKey)
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_plans SET repairs = ? WHERE id = (SELECT plan_id FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?)", c.ID, r.ID)
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_owner = ? WHERE id = ?", core.OwnerEngine, r.ID)
		}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "is owned by engine"},
		{name: "a running task unit", setup: func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec(`INSERT INTO core_task_runs (change_id, op, attempt, state, started_at)
				VALUES (?, 'apply', 1, 'running', ?)`, c.ID, formatTime(u.clock.Now()))
		}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "task unit"},
		{name: "an empty reason", reason: "-", code: errcode.InvalidInput, part: "1 to 500 characters"},
		{name: "a reason over 500 characters", reason: strings.Repeat("x", maxReasonLength+1),
			code: errcode.InvalidInput, part: "1 to 500 characters"},
		{name: "a change not in needs_repair", setup: func(u *ufxFixture, c core.ChangeView) {
			u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET state = ? WHERE id = ?", core.StateCompleted, c.ID)
		}, code: errcode.ChangeNotPending, part: "completed"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			u := newUfx(t)
			c := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "1"})
			u.setNeedsRepair(c.ID, ufxKey)
			if tc.setup != nil {
				tc.setup(u, c)
			}
			p, reason := tc.p, tc.reason
			if p.Actor == "" {
				p = bob
			}
			switch reason {
			case "":
				reason = "given up"
			case "-":
				reason = ""
			}
			before := u.state(c.ID)
			_, err := u.eng.Release(context.Background(), p, c.ID, reason, tc.call)
			wantRefusal(t, err, tc.code, tc.part)
			if s := u.state(c.ID); s != before {
				t.Errorf("state = %s after the refusal, want %s", s, before)
			}
			if s := u.journalEffect(c.ID, 1).State; s == core.EffectAbandoned {

	}
}

func TestReleaseRacesAResolution(t *testing.T) {
	u := newUfx(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	c := u.change(ufxOp{ID: "a", Value: "1"}, ufxOp{ID: "b", Value: "1"})
	u.setNeedsRepair(c.ID, ufxKey)
	u.sqlExec("UPDATE core_effects SET state = ?, reason = ?, commit_by = ? WHERE change_id = ?",
		string(core.EffectUnresolved), core.ReasonUncertain, formatTime(u.clock.Now()), c.ID)
	entered, release := make(chan struct{}, 1), make(chan struct{})
	u.store.mu.Lock()
	u.store.onObserve = func() {
		entered <- struct{}{}
		<-release
	}
	u.store.mu.Unlock()
	accept := core.ResolveRequest{Resolution: core.ResolutionAccept}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := u.eng.Resolve(ctx, bob, c.ID, 2, accept)
		done <- err
	}()
	select {
	case <-entered:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("the resolution never observed")
	}
	_, err := u.eng.Release(ctx, bob, c.ID, "given up", nil)
	wantCode(t, err, errcode.ChangeBusy)
	close(release)
	if err := <-done; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	u.store.mu.Lock()
	u.store.onObserve = nil
	u.store.mu.Unlock()

	res, err := u.eng.Release(ctx, bob, c.ID, "given up", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(res.Abandoned) != 1 || res.Abandoned[0].Seq != 1 {
		t.Errorf("abandoned = %+v, want effect 1 only: effect 2 was accepted", res.Abandoned)
	}
	_, err = u.eng.Resolve(ctx, bob, c.ID, 1, accept)
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.ChangeNotPending, "abandoned")
}
```

Create `internal/core/lifecycle/release.go`:

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

const phaseRelease = "release"

// maxReasonLength is the longest release reason, in characters (spec 1.3,
// Release).
const maxReasonLength = 500

// releaseEntry is the journal input of a release.
type releaseEntry struct {
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

// Release gives up a change in needs_repair (spec 1.3, Release). In one
// transaction it marks every non-terminal effect of the change and of its
// failed repair changes abandoned, moves the change to abandoned, releases
// its locks and journals the reason, and it answers the abandoned effects.
// A repeated release of an abandoned change answers it with none. A step
// of a composite is released only by that composite, as system:recovery
// with call naming it.
func (e *Engine) Release(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID, reason string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ReleaseResult, error) {
	res := core.ReleaseResult{Abandoned: []core.EffectView{}}
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		f, err := loadFacts(ctx, tx, changeID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := e.releaseRefusal(ctx, tx, p, f, reason, call); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		switch f.state {
		case core.StateAbandoned:
		case core.StateNeedsRepair:
			if res.Abandoned, err = e.abandon(ctx, tx, p, f, reason); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		default:
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending,
				fmt.Sprintf("change %s is %s; only a change in needs_repair is released", changeID, f.state))
		}
		res.Change, err = scanChange(tx.QueryRowContext(ctx,
			"SELECT "+changeColumns+" FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", changeID))
		return err
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &coded):
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, err
	case err != nil:
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: release %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// releaseRefusal applies the refusals of spec 1.3's Release in order.
func (e *Engine) releaseRefusal(ctx context.Context, q queryer, p core.Principal, f changeFacts, reason string,
	call *core.CallContext) error {
	switch {
	case f.repairs != "":
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s repairs change %s; release change %s", f.id, f.repairs, f.repairs))
	case f.parent != "" && (call == nil || call.ParentChangeID != f.parent || p.Actor != ActorRecovery):
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s is a step of composite %s; release the composite", f.id, f.parent))
	case f.owner != "":
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy, fmt.Sprintf("change %s is owned by %s", f.id, f.owner))
	}
	var repairID, repairOwner string
	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx,
		`SELECT c.id, c.recovery_owner FROM core_changes c JOIN core_plans p ON p.id = c.plan_id
		 WHERE p.repairs = ? AND c.recovery_owner <> '' ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1`, f.id).Scan(&repairID, &repairOwner)
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
			fmt.Sprintf("repair change %s of change %s is owned by %s", repairID, f.id, repairOwner))
	case !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the repair changes of %s: %w", f.id, err)
	}
	// Only the agent runs task units; the controller has no results table.
	if e.cfg.Side == core.SideAgent {
		var live int
		if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx,
			"SELECT count(*) FROM core_task_runs WHERE change_id = ? AND state IN ('starting', 'running')", f.id).
			Scan(&live); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the task units of %s: %w", f.id, err)
		}
		if live > 0 {
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy, fmt.Sprintf("change %s has a task unit still running", f.id))
		}
	}
	if n := utf8.RuneCountInString(reason); n < 1 || n > maxReasonLength {
		return &errcode.Error{
			Code: errcode.InvalidInput, Detail: "a release reason is 1 to 500 characters",
			Fields: []errcode.FieldError{{Path: "/reason", Message: "must be 1 to 500 characters"}},
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// abandon gives up a needs_repair change inside tx and returns the effects
// it abandoned.
func (e *Engine) abandon(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, p core.Principal, f changeFacts, reason string) ([]core.EffectView, error) {
	now := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()
	failed, err := repairChanges(ctx, tx, f.id, core.StateFailed)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	abandoned := []core.EffectView{}
	for _, id := range append([]string{f.id}, failed...) {
		effs, err := loadEffects(ctx, tx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read effects of %s: %w", id, err)
		}
		for _, eff := range effs {
			if !abandonable(eff.State) {
				continue
			}
			if err := setEffect(ctx, tx, now, id, eff.Seq, []core.EffectState{eff.State},
				effectUpdate{State: core.EffectAbandoned}); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			eff.State = core.EffectAbandoned
			abandoned = append(abandoned, effectView(eff))
		}
	}
	res, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
		"UPDATE core_changes SET state = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND state = ? AND recovery_owner = ''",
		core.StateAbandoned, formatTime(now), f.id, core.StateNeedsRepair)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	n, err := res.RowsAffected()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if n != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: change %s changed during its release", f.id)
	}
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "DELETE FROM core_locks WHERE owner = ?", f.id); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// An abandoned change is terminal, so its plan keeps only the hash (spec
	// 1.2, Sealed input).
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_plans SET input_ct = NULL WHERE id = ?", f.planID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	input, err := json.Marshal(releaseEntry{Reason: reason})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: encode the release reason: %w", err)
	}
	if err := e.journalChange(ctx, tx, now, f.id, p, phaseRelease, resultOK, "", input); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return abandoned, nil
}

// abandonable reports whether a release abandons an effect in state s: every
// state but the terminal ones (spec 1.2).
func abandonable(s core.EffectState) bool {
	switch s {
	case core.EffectSkipped, core.EffectUndone, core.EffectAccepted, core.EffectAbandoned:
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// repairChanges lists the ids of target's repair changes, oldest first; a
// non-empty state lists only those in that state.
func repairChanges(ctx context.Context, q queryer, target, state string) ([]string, error) {
	query := "SELECT c.id FROM core_changes c JOIN core_plans p ON p.id = c.plan_id WHERE p.repairs = ?"
	args := []any{target}
	if state != "" {
		query += " AND c.state = ?"
		args = append(args, state)
	}
	query += " ORDER BY c.id"
	rows, err := q.QueryContext(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: list the repair changes of %s: %w", target, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = rows.Close() }()
	var ids []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var id string
		if err := rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: list the repair changes of %s: %w", target, err)
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	return ids, rows.Err()
}

// Effects lists a change's effects, followed by those of its repair
// changes; each view carries its own change id.
func (e *Engine) Effects(ctx context.Context, changeID string) ([]core.EffectView, error) {
	q := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read()
	if _, err := loadFacts(ctx, q, changeID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	repairs, err := repairChanges(ctx, q, changeID, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := []core.EffectView{}
	for _, id := range append([]string{changeID}, repairs...) {
		effs, err := loadEffects(ctx, q, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read effects of %s: %w", id, err)
		}
		for _, eff := range effs {
			out = append(out, effectView(eff))
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// Steps lists a composite's step log in step order. Any other change, and
// every change on the agent, has none.
func (e *Engine) Steps(ctx context.Context, changeID string) ([]core.StepView, error) {
	q := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read()
	f, err := loadFacts(ctx, q, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := []core.StepView{}
	if e.cfg.Side != core.SideController || f.class != core.ClassComposite {
		return out, nil
	}
	rows, err := q.QueryContext(ctx,
		`SELECT step_id, ordinal, host_id, action, state, attempt, child_change_id, earlier_child_change_ids,
		 child_deadline, error_code, error_message
		 FROM core_composite_steps WHERE change_id = ? ORDER BY ordinal`, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read steps of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = rows.Close() }()
	for rows.Next() {
		v, err := scanStepView(rows)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read steps of %s: %w", changeID, err)
		}
		out = append(out, v)
	}
	return out, rows.Err()
}

// scanStepView reads the columns Steps selects into a StepView, which
// never carries inputs or outputs.
func scanStepView(s scanner) (core.StepView, error) {
	var v core.StepView
	var action, earlier string
	var child, deadline, code, msg sql.NullString
	if err := s.Scan(&v.ID, &v.Ordinal, &v.Host, &action, &v.State, &v.Attempt, &child, &earlier,
		&deadline, &code, &msg); err != nil {
		return v, err
	}
	if err := v.Action.UnmarshalText([]byte(action)); err != nil {
		return v, err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(earlier), &v.EarlierChildChangeIDs); err != nil {
		return v, fmt.Errorf("earlier child change ids of step %s: %w", v.ID, err)
	}
	v.EarlierChildChangeIDs = nonNil(v.EarlierChildChangeIDs)
	v.ChildChangeID = child.String
	if deadline.Valid {
		t, err := parseTime(deadline.String)
		if err != nil {
			return v, err
		}
		v.ChildDeadline = &t
	}
	if code.Valid {
		v.Error = &core.ChangeError{Code: code.String, Message: msg.String}
	}
	return v, nil
}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/coretest"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// The test module "rfx" has a revertible action repaired by its RepairedBy
// action, a converging action repaired by applying it again, and an action
// with no repair at all. Its handlers record the call context they see.

const rfxKey = "rfx"

var (
	refRfxSet      = core.ActionRef{Name: "rfx.item.set", Version: 1}      // revertible, RepairedBy rfx.item.repair
	refRfxRepair   = core.ActionRef{Name: "rfx.item.repair", Version: 1}   // compensable, forward only; reports repairOutcome
	refRfxConverge = core.ActionRef{Name: "rfx.item.converge", Version: 1} // compensable, Converges, forward only
	refRfxOnce     = core.ActionRef{Name: "rfx.item.once", Version: 1}     // compensable with a compensating action: no repair
)

type rfxHost struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	values  map[string]string
	calls   []string // "<action> <call> repairOf=<id>" for every Plan and Apply
	onApply func()   // runs at the start of the repair action's Apply, without mu held
}

func (h *rfxHost) saw(action, call string, env core.Env) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.calls = append(h.calls, fmt.Sprintf("%s %s repairOf=%s", action, call, env.Call.RepairOf))
}

func (h *rfxHost) sawCall(want string) bool {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Contains(h.calls, want)
}

func (h *rfxHost) hash() string {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	b, err := json.Marshal(h.values)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

type rfxIn struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Value string `json:"value,omitempty"`
	Fail  bool   `json:"fail,omitempty"`
}

type rfxOut struct {
	Previous string `json:"previous"`
}

type rfxSnap struct {
	Name, Value string
	Present     bool
}

type rfxRepairIn struct {
	Outcome    string `json:"outcome,omitempty"`    // "keep" reports kept; anything else restored
	Fail       bool   `json:"fail,omitempty"`       // Apply fails before any call
	FailRemote bool   `json:"failRemote,omitempty"` // Apply intends a remote call, then fails
}

type rfxRepairOut struct {
	RepairOutcome string `json:"repairOutcome"`
}

type rfxSetHandler struct{ h *rfxHost }

func (x rfxSetHandler) Plan(_ context.Context, env core.Env, _ rfxIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	x.h.saw("set", "Plan", env)
	return core.PlanOutcome{StateHash: x.h.hash()}, nil
}

func (x rfxSetHandler) Apply(_ context.Context, env core.Env, in rfxIn) (rfxOut, error) {
	x.h.saw("set", "Apply", env)
	if in.Fail {
		return rfxOut{}, errors.New("rfx: set failed")
	}
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	prev := x.h.values[in.Name]
	x.h.values[in.Name] = in.Value
	return rfxOut{Previous: prev}, nil
}

func (x rfxSetHandler) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, rfxIn, rfxOut) error { return nil }

func (x rfxSetHandler) Snapshot(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in rfxIn) ([]byte, error) {
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	v, ok := x.h.values[in.Name]
	return json.Marshal(rfxSnap{Name: in.Name, Value: v, Present: ok})
}

func (x rfxSetHandler) Revert(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, snapshot []byte) (core.RevertOutcome, error) {
	var s rfxSnap
	if err := json.Unmarshal(snapshot, &s); err != nil {
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, err
	}
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	if s.Present {
		x.h.values[s.Name] = s.Value
	} else {
		delete(x.h.values, s.Name)
	}
	return core.RevertOutcome{}, nil
}

type rfxPlainHandler struct {
	h    *rfxHost
	name string
}

func (x rfxPlainHandler) Plan(_ context.Context, env core.Env, _ rfxIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	x.h.saw(x.name, "Plan", env)
	return core.PlanOutcome{StateHash: x.h.hash()}, nil
}

func (x rfxPlainHandler) Apply(_ context.Context, env core.Env, in rfxIn) (rfxOut, error) {
	x.h.saw(x.name, "Apply", env)
	if in.Fail {
		return rfxOut{}, errors.New("rfx: " + x.name + " failed")
	}
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	prev := x.h.values[in.Name]
	x.h.values[in.Name] = in.Value
	return rfxOut{Previous: prev}, nil
}

func (x rfxPlainHandler) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, rfxIn, rfxOut) error { return nil }

type rfxRepairHandler struct{ h *rfxHost }

func (x rfxRepairHandler) Plan(_ context.Context, env core.Env, _ rfxRepairIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	x.h.saw("repair", "Plan", env)
	return core.PlanOutcome{StateHash: x.h.hash()}, nil
}

func (x rfxRepairHandler) Apply(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, in rfxRepairIn) (rfxRepairOut, error) {
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	hook := x.h.onApply
	x.h.mu.Unlock()
	if hook != nil {
		hook()
	}
	x.h.saw("repair", "Apply", env)
	switch {
	case in.Fail:
		return rfxRepairOut{}, errors.New("rfx: the repair failed")
	case in.FailRemote:
		if _, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, core.Effect{
			Kind: core.EffectModify, Resource: "rfx.item:remote", CommitWait: time.Minute,
			Before: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"value":""}`)},
		}, nil); err != nil {
			return rfxRepairOut{}, err
		}
		return rfxRepairOut{}, errors.New("rfx: the remote call failed")
	case in.Outcome == "keep":
		return rfxRepairOut{RepairOutcome: core.RepairKept}, nil
	}
	return rfxRepairOut{RepairOutcome: core.RepairRestored}, nil
}

func (x rfxRepairHandler) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, rfxRepairIn, rfxRepairOut) error {
	return nil
}

func (x rfxRepairHandler) Observe(context.Context, core.Env, core.Effect) (core.Observation, error) {
	return core.Observation{Current: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"value":""}`)}, Matches: 1, Exclusive: true}, nil
}

type rfxModule struct{ h *rfxHost }

func (m rfxModule) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	keys := []string{rfxKey}
	return core.Manifest{ID: "rfx", Version: 1, Actions: []core.ActionDef{
		core.DefineRevertible(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refRfxSet.Name, Version: 1, Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: keys, RepairedBy: refRfxRepair.Name,
		}, rfxSetHandler{m.h}),
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refRfxRepair.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: keys,
			ForwardOnly: true, Converges: true,
		}, rfxRepairHandler{m.h}),
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refRfxConverge.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: keys,
			ForwardOnly: true, Converges: true,
		}, rfxPlainHandler{m.h, "converge"}),
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refRfxOnce.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: keys,
			CompensatedBy: refRfxConverge.Name,
		}, rfxPlainHandler{m.h, "once"}),
	}}
}

func TestRepairPlansTheRepairedByAction(t *testing.T) {
	r := newRfx(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	target := r.revertibleTarget()

	res, err := r.eng.Repair(ctx, alice, target.ID, core.RepairRequest{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if res.Change != nil || res.Plan == nil || res.Plan.Action != refRfxRepair.Name || res.Plan.Version != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("repair = %+v, want a plan of %s", res, refRfxRepair)
	}
	if got := r.planRepairsOf(res.Plan.PlanID); got != target.ID {
		t.Errorf("the plan repairs %q, want %s", got, target.ID)
	}
	if want := "repair Plan repairOf=" + target.ID; !r.rh.sawCall(want) {
		t.Errorf("calls = %v, want %q", r.rh.calls, want)
	}
	if s := r.state(target.ID); s != core.StateNeedsRepair {
		t.Errorf("target = %s, want needs_repair: planning changes nothing", s)
	}

	keep, err := r.eng.Repair(ctx, alice, target.ID, core.RepairRequest{Input: json.RawMessage(`{"outcome":"keep"}`)})
	if err != nil || keep.Plan == nil || keep.Plan.PlanID == res.Plan.PlanID {
		t.Fatalf("repair with input = %+v, %v; want a new plan", keep, err)
	}
	_, err = r.eng.Repair(ctx, alice, target.ID, core.RepairRequest{Input: json.RawMessage(`{"bogus":1}`)})
	wantCode(t, err, errcode.InvalidInput)
}

func TestRepairPlansAConvergingReapply(t *testing.T) {

	}
	if got := r.planRepairsOf(res.Plan.PlanID); got != target.ID {

	if want := "converge Plan repairOf=" + target.ID; !r.rh.sawCall(want) {

	}
	_, err = r.eng.Repair(ctx, alice, target.ID, core.RepairRequest{Input: json.RawMessage(`{"name":"b"}`)})
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.InvalidInput, "without input")
}
```
