```go
			r.putEffect(target.ID, 1, core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonUncertain)
			return target.ID
		}, code: errcode.NeedsRepair, part: "resolve its effects first"},
		{name: "an unresolved effect on a failed repair change", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string {
			other := r.apply(alice, r.plan(alice, refRfxOnce, `{"name":"b"}`).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
			target := r.revertibleTarget()
			r.sqlExec("UPDATE core_plans SET repairs = ? WHERE id = (SELECT plan_id FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?)",
				target.ID, other.ID)
			r.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET state = ? WHERE id = ?", core.StateFailed, other.ID)
			r.putEffect(other.ID, 1, core.EffectUnresolved, core.ReasonUncertain)
			return target.ID
		}, code: errcode.NeedsRepair, part: "resolve its effects first"},
		{name: "a step decision on a single change", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string { return r.revertibleTarget().ID },
			req: core.RepairRequest{Step: "one", As: "reverted"}, code: errcode.InvalidInput, part: "only a composite"},
		{name: "an input naming repairs", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string { return r.revertibleTarget().ID },
			req: core.RepairRequest{Input: json.RawMessage(`{"repairs":"X"}`)}, code: errcode.InvalidInput, part: "repairs"},
		{name: "an input that is not an object", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string { return r.revertibleTarget().ID },
			req: core.RepairRequest{Input: json.RawMessage(`[1]`)}, code: errcode.InvalidInput, part: "JSON object"},
		{name: "a repair change", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string {
			target := r.revertibleTarget()
			r.sqlExec(`UPDATE core_plans SET repairs = 'TARGET1'
				WHERE id = (SELECT plan_id FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?)`, target.ID)
			return target.ID
		}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "repair change TARGET1"},
		{name: "an owned change", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string {
			target := r.revertibleTarget()
			r.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_owner = ? WHERE id = ?", core.OwnerResolve, target.ID)
			return target.ID
		}, code: errcode.ChangeBusy, part: "owned by resolve"},
		{name: "a change not in needs_repair", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string {
			return r.apply(alice, r.plan(alice, refRfxOnce, `{"name":"b"}`).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{}).ID
		}, code: errcode.ChangeNotPending, part: "completed"},
		{name: "a change with no repair", setup: func(r *rfxFixture) string {
			v := r.apply(alice, r.plan(alice, refRfxOnce, `{"name":"b"}`).PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
			r.setNeedsRepair(v.ID, rfxKey)
			return v.ID
		}, code: errcode.ChangeNotPending, part: "no repair"},
		{name: "a missing change", setup: func(*rfxFixture) string { return "NOPE" }, code: errcode.ChangeNotFound,
			part: "NOPE"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := newRfx(t)
			id := tc.setup(r)
			res, err := r.eng.Repair(ctx, alice, id, tc.req)
			wantRefusal(t, err, tc.code, tc.part)
			if res.Plan != nil || res.Change != nil {
				t.Errorf("a refused repair answered %+v", res)
			}
		})
	}
}

// refuseEmptyInput is a validator that refuses the input {} of one action.
type refuseEmptyInput struct{ name string }

func (v refuseEmptyInput) ValidateInput(def core.ActionDef, raw json.RawMessage) error {
	if def.Spec.Name == v.name && strings.TrimSpace(string(raw)) == "{}" {
		return errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput, "outcome is required")
	}
	return coretest.Validator{}.ValidateInput(def, raw)
}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// Repair repairs a change in needs_repair by the first row of spec 1.3's
// repair table that applies: an unresolved effect refuses it, an undo
// handler undoes the change, a revertible change gets a plan of its
// RepairedBy action, and a converging change without an undo handler gets
// a plan that applies it again with its stored input. A plan is applied by
// the client through the ordinary apply route.
func (e *Engine) Repair(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, req core.RepairRequest) (core.RepairResult, error) {
	q := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read()
	f, err := loadFacts(ctx, q, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	if err := repairRequestRefusal(f, req); err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	def, err := e.action(f.ref())
	if err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	switch {
	case f.repairs != "":
		return core.RepairResult{}, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s repairs change %s; repair change %s instead", changeID, f.repairs, f.repairs))
	case f.owner != "":
		return core.RepairResult{}, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy, fmt.Sprintf("change %s is owned by %s", changeID, f.owner))
	case f.state != core.StateNeedsRepair:
		return core.RepairResult{}, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s is %s; only a change in needs_repair is repaired", changeID, f.state))
	}
	n, err := unresolvedCount(ctx, q, changeID, true)
	if err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	if n > 0 {
		return core.RepairResult{}, errcode.New(errcode.NeedsRepair,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s has an unresolved effect: resolve its effects first", changeID))
	}
	h, s := def.Handler, def.Spec
	switch {
	case s.Class == core.ClassCompensable && h.Inverse != nil:
		if err := noRepairInput(req); err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		v, err := e.Undo(ctx, p, changeID, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		return core.RepairResult{Change: &v}, nil
	case s.Class == core.ClassRevertible:
		rdef, ok := repairedByDef(e.cfg.Registry, e.cfg.Side, s.RepairedBy)
		if !ok {
			return core.RepairResult{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s names RepairedBy %q, which is not registered", def.Ref(), s.RepairedBy)
		}
		input := req.Input
		if len(bytes.TrimSpace(input)) == 0 {
			input = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
		}
		v, err := e.planRepair(ctx, p, rdef, input, changeID)
		if err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		return core.RepairResult{Plan: &v}, nil
	case s.Class == core.ClassCompensable && s.Converges && h.Inverse == nil && !s.Task && h.Recover == nil:
		if err := noRepairInput(req); err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		input, err := e.storedRepairInput(ctx, q, f)
		if err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		v, err := e.planRepair(ctx, p, def, input, changeID)
		if err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		return core.RepairResult{Plan: &v}, nil
	}
	return core.RepairResult{}, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending,
		fmt.Sprintf("change %s has no repair; release it", changeID))
}

// repairRequestRefusal checks a repair request's shape: a step decision is
// for a composite, and an input is an object that never names repairs,
// which only the repair route sets.
func repairRequestRefusal(f changeFacts, req core.RepairRequest) error {
	if f.class != core.ClassComposite && (req.Step != "" || req.As != "") {
		return &errcode.Error{
			Code: errcode.InvalidInput, Detail: "a step decision repairs only a composite",
			Fields: []errcode.FieldError{{Path: "/step", Message: "only a composite has steps"}},
		}
	}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(req.Input)) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var m map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(req.Input, &m); err != nil || m == nil {
		return &errcode.Error{
			Code: errcode.InvalidInput, Detail: "a repair input is a JSON object",
			Fields: []errcode.FieldError{{Path: "/input", Message: "must be an object"}},
		}
	}
	if _, ok := m["repairs"]; ok {
		return &errcode.Error{
			Code: errcode.InvalidInput, Detail: "a repair input never carries repairs",
			Fields: []errcode.FieldError{{Path: "/input/repairs", Message: "is set only by the repair route"}},
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// noRepairInput refuses an input for a repair that takes none: an undo, or
// a re-apply that uses the change's stored input.
func noRepairInput(req core.RepairRequest) error {
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(req.Input)) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return &errcode.Error{
		Code: errcode.InvalidInput, Detail: "this change is repaired without input",
		Fields: []errcode.FieldError{{Path: "/input", Message: "must be absent"}},
	}
}

// repairedByDef returns the newest registered version of the action name
// on side.
func repairedByDef(reg *core.Registry, side core.Side, name string) (core.ActionDef, bool) {
	var best core.ActionDef
	found := false
	for _, a := range reg.Actions() {
		if a.Spec.Name == name && a.Spec.Side == side && (!found || a.Spec.Version > best.Spec.Version) {
			best, found = a, true
		}
	}
	return best, found
}

// checkRepairedBy refuses a registry in which a RepairedBy action of this
// side does not accept the input {}, which a repair request without input
// plans it with.
func checkRepairedBy(cfg Config) error {
	for _, a := range cfg.Registry.Actions() {
		if a.Spec.Side != cfg.Side || a.Spec.RepairedBy == "" {
			continue
		}
		rdef, ok := repairedByDef(cfg.Registry, cfg.Side, a.Spec.RepairedBy)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s names RepairedBy %s, which is not registered on this side", a.Ref(), a.Spec.RepairedBy)
		}
		if err := cfg.Validator.ValidateInput(rdef, json.RawMessage(`{}`)); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: %s, the RepairedBy action of %s, refuses the input {}: %w", rdef.Ref(), a.Ref(), err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// storedRepairInput opens the input a change's plan was made with; it is
// kept until the change is terminal (spec 1.2, Sealed input).
func (e *Engine) storedRepairInput(ctx context.Context, q queryer, f changeFacts) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	var ct []byte
	if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT input_ct FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", f.planID).Scan(&ct); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the input of change %s: %w", f.id, err)
	}
	if ct == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: the sealed input of change %s is gone", f.id)
	}
	in, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(planInputAD(f.planID), ct)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open the input of change %s: %w", f.id, err)
	}
	return in, nil
}

// planRepair is Plan for a repair change of the change repairs (spec 1.3,
// Repair of a single change). The plan records repairs in
// core_plans.repairs, from which the engine derives Env.Call.RepairOf for
// every later call of the repair change. Only the repair route makes such a
// plan, so it carries no parent's call context.
func (e *Engine) planRepair(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, def core.ActionDef, input json.RawMessage, repairs string) (core.PlanView, error) {
	canonical, err := e.canonical(def, input)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanView{}, err
	}
	env := e.env(p)
	env.Call = core.CallContext{RepairOf: repairs}
	return e.makePlan(ctx, p, def, canonical, env, nil, repairs)
}
```

```go
func TestRepairChangeHoldsTheTargetsLocks(t *testing.T) {
	r := newRfx(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	target := r.revertibleTarget()
	pl := r.repairPlan(target.ID, "")
	entered, release := make(chan struct{}, 1), make(chan struct{})
	r.rh.mu.Lock()
	r.rh.onApply = func() {
		entered <- struct{}{}
		<-release
	}
	r.rh.mu.Unlock()
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := r.eng.Apply(ctx, alice, pl.PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
		done <- err
	}()
	select {
	case <-entered:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("the repair change never applied")
	}
	var pid string
	if err := r.db.Read().QueryRow("SELECT id FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", pl.PlanID).Scan(&pid); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	v, err := r.eng.Change(ctx, target.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v.Owner != core.OwnerRepair || v.RepairedBy != pid || v.State != core.StateNeedsRepair {
		t.Errorf("target while repairing = %s owned by %q repaired by %q; want needs_repair owned by repair, by %s",
			v.State, v.Owner, v.RepairedBy, pid)
	}
	if owner := r.lockOwner(rfxKey); owner != pid {
		t.Errorf("lock %s is held by %q, want the repair change %s", rfxKey, owner, pid)
	}
	_, err = r.eng.Repair(ctx, alice, pid, core.RepairRequest{})
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.ChangeBusy, target.ID)
	_, err = r.eng.Release(ctx, bob, target.ID, "given up", nil)
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.ChangeBusy, "owned by repair")
	close(release)
	if err := <-done; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s := r.state(target.ID); s != core.StateRepaired {
		t.Errorf("target = %s, want repaired", s)
	}
}

}

func TestRepairChangeLeftInDoubtIsRecordedFailed(t *testing.T) {
	r := newRfx(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	target := r.revertibleTarget()
	first := r.repairPlan(target.ID, `{"failRemote":true}`)
	second := r.repairPlan(target.ID, "")

	p := r.apply(alice, first.PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	if p.State != core.StateFailed || p.Error == nil || p.Error.Code != string(errcode.NeedsRepair) {
		t.Fatalf("repair change = %s with error %+v, want failed with core.needs_repair", p.State, p.Error)
	}
	if v, _ := r.eng.Change(ctx, target.ID); v.State != core.StateNeedsRepair || v.Owner != "" {
		t.Errorf("target = %s owned by %q, want needs_repair and unowned", v.State, v.Owner)
	}
	if owner := r.lockOwner(rfxKey); owner != target.ID {
		t.Errorf("lock %s is held by %q, want the target %s", rfxKey, owner, target.ID)
	}
	effs, err := r.eng.Effects(ctx, target.ID)
	if err != nil || len(effs) != 1 || effs[0].ChangeID != p.ID || effs[0].State != core.EffectUnresolved {
		t.Fatalf("effects of the target = %+v, %v; want the repair change's unresolved effect", effs, err)
	}

	_, err = r.eng.Apply(ctx, alice, second.PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.NeedsRepair, "resolve its effects first")
	_, err = r.eng.Repair(ctx, alice, p.ID, core.RepairRequest{})
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.ChangeBusy, target.ID)
	_, err = r.eng.Release(ctx, bob, p.ID, "given up", nil)
	wantRefusal(t, err, errcode.ChangeBusy, target.ID)

	res, err := r.eng.Release(ctx, bob, target.ID, "given up", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(res.Abandoned) != 1 || res.Abandoned[0].ChangeID != p.ID {
		t.Errorf("abandoned = %+v, want the repair change's effect", res.Abandoned)
	}
}

func TestRepairChangeIsRefusedWhenItsTargetMoved(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name  string
		move  func(r *rfxFixture, target string)
		code  errcode.Code
		part  string
		state string
	}{
		{"the target is owned", func(r *rfxFixture, target string) {
			r.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_owner = ? WHERE id = ?", core.OwnerResolve, target)
		}, errcode.ChangeBusy, "owned by resolve", core.StateNeedsRepair},
		{"the target was released", func(r *rfxFixture, target string) {
			r.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET state = ? WHERE id = ?", core.StateAbandoned, target)
			r.sqlExec("DELETE FROM core_locks")
		}, errcode.ChangeBusy, "abandoned", core.StateAbandoned},
		{"the target's recovery handler has not finished", func(r *rfxFixture, target string) {
			r.sqlExec("UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_retry = 1 WHERE id = ?", target)
		}, errcode.NeedsRepair, "recovery handler has not finished", core.StateNeedsRepair},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := newRfx(t)
			target := r.revertibleTarget()
			pl := r.repairPlan(target.ID, "")
			tc.move(r, target.ID)
			_, err := r.eng.Apply(context.Background(), alice, pl.PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
			wantRefusal(t, err, tc.code, tc.part)
			if n := r.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", pl.PlanID); n != 0 {
				t.Errorf("a refused repair plan made %d changes", n)
			}
			if s := r.state(target.ID); s != tc.state {
				t.Errorf("target = %s, want %s", s, tc.state)
			}
		})
	}
}
```

```go
// planRepairs returns the change a plan repairs, or "" for an ordinary
// plan.
func planRepairs(ctx context.Context, q queryer, planID string) (string, error) {
	var repairs sql.NullString
	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT repairs FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", planID).Scan(&repairs)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	return repairs.String, nil
}

// repairTargetReady is the re-check of spec 1.3, Repair change P of R: R
// is needs_repair, unowned and without recovery_retry, and neither R nor a
// failed repair change of R has an unresolved effect. A second plan made
// before an earlier attempt failed is caught here.
func repairTargetReady(ctx context.Context, q queryer, target string) error {
	f, err := loadFacts(ctx, q, target)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	switch {
	case f.owner != "":
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy, fmt.Sprintf("change %s is owned by %s", target, f.owner))
	case f.state != core.StateNeedsRepair:
		return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s is %s; this repair plan no longer applies", target, f.state))
	case f.retry:
		return errcode.New(errcode.NeedsRepair,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s: repair it: its recovery handler has not finished", target))
	}
	n, err := unresolvedCount(ctx, q, target, true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if n > 0 {
		return errcode.New(errcode.NeedsRepair,
			fmt.Sprintf("change %s has an unresolved effect: resolve its effects first", target))
	}
	return nil
}

// takeRepairTarget runs in the intent transaction of the repair change p.
// It re-checks the target, gives it owner repair and repaired_by p, and
// moves every lock row of the target to p, so the keys are never free in
// between; p's own takeLocks then finds its keys held by p and increments
// their epochs.
func takeRepairTarget(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, now time.Time, target, p string) error {
	if err := repairTargetReady(ctx, tx, target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := claim(ctx, tx, now, target, "", core.OwnerRepair, core.StateNeedsRepair, core.StateNeedsRepair); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_changes SET repaired_by = ? WHERE id = ?", p, target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_locks SET owner = ? WHERE owner = ?", p, target)
	return err
}

// repairTransition applies the table of spec 1.3, Repair change P of R,
// when changeID is a repair change whose transition tr ends its run. It
// runs inside tr's transaction before the change's row is written: it
// marks the target repaired when P completed or was confirmed, gives the
// locks back to the target when P failed or was reverted, and records as
// failed an outcome that would leave P in needs_repair, because a repair
// change is never repaired itself.
func (e *Engine) repairTransition(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, now time.Time, changeID string, tr *transition) error {
	var target, action, output sql.NullString
	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx,
		`SELECT p.repairs, c.action, c.output_json FROM core_changes c JOIN core_plans p ON p.id = c.plan_id
		 WHERE c.id = ?`, changeID).Scan(&target, &action, &output); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if target.String == "" {
		return nil
	}
	switch tr.to {
	case core.StateCompleted, core.StateConfirmed:
		out := tr.output
		if len(out) == 0 {
			out = json.RawMessage(output.String)
		}
		outcome, err := e.repairOutcomeOf(ctx, tx, changeID, action.String, target.String, out)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		res, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`UPDATE core_changes SET state = ?, repair_outcome = ?, recovery_owner = '', updated_at = ?
			 WHERE id = ? AND state = ? AND recovery_owner = ?`,
			core.StateRepaired, outcome, formatTime(now), target.String, core.StateNeedsRepair, core.OwnerRepair)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		n, err := res.RowsAffected()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if n != 1 {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: change %s is no longer held by its repair change %s", target.String, changeID)
		}
		// A repaired change is terminal, so its plan keeps only the hash.
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			"UPDATE core_plans SET input_ct = NULL WHERE id = (SELECT plan_id FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?)",
			target.String)
		return err
	case core.StateNeedsRepair:
		tr.to, tr.release, tr.keepLocks, tr.giveBack = core.StateFailed, true, false, false
		return returnRepairTarget(ctx, tx, now, changeID, target.String)
	case core.StateFailed, core.StateReverted, core.StateInterrupted:
		return returnRepairTarget(ctx, tx, now, changeID, target.String)
	}
	return nil
}

// returnRepairTarget moves the locks of the repair change p back to its
// target and ends the target's repair ownership.
func returnRepairTarget(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, now time.Time, p, target string) error {
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_locks SET owner = ? WHERE owner = ?", target, p); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
		"UPDATE core_changes SET recovery_owner = '', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND recovery_owner = ?",
		formatTime(now), target, core.OwnerRepair)
	return err
}

// repairOutcomeOf is the repairOutcome a completed repair change reports
// relative to its target: a re-apply of the target's own action leaves the
// host in the target's intended state, so it is always kept; a RepairedBy
// action reports it in its output field repairOutcome. A missing or unknown
// value is stored as NULL and logged.
func (e *Engine) repairOutcomeOf(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, p, pAction, target string, out json.RawMessage) (any, error) {
	var rAction string
	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT action FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", target).Scan(&rAction); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if pAction == rAction {
		return core.RepairKept, nil
	}
	var o struct {
		RepairOutcome string `json:"repairOutcome"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(out, &o) == nil && (o.RepairOutcome == core.RepairRestored || o.RepairOutcome == core.RepairKept) {
		return o.RepairOutcome, nil
	}
	e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: a repair change reported no repairOutcome", "change", p, "target", target)
	return nil, nil
}
```

```go
func TestRetireThenApply(t *testing.T) {

	}

	if lk, err = f.eng.Lookup(ctx, pl.PlanID, false); err != nil || lk.Status != core.LookupRetired {
		t.Errorf("lookup = %+v, %v; want retired", lk, err)
	}
	if lk, err = f.eng.Retire(ctx, pl.PlanID); err != nil || lk.Status != core.LookupRetired {
		t.Errorf("a repeated retire = %+v, %v; want retired", lk, err)

	if n := f.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", pl.PlanID); n != 0 {

func TestRetireOfAnAppliedPlanAnswersItsLookup(t *testing.T) {
	f := newFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	pl := f.plan(alice, refAdd, `{"name":"a","value":"1"}`)
	v := f.apply(alice, pl.PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
	lk, err := f.eng.Retire(ctx, pl.PlanID)
	if err != nil || lk.Status != core.LookupTerminal || lk.ChangeID != v.ID {
		t.Fatalf("retire = %+v, %v; want the change's lookup", lk, err)
	}
	if n := f.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_plans WHERE id = ? AND retired_at IS NOT NULL", pl.PlanID); n != 0 {
		t.Error("retire marked a plan that has a change")
	}
}

func TestRetireRacesApply(t *testing.T) {
	f := newFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for i := range 100 {
		pl := f.plan(alice, refAdd, fmt.Sprintf(`{"name":"n%d","value":"1"}`, i))
		start := make(chan struct{})
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		var applied core.ChangeView
		var retired core.PlanLookup
		var applyErr, retireErr error
		wg.Add(2)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			<-start
			applied, applyErr = f.eng.Apply(ctx, alice, pl.PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{})
		}()
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			<-start
			retired, retireErr = f.eng.Retire(ctx, pl.PlanID)
		}()
		close(start)
		wg.Wait()
		if retireErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("round %d: retire: %v", i, retireErr)
		}
		lk, err := f.eng.Lookup(ctx, pl.PlanID, false)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("round %d: lookup: %v", i, err)
		}
		changes := f.count("SELECT count(*) FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", pl.PlanID)
		if applyErr != nil {
			wantCode(t, applyErr, errcode.PlanNotFound)
			if retired.Status != core.LookupRetired || lk.Status != core.LookupRetired || changes != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("round %d: apply refused, retire %+v, lookup %+v, %d changes; want retired and none",
					i, retired, lk, changes)
			}
			continue
		}
		if retired.Status == core.LookupRetired || retired.ChangeID != applied.ID || lk.ChangeID != applied.ID ||
			lk.Status != core.LookupTerminal || changes != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("round %d: applied %s, retire %+v, lookup %+v, %d changes; want the change in every answer",
				i, applied.ID, retired, lk, changes)
		}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// Lookup answers what became of a plan, for a composite that lost an
// answer (spec 1.3, Lookup and retire). It never writes. A plan without a
// change is absent, or retired once Retire marked it; a plan with a change
// is running, recovering or terminal by the change's owner.
func (e *Engine) Lookup(ctx context.Context, planID string, _ bool) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	return e.lookup(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), planID)
}

// Retire marks a plan that has no change retired, so a later apply of it
// is refused with plan.not_found, and answers retired; a plan with a
// change answers its lookup. It holds applyMu, so it never interleaves with
// an apply's checks and intent.
func (e *Engine) Retire(ctx context.Context, planID string) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	e.applyMu.Lock()
	defer e.applyMu.Unlock()
	var lk core.PlanLookup
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		var err error
		if lk, err = e.lookup(ctx, tx, planID); err != nil || lk.Status != core.LookupAbsent {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_plans SET retired_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
			formatTime(e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()), planID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lk = core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupRetired}
		return nil
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &coded):
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	case err != nil:
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: retire plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	return lk, nil
}

func (e *Engine) lookup(ctx context.Context, q queryer, planID string) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	var retired sql.NullString
	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT retired_at FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", planID).Scan(&retired)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return core.PlanLookup{}, errcode.New(errcode.PlanNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("no plan %s", planID))
	case err != nil:
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	v, err := scanChange(q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT "+changeColumns+" FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", planID))
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) && retired.Valid:
		return core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupRetired}, nil
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupAbsent}, nil
	case err != nil:
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the change of plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	lk := core.PlanLookup{
		ChangeID: v.ID, State: v.State, Owner: v.Owner, RepairOutcome: v.RepairOutcome, Output: v.Output, Error: v.Error,
	}
	switch v.Owner {
	case "":
		lk.Status = core.LookupTerminal
	case core.OwnerModule:
		lk.Status = core.LookupRecovering
	default:
		lk.Status = core.LookupRunning
	}
	if v.State == core.StatePending && v.Class == core.ClassRevertible {
		lk.Deadline = v.RevertDeadline
	}
	if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx,
		`SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN (?, ?)), count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = ?)
		 FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ?`,
		string(core.EffectMade), string(core.EffectUndoing), string(core.EffectUnresolved), v.ID).
		Scan(&lk.Made, &lk.Unresolved); err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: count effects of %s: %w", v.ID, err)
	}
	return lk, nil
}

// refuseRetired answers plan.not_found for a retired plan: retire promised
// the composite that the plan never becomes a change.
func refuseRetired(ctx context.Context, q queryer, planID string) error {
	var retired sql.NullString
	if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT retired_at FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", planID).Scan(&retired); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	if retired.Valid {
		return errcode.New(errcode.PlanNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("plan %s was retired", planID))
	}
	return nil
}
```

It also consumes L2 `canonicalJSON` and `windowOpen`, the `ufx` test module and helpers, and `PlanOptions`/`ApplyOptions.Call` (Tasks 6 and 14). It produces the `transition` field `private` (Contracts L2, Task 23): any later transition that records a change's result (Task 41's recovery handler outcome `completed`) sets it to the unredacted output.

1.2 clears a made effect's sealed secret on two rules: its undo window has closed, or the change is a step whose composite reached a terminal state. The agent cannot see a composite's state, so the composite runner tells it: `AckPrivate`'s `final` argument (C6) says the composite is terminal, and the ack clears the step's made-effect secrets in its own transaction (Task 36 sends it). `Purge` applies the undo-window rule.

```go
	u := newUfx(t)
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// PrivateOutputTTL is how long a step's unacknowledged private output is
// kept (spec 1.3, Child results, including secrets).
const PrivateOutputTTL = 24 * time.Hour

// privateOutputAD is the associated data of a change's sealed private
// output (ADR 0005).
func privateOutputAD(changeID string) string { return "core_changes.private_output_ct." + changeID }

// Lookup answers what became of a plan, for a composite that lost an
// answer (spec 1.3, Lookup and retire). It never writes. A plan without a
// change is absent, or retired once Retire marked it; a plan with a change
// is running, recovering or terminal by the change's owner. With private
// set, the answer carries the change's unredacted output while it is
// stored.
func (e *Engine) Lookup(ctx context.Context, planID string, private bool) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	return e.lookup(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), planID, private)
}

// Retire marks a plan that has no change retired, so a later apply of it
// is refused with plan.not_found, and answers retired; a plan with a
// change answers its lookup. It holds applyMu, so it never interleaves with
// an apply's checks and intent.
func (e *Engine) Retire(ctx context.Context, planID string) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	e.applyMu.Lock()
	defer e.applyMu.Unlock()
	var lk core.PlanLookup
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		var err error
		if lk, err = e.lookup(ctx, tx, planID, false); err != nil || lk.Status != core.LookupAbsent {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_plans SET retired_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
			formatTime(e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()), planID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lk = core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupRetired}
		return nil
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &coded):
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	case err != nil:
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: retire plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	return lk, nil
}

func (e *Engine) lookup(ctx context.Context, q queryer, planID string, private bool) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	var retired sql.NullString
	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT retired_at FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", planID).Scan(&retired)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return core.PlanLookup{}, errcode.New(errcode.PlanNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("no plan %s", planID))
	case err != nil:
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	v, err := scanChange(q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT "+changeColumns+" FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", planID))
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) && retired.Valid:
		return core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupRetired}, nil
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupAbsent}, nil
	case err != nil:
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the change of plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	lk := core.PlanLookup{
		ChangeID: v.ID, State: v.State, Owner: v.Owner, RepairOutcome: v.RepairOutcome, Output: v.Output, Error: v.Error,
	}
	switch v.Owner {
	case "":
		lk.Status = core.LookupTerminal
	case core.OwnerModule:
		lk.Status = core.LookupRecovering
	default:
		lk.Status = core.LookupRunning
	}
	if v.State == core.StatePending && v.Class == core.ClassRevertible {
		lk.Deadline = v.RevertDeadline
	}
	if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx,
		`SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN (?, ?)), count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = ?)
		 FROM core_effects WHERE change_id = ?`,
		string(core.EffectMade), string(core.EffectUndoing), string(core.EffectUnresolved), v.ID).
		Scan(&lk.Made, &lk.Unresolved); err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: count effects of %s: %w", v.ID, err)
	}
	if private {
		var ct []byte
		if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT private_output_ct FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", v.ID).
			Scan(&ct); err != nil {
			return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the private output of %s: %w", v.ID, err)
		}
		if ct != nil {
			raw, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(privateOutputAD(v.ID), ct)
			if err != nil {
				return core.PlanLookup{}, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open the private output of %s: %w", v.ID, err)
			}
			lk.Private = raw
		}
	}
	return lk, nil
}

// refuseRetired answers plan.not_found for a retired plan: retire promised
// the composite that the plan never becomes a change.
func refuseRetired(ctx context.Context, q queryer, planID string) error {
	var retired sql.NullString
	if err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT retired_at FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", planID).Scan(&retired); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	if retired.Valid {
		return errcode.New(errcode.PlanNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("plan %s was retired", planID))
	}
	return nil
}

// storePrivate keeps a step's unredacted output sealed when redaction hid
// something in it, so its composite can take the secret once, from the
// apply answer or a private lookup (spec 1.3, Child results, including
// secrets). It runs in the transaction that records the change's result; a
// top-level change, and an output without secret fields, store nothing.
func (e *Engine) storePrivate(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, now time.Time, changeID string, redacted, raw json.RawMessage) error {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var parent sql.NullString
	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT parent_change_id FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", changeID).
		Scan(&parent); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if parent.String == "" {
		return nil
	}
	a, err := canonicalJSON(redacted)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: compare the output of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	b, err := canonicalJSON(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: compare the output of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(a, b) {
		return nil
	}
	ct, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Seal(privateOutputAD(changeID), raw)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: seal the private output of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_changes SET private_output_ct = ?, private_output_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
		ct, formatTime(now), changeID)
	return err
}

// AckPrivate clears a change's private output once its composite has
// sealed it into the step log. With final set the change's composite is
// terminal, so the step can no longer be undone, and the sealed secrets of
// its made effects are cleared in the same transaction (spec 1.2). A change
// that is no step keeps them: only its own undo window ends its undo. It is
// idempotent.
func (e *Engine) AckPrivate(ctx context.Context, changeID string, final bool) error {
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		res, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			"UPDATE core_changes SET private_output_ct = NULL, private_output_at = NULL WHERE id = ?", changeID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		n, err := res.RowsAffected()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if n == 0 {
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("no change %s", changeID))
		}
		if !final {
			return nil
		}
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`UPDATE core_effects SET secret_ct = NULL WHERE change_id = ? AND state = ?
			 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_changes WHERE id = ? AND coalesce(parent_change_id, '') <> '')`,
			changeID, string(core.EffectMade), changeID)
		return err
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	if err != nil && !errors.As(err, &coded) {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: acknowledge the private output of %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	return err
}
```

In `internal/core/lifecycle/recover.go`, replace the whole `Purge` function (with its doc comment) by:

```go
// Purge deletes expired plans that never became a change, clears private
// outputs no composite acknowledged within PrivateOutputTTL, and clears the
// sealed secret of every made effect whose undo window has closed (spec
// 1.2, 1.3); a step whose composite is terminal is cleared by AckPrivate's
// final acknowledgement instead. It runs every 10 minutes, more often than
// the hourly purge the spec requires. A plan with a change is kept, so a repeated apply still
// returns that change (spec section 3).
func (e *Engine) Purge(ctx context.Context) error {
	// An apply that loaded a plan before it expired inserts its change later;
	// deleting the plan in between would fail that insert's foreign key.
	e.applyMu.Lock()
	defer e.applyMu.Unlock()
	now := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`DELETE FROM core_plans WHERE expires_at <= ?
			 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = core_plans.id)`, formatTime(now)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`UPDATE core_changes SET private_output_ct = NULL, private_output_at = NULL
			 WHERE private_output_at IS NOT NULL AND private_output_at <= ?`,
			formatTime(now.Add(-PrivateOutputTTL))); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return purgeEffectSecrets(ctx, tx)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: purge plans: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// purgeEffectSecrets clears the sealed secret of every made effect whose
// change can no longer be undone because a later change took one of its
// lock keys (spec 1.2). A secret exists only for an inverse, so it has no
// use once the undo window has closed.
func purgeEffectSecrets(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx) error {
	rows, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx,
		"SELECT DISTINCT change_id FROM core_effects WHERE state = ? AND secret_ct IS NOT NULL", string(core.EffectMade))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var ids []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var id string
		if err := rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
			_ = rows.Close()
			return err
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	if err := errors.Join(rows.Err(), rows.Close()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, id := range ids {
		key, err := windowOpen(ctx, tx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if key == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_effects SET secret_ct = NULL WHERE change_id = ? AND state = ?",
			id, string(core.EffectMade)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

`recover.go` already imports `context`, `database/sql`, `errors`, `fmt` and `core`.

```go
// undoNoteStore is the host state of module note: the names of its entries.
type undoNoteStore struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	entries map[string]bool
}

func (s *undoNoteStore) has(name string) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.entries[name]
}

func (s *undoNoteStore) set(name string, present bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.entries[name] = present
}

type undoNoteIn struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

type undoNoteOut struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func undoNoteDoc(name string) core.StateDoc {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"name": name})
	return core.StateDoc{State: b}
}

// undoNoteAdd adds an entry and journals its creation. It is its own
// Observer and Undoer, so its changes can be undone.
type undoNoteAdd struct{ store *undoNoteStore }

func (h undoNoteAdd) Plan(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in undoNoteIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	hash := "absent"
	if h.store.has(in.Name) {
		hash = "present"
	}
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{{Op: "+", Text: "note " + in.Name}}, StateHash: hash}, nil
}

func (h undoNoteAdd) Apply(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, in undoNoteIn) (undoNoteOut, error) {
	after := undoNoteDoc(in.Name)
	seq, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, core.Effect{
		Kind: core.EffectCreate, Resource: "note.entry:?" + in.Name, Recovery: &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name", Value: in.Name},
		Local: true, InverseLocal: true, Before: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}, After: &after,
	}, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return undoNoteOut{}, err
	}
	h.store.set(in.Name, true)
	if err := env.Effects.Made(ctx, seq, "note.entry:"+in.Name, after); err != nil {
		return undoNoteOut{}, err
	}
	return undoNoteOut(in), nil
}

func (h undoNoteAdd) Verify(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in undoNoteIn, _ undoNoteOut) error {
	if !h.store.has(in.Name) {
		return errors.New("note: entry " + in.Name + " is missing")
	}
	return nil
}

func (h undoNoteAdd) Observe(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.Observation, error) {
	name := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(e.Resource, "note.entry:"), "?")
	if !h.store.has(name) {
		return core.Observation{Current: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}, Exclusive: true}, nil
	}
	return core.Observation{Current: undoNoteDoc(name), Resource: "note.entry:" + name, Matches: 1, Exclusive: true}, nil
}

func (h undoNoteAdd) Inverse(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.InverseResult, error) {
	h.store.set(strings.TrimPrefix(e.Resource, "note.entry:"), false)
	return core.InverseResult{}, nil
}

var undoNoteRef = core.ActionRef{Name: "note.entry.add", Version: 1}

// undoNoteModule is module note, whose one action note.entry.add is
// compensable with an undo handler.
type undoNoteModule struct{ store *undoNoteStore }

func (m undoNoteModule) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	return core.Manifest{ID: "note", Version: 1, DefaultEnabled: true, Actions: []core.ActionDef{
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{Name: undoNoteRef.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable,
			Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: []string{"note"}}, undoNoteAdd(m)),
	}}
}

// undoNoteWait polls change id until the undo running on the engine's
// goroutine has left state undoing.
func undoNoteWait(t *testing.T, rt *Runtime, id string) core.ChangeView {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for {
		v, err := rt.Change(context.Background(), id)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if v.State != core.StateUndoing {
			return v
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("change %s is still undoing", id)
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}
```

```go
// Undo undoes a change of this host (spec 1.2). call names the composite
// whose unwind sends it, and is nil otherwise.
func (r *Runtime) Undo(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	return r.engine.Undo(ctx, p, changeID, call)
}

// Repair repairs a change of this host in needs_repair (spec 1.3). A repair
// may plan an action of the change's module, so, as for Plan, that module
// must be usable.
func (r *Runtime) Repair(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, req core.RepairRequest) (core.RepairResult, error) {
	v, err := r.engine.Change(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	if err := r.usable(v.Action); err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	return r.engine.Repair(ctx, p, changeID, req)
}

// Release gives up a change of this host in needs_repair. call names the
// composite releasing its step, and is nil otherwise.
func (r *Runtime) Release(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID, reason string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ReleaseResult, error) {
	return r.engine.Release(ctx, p, changeID, reason, call)
}

// Effects lists a change's effects and those of its repair changes.
func (r *Runtime) Effects(ctx context.Context, _ core.Principal, changeID string) ([]core.EffectView, error) {
	return r.engine.Effects(ctx, changeID)
}

// Observe reads the resource of one effect now and changes nothing.
func (r *Runtime) Observe(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int) (core.ObserveResult, error) {
	return r.engine.Observe(ctx, p, changeID, seq)
}

// Resolve records the operator's resolution of an unresolved effect.
func (r *Runtime) Resolve(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int, req core.ResolveRequest) (core.EffectView, error) {
	return r.engine.Resolve(ctx, p, changeID, seq, req)
}

// Lookup reports what became of a plan; private adds a child change's
// unredacted output while it is kept.
func (r *Runtime) Lookup(ctx context.Context, planID string, private bool) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	return r.engine.Lookup(ctx, planID, private)
}

// Retire marks a plan that has no change so that it is never applied.
func (r *Runtime) Retire(ctx context.Context, planID string) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	return r.engine.Retire(ctx, planID)
}

// AckPrivate clears a change's private output once the composite sealed it;
// final says the composite is terminal.
func (r *Runtime) AckPrivate(ctx context.Context, changeID string, final bool) error {
	return r.engine.AckPrivate(ctx, changeID, final)
}
```

```go
// The agent API's headers (ADR 0012).
const (
	// HeaderPrincipal carries the JSON of the calling Principal; the agent
	// accepts it only from the authenticated controller.
	HeaderPrincipal    = "Darkpanel-Principal"
	HeaderProtocol     = "Darkpanel-Protocol"
	HeaderVersion      = "Darkpanel-Version"
	HeaderControllerID = "Darkpanel-Controller-Id"
	// HeaderCall carries the CallContext the controller sends with a plan,
	// apply, undo or release: its JSON encoded with base64.RawURLEncoding
	// (spec 1.5). A plan's body is the action input itself, so the call
	// cannot travel in the body.
	HeaderCall = "Darkpanel-Call"
```

```go
// CallContext is core.CallContext without RepairOf, which the agent derives
// from a repair plan and never receives (spec 1.5). The agent decodes it
// with unknown members refused, so a repairOf member is
// request.invalid_input.
type CallContext struct {
	ParentChangeID string   `json:"parentChangeId"`
	ParentAction   string   `json:"parentAction"`
	StepID         string   `json:"stepId"`
	Retired        []string `json:"retired"`
}

// FromCall converts c, leaving out RepairOf.
func FromCall(c core.CallContext) CallContext {
	return CallContext{ParentChangeID: c.ParentChangeID, ParentAction: c.ParentAction, StepID: c.StepID,
		Retired: slices.Clone(c.Retired)}
}

// Core converts c back; RepairOf stays empty.
func (c CallContext) Core() core.CallContext {
	return core.CallContext{ParentChangeID: c.ParentChangeID, ParentAction: c.ParentAction, StepID: c.StepID,
		Retired: slices.Clone(c.Retired)}
}
```

```go
func (c *Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, a core.ActionRef, input json.RawMessage, opts core.PlanOptions) (core.PlanView, error) {
```

```go
// agent socket.

	cfg Config
	// principal returns the caller of an operation that acts for one.
	principal func(r *http.Request) (core.Principal, error)
	// call returns the call context the controller sends with a plan, apply,

	// allow refuses an operation before it reaches the agent; name is the
```

Insert after `headerPrincipal`:

```go
// headerCall reads the call context the controller sends, base64url without
// padding over its JSON; a request without the header has none. Unknown
// members are refused, so a repairOf, which the agent derives itself, is
// request.invalid_input.
func headerCall(r *http.Request) (*core.CallContext, error) {
	if len(r.Header.Values(wire.HeaderCall)) == 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}
	b, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(r.Header.Get(wire.HeaderCall))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput, fmt.Sprintf("the %s header is not base64url without padding: %v", wire.HeaderCall, err))
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(b))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var c wire.CallContext
	err = dec.Decode(&c)
	if err == nil {
		if _, tail := dec.Token(); !errors.Is(tail, io.EOF) {
			err = errors.New("more than one JSON value")
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput, fmt.Sprintf("the %s header is not a call context: %v", wire.HeaderCall, err))
	}
	call := c.Core()
	return &call, nil
}
```

```go
func (h *handler) handlePlan(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ref, err := actionRef(r)
	var p core.Principal
	if err == nil {
		p, err = h.actor(r, opPlan, ref.Name)
	}
	var call *core.CallContext
	if err == nil {
		call, err = h.call(r)
	}
	var input json.RawMessage
	if err == nil {
		input, err = readJSON(w, r)
	}
	var v core.PlanView
	if err == nil {
		v, err = h.cfg.Agent.Plan(r.Context(), p, ref, input, core.PlanOptions{Call: call})
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, wire.FromPlanView(v))
}

func (h *handler) handleApply(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opApply, "")
	var call *core.CallContext
	if err == nil {
		call, err = h.call(r)
	}
	var opts wire.ApplyOptions
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeJSON(w, r, &opts)
	}
	var v core.ChangeView
	if err == nil {
		o := opts.Core()
		o.Call = call
		v, err = h.cfg.Agent.Apply(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), o)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, wire.FromChangeView(v))
}
```

**3d. `internal/agent/api/socket.go`.** Add the import `"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/agent/wire"` (before the `core` import). Replace `NewSocketHandler` with:

```go
// NewSocketHandler serves the agent API on the agent socket, whose peer the
// socket listener has already checked is root. The caller is always the
// local root user, whatever header the peer sends; before enrollment only
// hello and reads are served. Enablement is the controller's rule and is not
// applied, but a module whose preflight checks fail is refused. The journal
// routes are absent: the controller alone collects and acknowledges the
// journal. A request carrying a call context is refused: only the
// controller sends one.
func NewSocketHandler(cfg Config, sock SocketConfig) http.Handler {
	h := &handler{cfg: cfg}
	h.principal = func(*http.Request) (core.Principal, error) { return socketPrincipal(sock.Identity()), nil }
	// The handler returned below refuses every request with the header, so
	// none that reaches a route carries a call.
	h.call = func(*http.Request) (*core.CallContext, error) { return nil, nil }
	h.allow = func(ctx context.Context, op, name string) error { return h.socketAllow(ctx, sock, op, name) }
	h.hello = func(*http.Request) error { return nil }
	mux := h.routes(false)
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if len(r.Header.Values(wire.HeaderCall)) > 0 {
			h.writeProblem(w, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput,
				"the "+wire.HeaderCall+" header is accepted only from the controller"))
			return
		}
		mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}
```

**3a. `internal/agent/wire/wire.go`.** Replace the package comment with:

```go
// Package wire holds the request and response bodies of the agent API
// (ADR 0012). Most core types carry no JSON tags, so the API never encodes
// them directly: their bodies are these types, with camelCase fields, times
// in UTC, durations in whole seconds and absent values as JSON null, and with
// conversions to and from their core counterparts. The lifecycle views and
// requests of spec 1.3 (core.EffectView, core.ObserveResult,
// core.PlanLookup, core.RepairRequest and core.ResolveRequest) carry their
// own tags and are sent as they are.
package wire
```

Replace `ChangeError`, `ChangeView`, `FromChangeView` and `ChangeView.Core` with:

```go
// ChangeError is core.ChangeError.
type ChangeError struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
	Cause   string `json:"cause"`
}

// ChangeView is core.ChangeView.
type ChangeView struct {
	ID             string          `json:"id"`
	HostID         string          `json:"hostId"`
	Action         string          `json:"action"`
	Version        int             `json:"version"`
	Actor          string          `json:"actor"`
	Class          string          `json:"class"`
	CompensatedBy  string          `json:"compensatedBy"`
	State          string          `json:"state"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time       `json:"createdAt"`
	UpdatedAt      time.Time       `json:"updatedAt"`
	RevertDeadline *time.Time      `json:"revertDeadline"`
	Output         json.RawMessage `json:"output"`
	Error          *ChangeError    `json:"error"`
	ParentChangeID string          `json:"parentChangeId"`
	Owner          string          `json:"owner"`
	RepairedBy     string          `json:"repairedBy"`
	RepairOutcome  string          `json:"repairOutcome"`
	Override       json.RawMessage `json:"override"`
}

// FromChangeView converts v.
func FromChangeView(v core.ChangeView) ChangeView {
	out := ChangeView{
		ID: v.ID, HostID: v.HostID, Action: v.Action, Version: v.Version, Actor: v.Actor, Class: string(v.Class),
		CompensatedBy: v.CompensatedBy, State: v.State, CreatedAt: v.CreatedAt.UTC(), UpdatedAt: v.UpdatedAt.UTC(),
		RevertDeadline: utcPtr(v.RevertDeadline), Output: raw(v.Output), ParentChangeID: v.ParentChangeID,
		Owner: v.Owner, RepairedBy: v.RepairedBy, RepairOutcome: v.RepairOutcome, Override: raw(v.Override),
	}
	if v.Error != nil {
		out.Error = &ChangeError{Code: v.Error.Code, Message: v.Error.Message, Cause: v.Error.Cause}
	}
	return out
}

// Core converts v back.
func (v ChangeView) Core() core.ChangeView {
	out := core.ChangeView{
		ID: v.ID, HostID: v.HostID, Action: v.Action, Version: v.Version, Actor: v.Actor, Class: core.Class(v.Class),
		CompensatedBy: v.CompensatedBy, State: v.State, CreatedAt: v.CreatedAt.UTC(), UpdatedAt: v.UpdatedAt.UTC(),
		RevertDeadline: utcPtr(v.RevertDeadline), Output: raw(v.Output), ParentChangeID: v.ParentChangeID,
		Owner: v.Owner, RepairedBy: v.RepairedBy, RepairOutcome: v.RepairOutcome, Override: raw(v.Override),
	}
	if v.Error != nil {
		out.Error = &core.ChangeError{Code: v.Error.Code, Message: v.Error.Message, Cause: v.Error.Cause}
	}
	return out
}

// RepairResult is core.RepairResult: the change a repair started, or the
// plan it made.
type RepairResult struct {
	Change *ChangeView `json:"change,omitempty"`
	Plan   *PlanView   `json:"plan,omitempty"`
}

// FromRepairResult converts r.
func FromRepairResult(r core.RepairResult) RepairResult {
	var out RepairResult
	if r.Change != nil {
		v := FromChangeView(*r.Change)
		out.Change = &v
	}
	if r.Plan != nil {
		p := FromPlanView(*r.Plan)
		out.Plan = &p
	}
	return out
}

// Core converts r back.
func (r RepairResult) Core() core.RepairResult {
	var out core.RepairResult
	if r.Change != nil {
		v := r.Change.Core()
		out.Change = &v
	}
	if r.Plan != nil {
		p := r.Plan.Core()
		out.Plan = &p
	}
	return out
}

// Release is the body of POST changes/{id}/release.
type Release struct {
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

// ReleaseResult is core.ReleaseResult; Abandoned is [] rather than null.
type ReleaseResult struct {
	Change    ChangeView        `json:"change"`
	Abandoned []core.EffectView `json:"abandoned"`
}

// FromReleaseResult converts r.
func FromReleaseResult(r core.ReleaseResult) ReleaseResult {
	abandoned := slices.Clone(r.Abandoned)
	if abandoned == nil {
		abandoned = []core.EffectView{}
	}
	return ReleaseResult{Change: FromChangeView(r.Change), Abandoned: abandoned}
}

// Core converts r back.
func (r ReleaseResult) Core() core.ReleaseResult {
	return core.ReleaseResult{Change: r.Change.Core(), Abandoned: slices.Clone(r.Abandoned)}
}

// Effects is the answer of GET changes/{id}/effects.
type Effects struct {
	Effects []core.EffectView `json:"effects"`
}

// AckPrivate is the optional body of POST changes/{id}/private-output/ack;
// an empty body is not final.
type AckPrivate struct {
	Final bool `json:"final"`
}
```

```go
// changeOpPath is the route of op on change changeID.
func changeOpPath(changeID, op string) string {
	return "changes/" + url.PathEscape(changeID) + "/" + op
}

// Undo undoes a change; call, when set, travels as Darkpanel-Call. The agent
// answers 202 with the change undoing, or 200 when it is already reverted.
func (c *Client) Undo(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	return c.change(ctx, request{method: http.MethodPost, path: changeOpPath(changeID, "undo"), principal: &p, call: call})
}

// Repair repairs a change in needs_repair: the answer holds the change the
// repair started or the plan it made.
func (c *Client) Repair(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, req core.RepairRequest) (core.RepairResult, error) {
	var res wire.RepairResult
	if err := c.do(ctx, request{method: http.MethodPost, path: changeOpPath(changeID, "repair"), principal: &p, body: req}, &res); err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	return res.Core(), nil
}

// Release gives up a change in needs_repair; call, when set, travels as
// Darkpanel-Call.
func (c *Client) Release(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID, reason string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ReleaseResult, error) {
	var res wire.ReleaseResult
	req := request{method: http.MethodPost, path: changeOpPath(changeID, "release"), principal: &p, call: call,
		body: wire.Release{Reason: reason}}
	if err := c.do(ctx, req, &res); err != nil {
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, err
	}
	return res.Core(), nil
}

// Effects lists a change's effects.
func (c *Client) Effects(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) ([]core.EffectView, error) {
	var res wire.Effects
	if err := c.do(ctx, request{method: http.MethodGet, path: changeOpPath(changeID, "effects"), principal: &p}, &res); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return res.Effects, nil
}

// Observe reads one effect's resource now.
func (c *Client) Observe(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int) (core.ObserveResult, error) {
	var res core.ObserveResult
	path := changeOpPath(changeID, "effects/"+strconv.Itoa(seq)+"/observe")
	if err := c.do(ctx, request{method: http.MethodGet, path: path, principal: &p}, &res); err != nil {
		return core.ObserveResult{}, err
	}
	return res, nil
}

// Resolve resolves an unresolved effect.
func (c *Client) Resolve(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int, req core.ResolveRequest) (core.EffectView, error) {
	var res core.EffectView
	path := changeOpPath(changeID, "effects/"+strconv.Itoa(seq)+"/resolve")
	if err := c.do(ctx, request{method: http.MethodPost, path: path, principal: &p, body: req}, &res); err != nil {
		return core.EffectView{}, err
	}
	return res, nil
}

// Lookup reports what became of a plan; private asks for a child change's
// unredacted output too.
func (c *Client) Lookup(ctx context.Context, planID string, private bool) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	var q url.Values
	if private {
		q = url.Values{"private": {"1"}}
	}
	var res core.PlanLookup
	if err := c.do(ctx, request{method: http.MethodGet, path: "plans/" + url.PathEscape(planID), query: q}, &res); err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	}
	return res, nil
}

// Retire marks a plan without a change as never to be applied.
func (c *Client) Retire(ctx context.Context, planID string) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	var res core.PlanLookup
	if err := c.do(ctx, request{method: http.MethodPost, path: "plans/" + url.PathEscape(planID) + "/retire"}, &res); err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	}
	return res, nil
}

// AckPrivate tells the agent the composite sealed a change's private output;
// final says the composite is terminal.
func (c *Client) AckPrivate(ctx context.Context, changeID string, final bool) error {
	req := request{method: http.MethodPost, path: changeOpPath(changeID, "private-output/ack")}
	if final {
		req.body = wire.AckPrivate{Final: true}
	}
	return c.do(ctx, req, nil)
}
```

```go
// routeOpsCalls records the agent calls the change-operation routes make.
type routeOpsCalls struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	list []any
}

func (c *routeOpsCalls) add(v ...any) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.list = append(c.list, v...)
}

func (c *routeOpsCalls) all() []any {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(c.list)

		{"POST", "/agent/v1/changes/c1/private-output/ack", nil, http.StatusNoContent, ""},
	} {
		got := call(t, h, tc.method, tc.path, hdr, tc.body)
		if got.Code != tc.status || !strings.Contains(got.Body.String(), tc.contains) {
			t.Errorf("%s %s: %d %s, want %d with %s", tc.method, tc.path, got.Code, got.Body, tc.status, tc.contains)
		}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		method, path string
		body         []byte
	}{
		{"GET", "/agent/v1/changes/c1/effects/0/observe", nil},
		{"GET", "/agent/v1/changes/c1/effects/x/observe", nil},
		{"POST", "/agent/v1/changes/c1/effects/-1/resolve", []byte(`{"resolution":"accept"}`)},
		{"GET", "/agent/v1/plans/p1?private=yes", nil},
		{"GET", "/agent/v1/plans/p1?other=1", nil},
		{"GET", "/agent/v1/plans/p1?private=1&private=1", nil},
	} {
		wantProblem(t, call(t, h, tc.method, tc.path, hdr, tc.body), 422, errcode.InvalidInput)
	}
}
```

```go
// routes maps every route. The journal routes and the change operations of
// spec 1.3 only serve the controller's session: the agent socket serves none
// of them, so every undo, repair, release and resolution goes through the
// controller's admission checks.
func (h *handler) routes(controller bool) *http.ServeMux {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"hello", h.handleHello)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"actions/{name}/{version}/read", h.handleRead)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"resources/{module}/{resource}", h.handleResource)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"actions/{name}/{version}/plan", h.handlePlan)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"plans/{id}/apply", h.handleApply)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"changes/{id}/confirm", h.handleChangeOp(opConfirm))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"changes/{id}/revert", h.handleChangeOp(opRevert))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"changes/{id}", h.handleChange)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"changes", h.handleChanges)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"modules/{id}/preflight", h.handlePreflight)
	if controller {
		mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"journal", h.handleJournal)
		mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"journal/ack", h.handleAck)
		mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"changes/{id}/undo", h.handleUndo)
		mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"changes/{id}/repair", h.handleRepair)
		mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"changes/{id}/release", h.handleRelease)
		mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"changes/{id}/effects", h.handleEffects)
		mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"changes/{id}/effects/{seq}/observe", h.handleObserve)
		mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"changes/{id}/effects/{seq}/resolve", h.handleResolve)
		mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"changes/{id}/private-output/ack", h.handleAckPrivate)
		mux.HandleFunc("GET "+prefix+"plans/{id}", h.handleLookup)
		mux.HandleFunc("POST "+prefix+"plans/{id}/retire", h.handleRetire)
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		h.writeProblem(w, errcode.New(errcode.NotFound, fmt.Sprintf("no agent API route %s %s", r.Method, r.URL.Path)))
	})
	return mux
}
```

Replace the whole `handleApply` function (Task 25's version) with:

```go
// handleApply answers 202 while the change is still applying (spec 1.3
// Asynchronous apply), 200 otherwise.
func (h *handler) handleApply(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opApply, "")
	var call *core.CallContext
	if err == nil {
		call, err = h.call(r)
	}
	var opts wire.ApplyOptions
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeJSON(w, r, &opts)
	}
	var v core.ChangeView
	if err == nil {
		o := opts.Core()
		o.Call = call
		v, err = h.cfg.Agent.Apply(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), o)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if v.State == core.StateApplying {
		status = http.StatusAccepted
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, status, wire.FromChangeView(v))
}
```

```go
// handleUndo answers 202 with the change undoing, or 200 when it was
// already reverted.
func (h *handler) handleUndo(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opUndo, "")
	var call *core.CallContext
	if err == nil {
		call, err = h.call(r)
	}
	var v core.ChangeView
	if err == nil {
		v, err = h.cfg.Agent.Undo(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), call)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusAccepted
	if v.State == core.StateReverted {
		status = http.StatusOK
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, status, wire.FromChangeView(v))
}

// handleRepair answers 202 with the change a repair started, or 200 with the
// plan it made.
func (h *handler) handleRepair(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opRepair, "")
	var req core.RepairRequest
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeJSON(w, r, &req)
	}
	var res core.RepairResult
	if err == nil {
		res, err = h.cfg.Agent.Repair(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), req)
	}
	if err == nil && (res.Change == nil) == (res.Plan == nil) {
		err = errors.New("api: a repair answered neither a change nor a plan, or both")
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if res.Change != nil {
		status = http.StatusAccepted
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, status, wire.FromRepairResult(res))
}

// handleRelease passes the reason on unchecked: the engine validates it.
func (h *handler) handleRelease(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opRelease, "")
	var call *core.CallContext
	if err == nil {
		call, err = h.call(r)
	}
	var body wire.Release
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeJSON(w, r, &body)
	}
	var res core.ReleaseResult
	if err == nil {
		res, err = h.cfg.Agent.Release(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), body.Reason, call)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, wire.FromReleaseResult(res))
}

func (h *handler) handleEffects(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opEffects, "")
	var effects []core.EffectView
	if err == nil {
		effects, err = h.cfg.Agent.Effects(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"))
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	if effects == nil {
		effects = []core.EffectView{}
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, wire.Effects{Effects: effects})
}

// effectSeq reads an effect route's {seq}, a positive integer.
func effectSeq(r *http.Request) (int, error) {
	seq, err := strconv.Atoi(r.PathValue("seq"))
	if err != nil || seq < 1 {
		return 0, &errcode.Error{Code: errcode.InvalidInput, Detail: "seq must be a positive integer",
			Fields: []errcode.FieldError{{Path: "/seq", Message: "must be a positive integer"}}}
	}
	return seq, nil
}

func (h *handler) handleObserve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opObserve, "")
	var seq int
	if err == nil {
		seq, err = effectSeq(r)
	}
	var res core.ObserveResult
	if err == nil {
		res, err = h.cfg.Agent.Observe(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), seq)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
}

func (h *handler) handleResolve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, err := h.actor(r, opResolve, "")
	var seq int
	if err == nil {
		seq, err = effectSeq(r)
	}
	var req core.ResolveRequest
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeJSON(w, r, &req)
	}
	var v core.EffectView
	if err == nil {
		v, err = h.cfg.Agent.Resolve(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), seq, req)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, v)
}

// lookupPrivate reads GET plans/{id}'s one parameter: private=1 asks for a
// child change's unredacted output.
func lookupPrivate(r *http.Request) (bool, error) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	for _, k := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(q)) {
		if k != "private" || len(q[k]) > 1 {
			return false, invalidQuery(k, "unknown or repeated parameter")
		}
	}
	if !q.Has("private") {
		return false, nil
	}
	if q.Get("private") != "1" {
		return false, invalidQuery("private", "must be 1")
	}
	return true, nil
}

func (h *handler) handleLookup(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	private, err := lookupPrivate(r)
	if err == nil {
		err = h.allow(r.Context(), opLookup, "")
	}
	var lk core.PlanLookup
	if err == nil {
		lk, err = h.cfg.Agent.Lookup(r.Context(), r.PathValue("id"), private)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, lk)
}

func (h *handler) handleRetire(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	err := h.allow(r.Context(), opRetire, "")
	var lk core.PlanLookup
	if err == nil {
		lk, err = h.cfg.Agent.Retire(r.Context(), r.PathValue("id"))
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, lk)
}

// handleAckPrivate reads an empty body as an acknowledgement that is not
// final.
func (h *handler) handleAckPrivate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	err := h.allow(r.Context(), opAckPrivate, "")
	var ack wire.AckPrivate
	if err == nil && r.ContentLength != 0 {
		err = decodeJSON(w, r, &ack)
	}
	if err == nil {
		err = h.cfg.Agent.AckPrivate(r.Context(), r.PathValue("id"), ack.Final)
	}
	if err != nil {
		h.writeProblem(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}
```

```go
package dispatch

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// opsAgent is h1's agent with its change operations recorded and answered
// for view; Repair answers plan when it is set, else view undoing.
type opsAgent struct {
	core.AgentClient
	view core.ChangeView
	plan *core.PlanView

	mu    sync.Mutex
	calls []string
}

func (a *opsAgent) record(format string, args ...any) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.calls = append(a.calls, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}

func (a *opsAgent) recorded() []string {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(a.calls)
}

func (a *opsAgent) Undo(_ context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	a.record("undo %s by %s, call %v", changeID, p.Actor, call)
	v := a.view
	v.State = core.StateUndoing
	return v, nil
}

func (a *opsAgent) Repair(_ context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, req core.RepairRequest) (core.RepairResult, error) {
	a.record("repair %s by %s, input %s, step %q as %q", changeID, p.Actor, string(req.Input), req.Step, req.As)
	if a.plan != nil {
		pl := *a.plan
		return core.RepairResult{Plan: &pl}, nil
	}
	v := a.view
	v.State = core.StateUndoing
	return core.RepairResult{Change: &v}, nil
}

func (a *opsAgent) Release(_ context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID, reason string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ReleaseResult, error) {
	a.record("release %s by %s: %s, call %v", changeID, p.Actor, reason, call)
	v := a.view
	v.State = core.StateAbandoned
	return core.ReleaseResult{Change: v, Abandoned: []core.EffectView{{ChangeID: changeID, Seq: 1, State: core.EffectAbandoned}}}, nil
}

func (a *opsAgent) Effects(_ context.Context, _ core.Principal, changeID string) ([]core.EffectView, error) {
	a.record("effects %s", changeID)
	return []core.EffectView{{ChangeID: changeID, Seq: 1, State: core.EffectMade}}, nil
}

func (a *opsAgent) Observe(_ context.Context, _ core.Principal, changeID string, seq int) (core.ObserveResult, error) {
	a.record("observe %s %d", changeID, seq)
	return core.ObserveResult{Effect: core.EffectView{ChangeID: changeID, Seq: seq}, Allowed: []string{core.ResolutionAccept}}, nil
}

func (a *opsAgent) Resolve(_ context.Context, _ core.Principal, changeID string, seq int, req core.ResolveRequest) (core.EffectView, error) {
	a.record("resolve %s %d %s", changeID, seq, req.Resolution)
	return core.EffectView{ChangeID: changeID, Seq: seq, State: core.EffectAccepted}, nil
}

	h.clients.Add(testHost, agent)

	if err != nil || res.Change != nil || res.Plan == nil || res.Plan.PlanID != pl.PlanID {
		t.Fatalf("Repair = %+v, %v; want the agent's plan", res, err)
	}
	var host, action, repairs string
	var version int
	if err := h.db.Read().QueryRow("SELECT host_id, action, version, repairs FROM core_plan_index WHERE plan_id = ?", pl.PlanID).
		Scan(&host, &action, &version, &repairs); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("plan index row: %v", err)
	}
	if host != testHost || action != refSet.Name || version != 1 || repairs != target.ID {
		t.Errorf("plan index row = %s %s %d repairs %s", host, action, version, repairs)
	}
	if v, err := d.Apply(ctx, alice, testHost, refSet, pl.PlanID, core.ApplyOptions{}); err != nil || v.State != core.StatePending {
		t.Errorf("Apply of the relayed plan = %+v, %v; want pending", v, err)
	}

	agent.plan = nil
	res, err = d.Repair(ctx, alice, target.ID, core.RepairRequest{})
	if err != nil || res.Plan != nil || res.Change == nil || res.Change.State != core.StateUndoing {
		t.Errorf("Repair = %+v, %v; want the agent's undoing change", res, err)
	}
	want := []string{
		`repair ` + target.ID + ` by user:alice, input {"outcome":"keep"}, step "" as ""`,
		`repair ` + target.ID + ` by user:alice, input , step "" as ""`,
	}
	if got := agent.recorded(); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Errorf("agent calls\n got %q\nwant %q", got, want)
	}
}

func TestReleasingCompositeRefusesChildRepairs(t *testing.T) {
	h, d := newDispatcher(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	child := h.applyAgent(d, "a", core.ApplyOptions{ConfirmNow: true})
	agent := &opsAgent{AgentClient: h.rt, view: child}
	h.clients.Add(testHost, agent)
	opsComposite(t, h, "01COMPOSITE", child.ID, core.StateReleasing)

	_, err := d.Repair(ctx, alice, child.ID, core.RepairRequest{})
	if e := wantCode(t, err, errcode.ChangeBusy); !strings.Contains(e.Detail, "01COMPOSITE") {
		t.Errorf("detail %q does not name the composite", e.Detail)
	}
	// A repair plan of the child indexed before the release began.
	if _, err := h.db.Writer().Exec(`INSERT INTO core_plan_index (plan_id, host_id, action, version, expires_at, repairs)
		VALUES ('01REPAIRPLAN', ?, ?, 1, '2026-10-17T12:10:00.000000000Z', ?)`, testHost, refSet.Name, child.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, err = d.Apply(ctx, alice, testHost, refSet, "01REPAIRPLAN", core.ApplyOptions{})
	_ = wantCode(t, err, errcode.ChangeBusy)
	if n := h.count("SELECT applied FROM core_plan_index WHERE plan_id = '01REPAIRPLAN'"); n != 0 {
		t.Errorf("a refused repair plan was marked applied")
	}
	if got := agent.recorded(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("a refused repair reached the agent: %q", got)
	}

	if _, err := h.db.Writer().Exec("UPDATE core_changes SET state = ? WHERE id = '01COMPOSITE'", core.StateAbandoned); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if res, err := d.Repair(ctx, alice, child.ID, core.RepairRequest{}); err != nil || res.Change == nil {
		t.Errorf("Repair once the composite is abandoned = %+v, %v; want the agent's answer", res, err)
	}
}
```
