```go
package dispatch

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

var _ core.DispatcherChangeOps = (*Dispatcher)(nil)

// changeSide finds where changeID lives: on the controller engine, with a
// nil client, or on the agent of hostID that core_change_index names or that
// holds it.
func (d *Dispatcher) changeSide(ctx context.Context, changeID string) (string, core.AgentClient, error) {
	_, err := d.cfg.Engine.Change(ctx, changeID)
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		return "", nil, nil
	case !isChangeNotFound(err):
		return "", nil, err
	}
	return d.owner(ctx, changeID)
}

// Undo undoes a change where it lives, then ingests its host's journal. The
// operator's undo carries no call context; only a composite's unwind does.
func (d *Dispatcher) Undo(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	hostID, c, err := d.changeSide(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		return d.cfg.Engine.Undo(ctx, p, changeID, nil)
	}
	v, err := c.Undo(ctx, p, changeID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return v, err
	}
	d.ingest(ctx, hostID)
	return checkChange(v, hostID, changeID)
}

// Repair repairs a change where it lives (spec 1.3). A plan it answers is
// indexed with the change it repairs, so the client applies it through the
// ordinary apply route. A step of a composite being released is refused:
// the release decides that step.
func (d *Dispatcher) Repair(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, req core.RepairRequest) (core.RepairResult, error) {
	if err := d.refuseReleasingParent(ctx, changeID); err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	hostID, c, err := d.changeSide(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	var res core.RepairResult
	if c == nil {
		res, err = d.cfg.Engine.Repair(ctx, p, changeID, req)
	} else {
		res, err = c.Repair(ctx, p, changeID, req)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return core.RepairResult{}, err
	}
	switch {
	case res.Change != nil && res.Plan == nil:
		if c == nil {
			return res, nil
		}
		d.ingest(ctx, hostID)
		v, err := checkChange(*res.Change, hostID, changeID)
		if err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		res.Change = &v
		return res, nil
	case res.Plan != nil && res.Change == nil:
		if res.Plan.HostID != hostID {
			return core.RepairResult{}, fmt.Errorf("dispatch: repair of change %s on %q answered with a plan on %q",
				changeID, hostID, res.Plan.HostID)
		}
		if err := d.rememberRepair(ctx, hostID, *res.Plan, changeID); err != nil {
			return core.RepairResult{}, err
		}
		return res, nil
	}
	return core.RepairResult{}, fmt.Errorf("dispatch: repair of change %s answered neither a change nor a plan, or both", changeID)
}

// Release gives up a change where it lives, then ingests its host's journal.
func (d *Dispatcher) Release(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID, reason string) (core.ReleaseResult, error) {
	hostID, c, err := d.changeSide(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		return d.cfg.Engine.Release(ctx, p, changeID, reason, nil)
	}
	res, err := c.Release(ctx, p, changeID, reason, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, err
	}
	d.ingest(ctx, hostID)
	if res.Change, err = checkChange(res.Change, hostID, changeID); err != nil {
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, err
	}
	return res, nil
}

// Effects lists a change's effects where it lives.
func (d *Dispatcher) Effects(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) ([]core.EffectView, error) {
	_, c, err := d.changeSide(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		return d.cfg.Engine.Effects(ctx, changeID)
	}
	return c.Effects(ctx, p, changeID)
}

// Observe reads one effect's resource where its change lives.
func (d *Dispatcher) Observe(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int) (core.ObserveResult, error) {
	_, c, err := d.changeSide(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ObserveResult{}, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		return d.cfg.Engine.Observe(ctx, p, changeID, seq)
	}
	return c.Observe(ctx, p, changeID, seq)
}

// Resolve resolves an effect where its change lives, then ingests its
// host's journal.
func (d *Dispatcher) Resolve(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string, seq int, req core.ResolveRequest) (core.EffectView, error) {
	hostID, c, err := d.changeSide(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.EffectView{}, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		return d.cfg.Engine.Resolve(ctx, p, changeID, seq, req)
	}
	v, err := c.Resolve(ctx, p, changeID, seq, req)
	if err != nil {
		return v, err
	}
	d.ingest(ctx, hostID)
	return v, nil
}

// Steps lists a composite's steps. Composites run on the controller, so an
// agent change has none.
func (d *Dispatcher) Steps(ctx context.Context, _ core.Principal, changeID string) ([]core.StepView, error) {
	_, c, err := d.changeSide(ctx, changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		return d.cfg.Engine.Steps(ctx, changeID)
	}
	return []core.StepView{}, nil
}

// refuseReleasingParent answers core.change_busy when changeID is the child
// of a composite being released.
func (d *Dispatcher) refuseReleasingParent(ctx context.Context, changeID string) error {
	var parent string
	err := d.cfg.DB.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT s.change_id FROM core_composite_steps s
		JOIN core_changes c ON c.id = s.change_id
		WHERE s.child_change_id = ? AND c.state = ? LIMIT 1`, changeID, core.StateReleasing).Scan(&parent)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return nil
	case err != nil:
		return fmt.Errorf("dispatch: read composite steps: %w", err)
	}
	return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeBusy,
		fmt.Sprintf("change %s is a step of composite %s, which is being released", changeID, parent))
}

// refuseReleasingRepair refuses the apply of a repair plan whose target is a
// step of a composite being released. planFor has checked the plan's row.
func (d *Dispatcher) refuseReleasingRepair(ctx context.Context, planID string) error {
	var repairs sql.NullString
	if err := d.cfg.DB.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx,
		"SELECT repairs FROM core_plan_index WHERE plan_id = ?", planID).Scan(&repairs); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("dispatch: read plan index: %w", err)
	}
	if !repairs.Valid {
		return nil
	}
	return d.refuseReleasingParent(ctx, repairs.String)
}

// rememberRepair indexes a repair plan as remember indexes any plan, with the
// change it repairs.
func (d *Dispatcher) rememberRepair(ctx context.Context, hostID string, v core.PlanView, target string) error {
	cutoff := d.cfg.Clock.Now().Add(-PlanIndexRetention).UTC().Format(timeFormat)
	err := d.cfg.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			"DELETE FROM core_plan_index WHERE applied = 0 AND expires_at <= ?", cutoff); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`INSERT INTO core_plan_index (plan_id, host_id, action, version, expires_at, repairs) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
			v.PlanID, hostID, v.Action, v.Version, v.ExpiresAt.UTC().Format(timeFormat), target)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("dispatch: index repair plan %s: %w", v.PlanID, err)
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
	d.ObserveFunc = func(_ context.Context, _ core.Principal, id string, seq int) (core.ObserveResult, error) {
		*got = append(*got, fmt.Sprintf("Observe %s %d", id, seq))
		return core.ObserveResult{Effect: changeOpsEffect, Allowed: []string{core.ResolutionAccept},
			Observation: core.ObservationView{Current: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage(`{"n":2}`)}, Matches: 2}}, nil
	}
	d.ResolveFunc = func(_ context.Context, _ core.Principal, id string, seq int, req core.ResolveRequest) (core.EffectView, error) {
		*got = append(*got, fmt.Sprintf("Resolve %s %d %s %s", id, seq, req.Resolution, req.Resource))
		return changeOpsEffect, nil
	}
	d.StepsFunc = func(_ context.Context, _ core.Principal, id string) ([]core.StepView, error) {
		*got = append(*got, "Steps "+id)
		return nil, nil
	}
}

func TestChangeOperationRoutes(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	var last call
	h.stubDispatcher(&last)
	var got []string
	h.changeOpsStub(&got)
	token := h.token(core.ScopeAdmin)
	undoing := `{"id":"c7","hostId":"h1","action":"demo.item.add","version":1,"class":"revertible","state":"undoing",` +
		`"actor":"user:u1","createdAt":"2026-10-17T12:05:00Z","updatedAt":"2026-10-17T12:05:00Z","revertDeadline":null,` +
		`"output":null,"error":null,"compensatedBy":null,"parentChangeId":null,"owner":"undo","repairedBy":null,` +
		`"repairOutcome":null,"override":null}`
	plan := `{"plan":{"planId":"rp1","hostId":"h1","action":"demo.item.repair","version":1,"inputHash":"h","diff":[],` +
		`"guards":[],"expiresAt":"2026-10-17T12:15:00Z","confirmation":null}}`
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		method, path, body string
		status             int
		call               string
		answer             []string
	}{
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/undo", "", 202, "Undo c7", []string{undoing}},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/cdone/undo", "", 200, "Undo cdone", []string{`"state":"reverted"`}},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/repair", `{"input":{"outcome":"keep"}}`, 200,
			`Repair c7 input={"outcome":"keep"} step= as=`, []string{plan}},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c8/repair", `{}`, 202, "Repair c8 input= step= as=",
			[]string{`{"change":{"id":"c8",`, `"state":"undoing"`}},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c9/repair", `{"step":"db","as":"applied"}`, 202, "Repair c9 input= step=db as=applied",
			[]string{`{"change":{"id":"c9",`}},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/release", `{"reason":"host rebuilt"}`, 200, "Release c7 host rebuilt",
			[]string{`{"change":{"id":"c7",`, `"state":"abandoned"`, `"abandoned":[{"changeId":"c7","seq":2,`}},
		{"GET", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects", "", 200, "Effects c7", []string{`{"effects":[{"changeId":"c7","seq":2,`}},
		{"GET", "/api/v1/changes/c8/effects", "", 200, "Effects c8", []string{`{"effects":[]}`}},
		{"GET", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects/2/observe", "", 200, "Observe c7 2", []string{`"allowed":["accept"]`, `"matches":2`}},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects/2/resolve", `{"resolution":"reconcile","resource":"demo.item:i2"}`, 200,
			"Resolve c7 2 reconcile demo.item:i2", []string{`{"changeId":"c7","seq":2,`}},
		{"GET", "/api/v1/changes/c7/steps", "", 200, "Steps c7", []string{`{"steps":[]}`}},
	} {
		got = nil
		rec := h.serve(withToken(request(tc.method, tc.path, tc.body), token))
		if rec.Code != tc.status {
			t.Errorf("%s %s: %d %s, want %d", tc.method, tc.path, rec.Code, rec.Body, tc.status)
			continue
		}
		if len(got) != 1 || got[0] != tc.call {
			t.Errorf("%s %s: dispatched %q, want %q", tc.method, tc.path, got, tc.call)
		}
		for _, want := range tc.answer {
			if !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
				t.Errorf("%s %s: answer %s lacks %s", tc.method, tc.path, rec.Body, want)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestChangeOperationScopes(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	var last call
	h.stubDispatcher(&last)
	var got []string
	h.changeOpsStub(&got)
	tokens := map[core.Scope]string{}
	for _, s := range []core.Scope{core.ScopeRead, core.ScopeOperate, core.ScopeAdmin} {
		tokens[s] = h.token(s)
	}
	// c7 is a change of the agent-side revertible demo.item.add, c1 of the
	// controller-side compensable demo.item.remove.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		method, path, body string
		need               core.Scope
	}{
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/undo", "", core.ScopeOperate},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c1/undo", "", core.ScopeAdmin},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/repair", `{}`, core.ScopeOperate},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c1/repair", `{}`, core.ScopeAdmin},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/release", `{"reason":"r"}`, core.ScopeAdmin},
		{"GET", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects/2/observe", "", core.ScopeAdmin},
		{"POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects/2/resolve", `{"resolution":"accept"}`, core.ScopeAdmin},
		{"GET", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects", "", core.ScopeRead},
		{"GET", "/api/v1/changes/c7/steps", "", core.ScopeRead},
	} {
		for scope, token := range tokens {
			got = nil
			rec := h.serve(withToken(request(tc.method, tc.path, tc.body), token))
			if scope.Allows(tc.need) {
				if (rec.Code != http.StatusOK && rec.Code != http.StatusAccepted) || len(got) != 1 {
					t.Errorf("%s %s with %s: %d %s, dispatched %q", tc.method, tc.path, scope, rec.Code, rec.Body, got)
				}
				continue
			}
			p := decodeProblem(t, rec, 403, errcode.Forbidden)
			if p.Detail != "this request needs the "+string(tc.need)+" scope" || len(got) != 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s %s with %s: detail %q, dispatched %q", tc.method, tc.path, scope, p.Detail, got)
			}
		}
	}
}

	for _, id := range []string{"cbg", "missing"} {
		for _, rt := range []struct{ method, op, body string }{
			{"POST", "undo", ""},

			{"POST", "release", `{"reason":"r"}`},

func TestChangeOperationBodies(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	var last call
	h.stubDispatcher(&last)
	var got []string
	h.changeOpsStub(&got)
	token := h.token(core.ScopeAdmin)
	repair, release := "/api/v1/changes/c7/repair", "/api/v1/changes/c7/release"
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, method, path, body string
		status                   int
		code                     errcode.Code
		field                    string
	}{
		{"step without as", "POST", repair, `{"step":"db"}`, 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "/as"},
		{"as without step", "POST", repair, `{"as":"reverted"}`, 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "/step"},
		{"unknown decision", "POST", repair, `{"step":"db","as":"undone"}`, 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "/as"},
		{"input with a step", "POST", repair, `{"input":{"a":1},"step":"db","as":"applied"}`, 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "/input"},
		{"input not an object", "POST", repair, `{"input":[1]}`, 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "/input"},
		{"unknown repair field", "POST", repair, `{"force":true}`, 400, errcode.InvalidJSON, ""},
		{"no repair body", "POST", repair, "", 415, errcode.UnsupportedMediaType, ""},
		{"empty reason", "POST", release, `{"reason":""}`, 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "/reason"},
		{"long reason", "POST", release, `{"reason":"` + strings.Repeat("é", 501) + `"}`, 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "/reason"},
		{"unknown resolution", "POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects/2/resolve", `{"resolution":"ignore"}`, 422,
			errcode.InvalidInput, "/resolution"},
		{"zero seq", "GET", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects/0/observe", "", 422, errcode.InvalidInput, "seq"},
		{"seq not a number", "POST", "/api/v1/changes/c7/effects/x/resolve", `{"resolution":"accept"}`, 422,
			errcode.InvalidInput, "seq"},
	} {
		got = nil
		rec := h.serve(withToken(request(tc.method, tc.path, tc.body), token))
		p := decodeProblem(t, rec, tc.status, tc.code)
		if tc.field != "" && (len(p.Errors) != 1 || p.Errors[0].Path != tc.field) {
			t.Errorf("%s: errors %+v, want one at %s", tc.name, p.Errors, tc.field)
		}
		if len(got) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s: dispatched %q", tc.name, got)
		}
	}
	// 500 characters of two bytes each are accepted.
	got = nil
	rec := h.serve(withToken(request("POST", release, `{"reason":"`+strings.Repeat("é", 500)+`"}`), token))
	if rec.Code != 200 || len(got) != 1 {
		t.Errorf("a 500-character reason: %d %s, dispatched %q", rec.Code, rec.Body, got)
	}
}

func TestOpenAPIDocumentsChangeOperations(t *testing.T) {
	reg, err := core.NewRegistry(demoModule{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	doc, err := schema.OpenAPI(reg, Routes())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// A property's schema may be the boolean true (any value), so each one
	// is decoded on its own.
	var d struct {
		Paths      map[string]map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"paths"`
		Components struct {
			Schemas map[string]struct {
				Properties map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"properties"`
			} `json:"schemas"`
		} `json:"components"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(doc, &d); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	enum := func(prop json.RawMessage) []string {
		var s struct {
			Enum []string `json:"enum"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(prop, &s); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("property schema %s: %v", prop, err)
		}
		return s.Enum
	}
	for path, method := range map[string]string{
		"/api/v1/changes/{id}/undo":                 "post",
		"/api/v1/changes/{id}/repair":               "post",
		"/api/v1/changes/{id}/release":              "post",
		"/api/v1/changes/{id}/effects":              "get",
		"/api/v1/changes/{id}/effects/{seq}/observe": "get",
		"/api/v1/changes/{id}/effects/{seq}/resolve": "post",
		"/api/v1/changes/{id}/steps":                "get",
	} {
		if _, ok := d.Paths[path][method]; !ok {
			t.Errorf("the document lacks %s %s", method, path)
		}
	}
	props := d.Components.Schemas["Change"].Properties
	for _, name := range []string{"parentChangeId", "owner", "repairedBy", "repairOutcome", "override"} {
		if _, ok := props[name]; !ok {
			t.Errorf("the Change schema lacks %s", name)
		}
	}
	states, classes := enum(props["state"]), enum(props["class"])
	if !slices.Contains(states, core.StateNeedsRepair) || !slices.Contains(classes, string(core.ClassComposite)) {
		t.Errorf("Change state enum %v and class enum %v lack the lifecycle values", states, classes)
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the implementation**

**3a. Create `internal/controller/api/changes.go`:**

```go
package api

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
)

// maxReleaseReason is the longest release reason, in characters (spec 1.3).
const maxReleaseReason = 500

// repairRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/changes/{id}/repair: input for
// a RepairedBy plan, or a composite step decision, or neither.
type repairRequest struct {
	Input json.RawMessage `json:"input"`
	Step  string          `json:"step"`
	As    string          `json:"as"`
}

// repairResponse holds the change a repair started or the plan it made.
type repairResponse struct {
	Change *changeResponse `json:"change,omitempty"`
	Plan   *planResponse   `json:"plan,omitempty"`
}

type releaseRequest struct {
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

type releaseResponse struct {
	Change    changeResponse    `json:"change"`
	Abandoned []core.EffectView `json:"abandoned"`
}

type effectsResponse struct {
	Effects []core.EffectView `json:"effects"`
}

type stepsResponse struct {
	Steps []core.StepView `json:"steps"`
}

type resolveRequest struct {
	Resolution string `json:"resolution"`
	Resource   string `json:"resource"`
}

// request checks a repair body. An input must be an object, and a step
// decision names the step and reverted or applied, never with an input.
func (b repairRequest) request() (core.RepairRequest, error) {
	input := bytes.TrimSpace(b.Input)
	if bytes.Equal(input, []byte("null")) {
		input = nil
	}
	switch {
	case len(input) > 0 && input[0] != '{':
		return core.RepairRequest{}, invalidField("/input", "must be an object")
	case len(input) > 0 && b.Step != "":
		return core.RepairRequest{}, invalidField("/input", "not allowed with step")
	case b.Step == "" && b.As != "":
		return core.RepairRequest{}, invalidField("/step", "required with as")
	case b.Step != "" && b.As != "reverted" && b.As != "applied":
		return core.RepairRequest{}, invalidField("/as", "must be reverted or applied")
	}
	return core.RepairRequest{Input: input, Step: b.Step, As: b.As}, nil
}

// visibleChange authorizes need, then reads the route's change as the
// caller; a change the network hides is answered as missing.
func (s *Server) visibleChange(r *http.Request, need core.Scope) (core.Principal, core.ChangeView, error) {
	c, _ := callerFrom(r.Context())
	if err := authorize(c.principal, need); err != nil {
		return c.principal, core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	id := r.PathValue("id")
	v, err := s.cfg.Dispatcher.Change(r.Context(), c.principal, id)
	if err == nil && !s.networkVisible(v) {
		err = errHiddenChange(id)
	}
	return c.principal, v, err
}

// effectSeq reads an effect route's {seq}, a positive integer.
func effectSeq(r *http.Request) (int, error) {
	seq, err := strconv.Atoi(r.PathValue("seq"))
	if err != nil || seq < 1 {
		return 0, invalidField("seq", "must be a positive integer")
	}
	return seq, nil
}

// handleUndo needs the scope of the change's own action, as confirm and
// revert do. It answers 202 with the change undoing, or 200 when the change
// was already reverted.
func (s *Server) handleUndo(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, v, err := s.visibleChange(r, core.ScopeRead)
	if err == nil {
		err = s.authorizeChange(p, v)
	}
	if err == nil {
		v, err = s.cfg.Dispatcher.Undo(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"))
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeProblem(w, s.log, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusAccepted
	if v.State == core.StateReverted {
		status = http.StatusOK
	}
	writeJSON(w, s.log, status, toChange(v))
}

// handleRepair needs the scope of the change's own action. It answers 202
// with the change a repair started, or 200 with the plan it made, which the
// client applies through the ordinary apply route.
func (s *Server) handleRepair(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, v, err := s.visibleChange(r, core.ScopeRead)
	if err == nil {
		err = s.authorizeChange(p, v)
	}
	var body repairRequest
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeBody(w, r, &body)
	}
	var req core.RepairRequest
	if err == nil {
		req, err = body.request()
	}
	var res core.RepairResult
	if err == nil {
		res, err = s.cfg.Dispatcher.Repair(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), req)
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeProblem(w, s.log, err)
		return
	}
	switch {
	case res.Change != nil:
		ch := toChange(*res.Change)
		writeJSON(w, s.log, http.StatusAccepted, repairResponse{Change: &ch})
	case res.Plan != nil:
		pl := toPlan(*res.Plan)
		writeJSON(w, s.log, http.StatusOK, repairResponse{Plan: &pl})
	default:
		writeProblem(w, s.log, fmt.Errorf("api: the repair of change %s answered neither a change nor a plan", r.PathValue("id")))
	}
}

func (s *Server) handleRelease(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, _, err := s.visibleChange(r, core.ScopeAdmin)
	var body releaseRequest
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeBody(w, r, &body)
	}
	if n := utf8.RuneCountInString(body.Reason); err == nil && (n < 1 || n > maxReleaseReason) {
		err = invalidField("/reason", fmt.Sprintf("must be 1 to %d characters", maxReleaseReason))
	}
	var res core.ReleaseResult
	if err == nil {
		res, err = s.cfg.Dispatcher.Release(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), body.Reason)
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeProblem(w, s.log, err)
		return
	}
	abandoned := res.Abandoned
	if abandoned == nil {
		abandoned = []core.EffectView{}
	}
	writeJSON(w, s.log, http.StatusOK, releaseResponse{Change: toChange(res.Change), Abandoned: abandoned})
}

func (s *Server) handleEffects(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, _, err := s.visibleChange(r, core.ScopeRead)
	var effects []core.EffectView
	if err == nil {
		effects, err = s.cfg.Dispatcher.Effects(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"))
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeProblem(w, s.log, err)
		return
	}
	if effects == nil {
		effects = []core.EffectView{}
	}
	writeJSON(w, s.log, http.StatusOK, effectsResponse{Effects: effects})
}

func (s *Server) handleObserve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, _, err := s.visibleChange(r, core.ScopeAdmin)
	var seq int
	if err == nil {
		seq, err = effectSeq(r)
	}
	var res core.ObserveResult
	if err == nil {
		res, err = s.cfg.Dispatcher.Observe(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), seq)
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeProblem(w, s.log, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, s.log, http.StatusOK, res)
}

func (s *Server) handleResolve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, _, err := s.visibleChange(r, core.ScopeAdmin)
	var seq int
	if err == nil {
		seq, err = effectSeq(r)
	}
	var body resolveRequest
	if err == nil {
		err = decodeBody(w, r, &body)
	}
	if err == nil && body.Resolution != core.ResolutionAccept && body.Resolution != core.ResolutionReconcile {
		err = invalidField("/resolution", "must be accept or reconcile")
	}
	var v core.EffectView
	if err == nil {
		v, err = s.cfg.Dispatcher.Resolve(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"), seq,
			core.ResolveRequest{Resolution: body.Resolution, Resource: body.Resource})
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeProblem(w, s.log, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, s.log, http.StatusOK, v)
}

func (s *Server) handleSteps(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p, _, err := s.visibleChange(r, core.ScopeRead)
	var steps []core.StepView
	if err == nil {
		steps, err = s.cfg.Dispatcher.Steps(r.Context(), p, r.PathValue("id"))
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeProblem(w, s.log, err)
		return
	}
	if steps == nil {
		steps = []core.StepView{}
	}
	writeJSON(w, s.log, http.StatusOK, stepsResponse{Steps: steps})
}
```

```go
var changeStates = []string{
```

```go
func toChange(v core.ChangeView) changeResponse {

		State: v.State, Actor: v.Actor, CreatedAt: v.CreatedAt, UpdatedAt: v.UpdatedAt, RevertDeadline: v.RevertDeadline,

		Override: orNull(v.Override)}
	if v.Error != nil {
```

Replace `changeWire` and `changeErrorWire` with:

```go
// changeWire is the API's Change. A change from the agent socket is
// converted to it, so --json prints the same object either way. The
// lifecycle fields of spec 1.3 are left out when unset: the agent socket's
// change has none of them, and its --json stays as it was.
type changeWire struct {
	ID             string           `json:"id"`
	HostID         *string          `json:"hostId"`
	Action         string           `json:"action"`
	Version        int              `json:"version"`
	Class          core.Class       `json:"class"`
	State          string           `json:"state"`
	Actor          string           `json:"actor"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time        `json:"createdAt"`
	UpdatedAt      time.Time        `json:"updatedAt"`
	RevertDeadline *time.Time       `json:"revertDeadline"`
	Output         json.RawMessage  `json:"output"`
	Error          *changeErrorWire `json:"error"`
	CompensatedBy  *string          `json:"compensatedBy"`
	ParentChangeID *string          `json:"parentChangeId,omitempty"`
	Owner          *string          `json:"owner,omitempty"`
	RepairedBy     *string          `json:"repairedBy,omitempty"`
	RepairOutcome  *string          `json:"repairOutcome,omitempty"`
	Override       json.RawMessage  `json:"override,omitempty"`
}

type changeErrorWire struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
	Cause   string `json:"cause,omitempty"`
}

// changePoll is how often the CLI reads a change it waits for (spec 1.6:
// every second). It is a variable so tests can shorten it.
var changePoll = time.Second

// waitChange reads change ch again every changePoll while its state is one
// of busy, and returns its last view and JSON.
func waitChange(ctx context.Context, c *client, ch changeWire, raw json.RawMessage, busy ...string) (changeWire, json.RawMessage, error) {
	for slices.Contains(busy, ch.State) {
		t := time.NewTimer(changePoll)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Stop()
			return changeWire{}, nil, ctx.Err()
		case <-t.C:
		}
		var next json.RawMessage
		if err := c.do(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/changes/"+url.PathEscape(ch.ID), nil, &next); err != nil {
			return changeWire{}, nil, err
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(next, &ch); err != nil {
			return changeWire{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("decode the change: %w", err)
		}
		raw = next
	}
	return ch, raw, nil
}
```

```go
// printChange writes a change's state, how to confirm a pending one, who
// owns it, how it was repaired, how to repair one that needs it, and its
// output with the note on secret outputs.
func printChange(w io.Writer, ch changeWire, secrets []string) error {
	if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "Change %s: %s\n", sanitize(ch.ID), sanitize(ch.State)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ch.State == core.StatePending && ch.RevertDeadline != nil {
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "Confirm it before %s with: darkpanel change confirm %s\nUnless confirmed by then, it is reverted.\n",
			ch.RevertDeadline.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), sanitize(ch.ID)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if ch.Owner != nil {
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "Owner: %s\n", sanitize(*ch.Owner)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if ch.RepairedBy != nil {
		outcome := ""
		if ch.RepairOutcome != nil {
			outcome = " (" + *ch.RepairOutcome + ")"
		}
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "Repaired by change %s%s\n", sanitize(*ch.RepairedBy), sanitize(outcome)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if ch.State == core.StateNeedsRepair {
		if ch.Error != nil {
			cause := ""
			if ch.Error.Cause != "" {
				cause = ", caused by " + ch.Error.Cause
			}
			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "Needs repair: %s (%s%s)\n",
				sanitize(ch.Error.Message), sanitize(ch.Error.Code), sanitize(cause)); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "Repair it with: darkpanel change repair %s\nOr give it up with: darkpanel change release %s --reason <why>\n",
			sanitize(ch.ID), sanitize(ch.ID)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if len(ch.Output) == 0 || string(ch.Output) == "null" {
		return nil
	}
	if err := render(w, ch.Output); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	noteSecrets(w, secrets, ch.Output)
	return nil
}
```

```go
// changePath is the route of op on change id.
func changePath(id, op string) string {
	return "/api/v1/changes/" + url.PathEscape(id) + "/" + op
}

// decodeChange decodes a Change answer.
func decodeChange(raw json.RawMessage) (changeWire, error) {
	var ch changeWire
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ch); err != nil {
		return changeWire{}, fmt.Errorf("decode the change: %w", err)
	}
	return ch, nil
}

// showChange prints a change: with --json its raw JSON, else printChange.
func showChange(cmd *cobra.Command, ch changeWire, raw json.RawMessage) error {
	if asJSON, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("json"); asJSON {
		_, err := fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "%s\n", raw)
		return err
	}
	return printChange(cmd.OutOrStdout(), ch, nil)
}

// printRaw prints an answer: with --json as it is, else rendered for people.
func printRaw(cmd *cobra.Command, raw json.RawMessage) error {
	if asJSON, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("json"); asJSON {
		_, err := fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "%s\n", raw)
		return err
	}
	return render(cmd.OutOrStdout(), raw)
}

// undoOutcome is the error of an undo or a repair that did not end well:
// the change still needs repair, or failed.
func undoOutcome(ch changeWire) error {
	switch ch.State {
	case core.StateNeedsRepair, core.StateFailed, core.StateInterrupted:
	default:
		return nil
	}
	if ch.Error != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("change %s %s: %s (%s)", ch.ID, ch.State, ch.Error.Message, ch.Error.Code)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("change %s %s", ch.ID, ch.State)
}

// changeUndoCommand is `change undo`. The undo answers at once with the
// change undoing; the command waits until the undo has ended.
func (a *app) changeUndoCommand() *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "undo <id>",
		Short: "Undo a change while no later change took its locks",
		Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			c, err := a.connect(cmd)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			var raw json.RawMessage
			if err := c.do(cmd.Context(), http.MethodPost, changePath(args[0], "undo"), nil, &raw); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			ch, err := decodeChange(raw)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if ch, raw, err = waitChange(cmd.Context(), c, ch, raw, core.StateUndoing); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := showChange(cmd, ch, raw); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return undoOutcome(ch)
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().Bool("json", false, "print the raw JSON answer")
	addConnFlags(cmd, false, false)
	return cmd
}

// changeRepairCommand is `change repair`. The controller answers with the
// change the repair started, which the command waits for, or with a plan of
// the repairing action, which it shows, asks about and applies like any
// plan.
func (a *app) changeRepairCommand() *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "repair <id>",
		Short: "Repair a change that needs repair",
		Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			body, err := repairBody(cmd)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			c, err := a.connect(cmd)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			var res struct {
				Change json.RawMessage `json:"change"`
				Plan   *planWire       `json:"plan"`
			}
			if err := c.do(cmd.Context(), http.MethodPost, changePath(args[0], "repair"), body, &res); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if res.Plan != nil {
				return a.applyRepairPlan(cmd, c, *res.Plan)
			}
			ch, err := decodeChange(res.Change)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			ch, raw, err := waitChange(cmd.Context(), c, ch, res.Change, core.StateUndoing, core.StateApplying)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := showChange(cmd, ch, raw); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return undoOutcome(ch)
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().String("input", "", `options of the repairing action as a JSON object, such as {"outcome":"keep"}`)
	cmd.Flags().String("step", "", "the step of a composite to decide, with --as")
	cmd.Flags().String("as", "", "what the step counts as: reverted or applied")
	cmd.Flags().Bool("yes", false, "apply a repair plan without asking Apply? [y/N]; an irreversible action still needs its confirmation phrase")
	cmd.Flags().String("confirmation", "", "the confirmation phrase a repair plan names, instead of typing it")
	cmd.Flags().Bool("json", false, "print the raw JSON answer")
	addConnFlags(cmd, false, false)
	return cmd
}

// repairBody is the repair request of --input, or of --step and --as.
func repairBody(cmd *cobra.Command) (map[string]any, error) {
	input, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("input")
	step, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("step")
	as, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("as")
	body := map[string]any{}
	switch {
	case input != "" && (step != "" || as != ""):
		return nil, usagef("--input cannot be combined with --step and --as")
	case (step == "") != (as == ""):
		return nil, usagef("--step and --as go together")
	case step != "" && as != "reverted" && as != "applied":
		return nil, usagef("--as must be reverted or applied, not %q", as)
	case step != "":
		body["step"], body["as"] = step, as
	case input != "":
		var obj map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &obj); err != nil || obj == nil {
			return nil, usagef("--input must be a JSON object")
		}
		body["input"] = json.RawMessage(input)
	}
	return body, nil
}

// applyRepairPlan shows a repair plan, asks, and applies it through the
// ordinary apply route of its host and action.
func (a *app) applyRepairPlan(cmd *cobra.Command, c *client, plan planWire) error {
	def, ok := a.opts.Registry.Action(core.ActionRef{Name: plan.Action, Version: plan.Version})
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("the repair plan %s is for %s/v%d, which this darkpanel does not know; apply it through the API",
			sanitize(plan.PlanID), sanitize(plan.Action), plan.Version)
	}
	host := ""
	if plan.HostID != nil {
		host = *plan.HostID
	}
	calls := apiCalls(c, def, host)
	calls.plan = func(context.Context, any) (planWire, error) { return plan, nil }
	ch, raw, err := a.planAndApply(cmd, calls, nil, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := showChange(cmd, ch, raw); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return changeOutcome(ch)
}

func (a *app) changeReleaseCommand() *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "release <id>",
		Short: "Give up a change that needs repair, abandoning its unsettled effects",
		Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			reason, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("reason")
			if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
				return usagef("--reason is required: say why the change is given up")
			}
			c, err := a.connect(cmd)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			var raw json.RawMessage
			if err := c.do(cmd.Context(), http.MethodPost, changePath(args[0], "release"), map[string]any{"reason": reason}, &raw); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			w := cmd.OutOrStdout()
			if asJSON, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("json"); asJSON {
				_, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\n", raw)
				return err
			}
			var res struct {
				Change    changeWire      `json:"change"`
				Abandoned json.RawMessage `json:"abandoned"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &res); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("decode the release: %w", err)
			}
			if err := printChange(w, res.Change, nil); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if _, err := fmt.Fprintln(w, "Abandoned effects:"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return render(w, res.Abandoned)
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().String("reason", "", "why the change is given up, 1 to 500 characters (required)")
	cmd.Flags().Bool("json", false, "print the raw JSON answer")
	addConnFlags(cmd, false, false)
	return cmd
}

func (a *app) changeResolveCommand() *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "resolve <id> accept|reconcile",
		Short: "Resolve an unresolved effect: accept the state found, or reconcile the journal with it",
		Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(2),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			resolution := args[1]
			if resolution != core.ResolutionAccept && resolution != core.ResolutionReconcile {
				return usagef("the resolution is accept or reconcile, not %q", resolution)
			}
			seq, _ := cmd.Flags().GetInt("effect")
			if seq < 1 {
				return usagef("--effect is required: the effect's sequence number, from darkpanel change effects")
			}
			body := map[string]any{"resolution": resolution}
			if resource, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("resource"); resource != "" {
				body["resource"] = resource
			}
			c, err := a.connect(cmd)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			var raw json.RawMessage
			path := changePath(args[0], "effects/"+strconv.Itoa(seq)+"/resolve")
			if err := c.do(cmd.Context(), http.MethodPost, path, body, &raw); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return printRaw(cmd, raw)
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().Int("effect", 0, "the sequence number of the effect to resolve")
	cmd.Flags().String("resource", "", "with reconcile: the candidate object to record when the identity matches several")
	cmd.Flags().Bool("json", false, "print the raw JSON answer")
	addConnFlags(cmd, false, false)
	return cmd
}

func (a *app) changeEffectsCommand() *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "effects <id>",
		Short: "List a change's effects, or observe one with --observe",
		Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			seq, _ := cmd.Flags().GetInt("observe")
			if cmd.Flags().Changed("observe") && seq < 1 {
				return usagef("--observe takes an effect's sequence number, 1 or more")
			}
			c, err := a.connect(cmd)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			path := changePath(args[0], "effects")
			if seq > 0 {
				path += "/" + strconv.Itoa(seq) + "/observe"
			}
			var raw json.RawMessage
			if err := c.do(cmd.Context(), http.MethodGet, path, nil, &raw); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return printRaw(cmd, raw)
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().Int("observe", 0, "observe this effect's resource now, changing nothing: the preview of a resolution")
	cmd.Flags().Bool("json", false, "print the raw JSON answer")
	addConnFlags(cmd, false, false)
	return cmd
}

func (a *app) changeStepsCommand() *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
```

### Task 33: Composite references

**Files:**
- Create: `internal/core/lifecycle/refs.go`
- Create: `internal/core/lifecycle/refs_test.go`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C8 (Task 4)
- Produces: L2 `resolveInputRefs`, `resolveStepRefs`, `stepRefs`.

**Items:** 45

**Depends on:** Task 4

**Implementer:** dr-superpowers:impl-sonnet-low
**Evaluation:** files 1 - spec 0 - coupling 0 - risk 1 = 2

Two passes keep a value from ever becoming a reference. `resolveInputRefs` returns a template still: `${steps…}` references stay, `$${` stays escaped, and every `${` inside a substituted input value is escaped as `$${`. `resolveStepRefs` then resolves the step references and decodes `$${` to `${`, and nothing it substitutes is read again. The final input of every step is therefore `resolveStepRefs(resolveInputRefs(template, input), outputs)`, with `outputs` nil for a step without references (Tasks 34 and 35 call it so). A literal `$` directly before a `${steps…}` reference cannot be told from an escape, so `resolveInputRefs` refuses it.

```go
	}{
		{"missing input path", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input.nope}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.InvalidInput},
		{"input index out of range", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input.l.2}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{"l":[1]}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.InvalidInput},
		{"input index with a leading zero", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input.l.01}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{"l":[1,2]}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.InvalidInput},
		{"an object inside a longer string", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"x${input.o}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{"o":{}}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
		{"an unterminated reference", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input.x"}`), json.RawMessage(`{"x":1}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
		{"an unknown reference", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${env.HOME}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
		{"an empty path segment", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input..x}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
		{"a step reference without output", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${steps.s.result.x}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
		{"a $ before a step reference", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input.p}${steps.s.output.j}"}`), json.RawMessage(`{"p":"x$"}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
		{"a template that is not JSON", func() error {
			_, err := resolveInputRefs(json.RawMessage(`{`), json.RawMessage(`{}`))
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
		{"a step without output", func() error {
			_, err := resolveStepRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${steps.t.output.k}"}`), outputs)
			return err
		}, errcode.ChildFailed},
		{"a missing step path", func() error {
			_, err := resolveStepRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${steps.s.output.k}"}`), outputs)
			return err
		}, errcode.ChildFailed},
		{"a list inside a longer string", func() error {
			_, err := resolveStepRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"x${steps.s.output.o}"}`), outputs)
			return err
		}, errcode.ChildFailed},
		{"an input reference left for the step pass", func() error {
			_, err := resolveStepRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input.x}"}`), outputs)
			return err
		}, errcode.Internal},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			err := tt.run()
			if err == nil || errcode.From(err).Code != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("error %v, want code %s", err, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestStepRefs(t *testing.T) {
	tmpl := `{"b":"${steps.db.output.host}","a":["${steps.auth.output.key}","x${steps.db.output.port}"],` +
		`"c":"$${steps.no.output.x}","d":"${input.y}"}`
	ids, err := stepRefs(json.RawMessage(tmpl))
	if err != nil || !slices.Equal(ids, []string{"auth", "db"}) {
		t.Errorf("stepRefs = %q, %v; want auth and db, in key order", ids, err)
	}
	if ids, err := stepRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${input.x}","b":1}`)); err != nil || len(ids) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("stepRefs without step references = %q, %v", ids, err)
	}
	if _, err := stepRefs(json.RawMessage(`{"a":"${steps.db"}`)); err == nil {
		t.Error("stepRefs accepted an unterminated reference")
	}
}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"maps"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// A step template's strings may hold references (spec 1.3):
// ${input.<path>} and ${steps.<id>.output.<path>}, where <path> is
// dot-separated object keys and array indexes, and $${ is a literal ${.
// Object keys are never templates.

const (
	refsInput = "input"
	refsSteps = "steps"
)

// refsPart is one piece of a template string: literal text, with escapes
// decoded, when kind is empty, else one reference.
type refsPart struct {
	text string
	ref  string   // the reference as written, "${...}"
	kind string   // refsInput or refsSteps
	step string   // a steps reference's step id
	path []string // the path below the input or the step's output
}

// refsParse splits s into literal text and references. A ${ without a
// closing }, or a reference of neither form, is an error: templates are the
// module's, so it is a module bug.
func refsParse(s string) ([]refsPart, error) {
	var parts []refsPart
	var lit strings.Builder
	flush := func() {
		if lit.Len() > 0 {
			parts = append(parts, refsPart{text: lit.String()})
			lit.Reset()
		}
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(s); {
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(s[i:], "$${"):
			lit.WriteString("${")
			i += 3
		case strings.HasPrefix(s[i:], "${"):
			end := strings.IndexByte(s[i:], '}')
			if end < 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: template string %q: unterminated reference at byte %d", s, i)
			}
			p, err := refsReference(s[i : i+end+1])
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			flush()
			parts = append(parts, p)
			i += end + 1
		default:
			lit.WriteByte(s[i])
			i++
		}
	}
	flush()
	return parts, nil
}

// refsReference parses one "${...}".
func refsReference(ref string) (refsPart, error) {
	segs := strings.Split(ref[2:len(ref)-1], ".")
	bad := fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: reference %s: want ${input.<path>} or ${steps.<id>.output.<path>}", ref)
	if slices.Contains(segs, "") {
		return refsPart{}, bad
	}
	switch {
	case len(segs) >= 2 && segs[0] == refsInput:
		return refsPart{ref: ref, kind: refsInput, path: segs[1:]}, nil
	case len(segs) >= 4 && segs[0] == refsSteps && segs[2] == "output":
		return refsPart{ref: ref, kind: refsSteps, step: segs[1], path: segs[3:]}, nil
	}
	return refsPart{}, bad
}

// refsDecode decodes one JSON value, keeping numbers as json.Number so they
// keep their text.
func refsDecode(raw json.RawMessage) (any, error) {
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	dec.UseNumber()
	var v any
	if err := dec.Decode(&v); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := dec.Token(); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, errors.New("more than one JSON value")
	}
	return v, nil
}

// refsEncode encodes v without HTML escaping, because templates are shown
// in clear in the preview.
func refsEncode(v any) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	enc := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	if err := enc.Encode(v); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: encode a step template: %w", err)
	}
	return json.RawMessage(bytes.TrimSuffix(buf.Bytes(), []byte("\n"))), nil
}

// refsWalk replaces every string of v, through objects (in key order) and
// arrays, with what str returns for it.
func refsWalk(v any, str func(string) (any, error)) (any, error) {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case string:
		return str(x)
	case map[string]any:
		out := make(map[string]any, len(x))
		for _, k := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(x)) {
			r, err := refsWalk(x[k], str)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			out[k] = r
		}
		return out, nil
	case []any:
		out := make([]any, len(x))
		for i, e := range x {
			r, err := refsWalk(e, str)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			out[i] = r
		}
		return out, nil
	}
	return v, nil
}

// refsLookup follows path into v; ok is false when a key or an index is
// missing. An index is a decimal number without a leading zero.
func refsLookup(v any, path []string) (any, bool) {
	for _, seg := range path {
		switch node := v.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			next, ok := node[seg]
			if !ok {
				return nil, false
			}
			v = next
		case []any:
			i, err := strconv.Atoi(seg)
			if err != nil || i < 0 || i >= len(node) || strconv.Itoa(i) != seg {
				return nil, false
			}
			v = node[i]
		default:
			return nil, false
		}
	}
	return v, true
}

// refsText is the text a reference inside a longer string stands for: a
// string's own text or a number's JSON text.
func refsText(v any) (string, bool) {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case string:
		return x, true
	case json.Number:
		return x.String(), true
	}
	return "", false
}

// refsEscape escapes every ${ in the strings of v, so that a substituted
// value stays literal in the step pass.
func refsEscape(v any) any {
	out, _ := refsWalk(v, func(s string) (any, error) { return strings.ReplaceAll(s, "${", "$${"), nil })
	return out
}

// resolveInputRefs resolves the ${input...} references of tmpl against the
// composite's input at plan time. The result is still a template:
// ${steps...} references stay, $${ stays escaped, and every ${ a
// substituted value holds is escaped, so a value never becomes a reference.
// A missing input path is request.invalid_input.
func resolveInputRefs(tmpl, input json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	t, err := refsDecode(tmpl)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: step template: %w", err)
	}
	in, err := refsDecode(input)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composite input: %w", err)
	}
	out, err := refsWalk(t, func(s string) (any, error) { return refsInputString(s, in) })
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return refsEncode(out)
}

func refsInputString(s string, input any) (any, error) {
	parts, err := refsParse(s)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(parts) == 1 && parts[0].kind == refsInput {
		v, err := refsInputValue(parts[0], input)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return refsEscape(v), nil
	}
	var out, lit strings.Builder
	flush := func() {
		out.WriteString(strings.ReplaceAll(lit.String(), "${", "$${"))
		lit.Reset()
	}
	for _, p := range parts {
		switch p.kind {
		case "":
			lit.WriteString(p.text)
		case refsInput:
			v, err := refsInputValue(p, input)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			text, ok := refsText(v)
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: reference %s inside a longer string is not a string or a number", p.ref)
			}
			lit.WriteString(text)
		case refsSteps:
			if strings.HasSuffix(lit.String(), "$") {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: template string %q: a $ right before %s cannot be told from an escape", s, p.ref)
			}
			flush()
			out.WriteString(p.ref)
		}
	}
	flush()
	return out.String(), nil
}

func refsInputValue(p refsPart, input any) (any, error) {
	v, ok := refsLookup(input, p.path)
	if !ok {
		return nil, errcode.New(errcode.InvalidInput,
			fmt.Sprintf("the input has no %s, which the step reference %s needs", strings.Join(p.path, "."), p.ref))
	}
	return v, nil
}

// resolveStepRefs resolves the ${steps...} references of tmpl, a template
// resolveInputRefs returned, against the unredacted outputs of the steps it
// follows, keyed by step id, and decodes $${ to ${. A missing step output or
// path, or a value that cannot stand inside a longer string, fails the step
// with core.child_failed.
func resolveStepRefs(tmpl json.RawMessage, outputs map[string]json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	t, err := refsDecode(tmpl)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: step template: %w", err)
	}
	decoded := map[string]any{}
	out, err := refsWalk(t, func(s string) (any, error) { return refsStepString(s, outputs, decoded) })
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return refsEncode(out)
}

func refsStepString(s string, outputs map[string]json.RawMessage, decoded map[string]any) (any, error) {
	parts, err := refsParse(s)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(parts) == 1 && parts[0].kind == refsSteps {
		return refsStepValue(parts[0], outputs, decoded)
	}
	var out strings.Builder
	for _, p := range parts {
		switch p.kind {
		case "":
			out.WriteString(p.text)
		case refsSteps:
			v, err := refsStepValue(p, outputs, decoded)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			text, ok := refsText(v)
			if !ok {
				return nil, errcode.New(errcode.ChildFailed,
					fmt.Sprintf("step %s: %s inside a longer string is not a string or a number", p.step, p.ref))
			}
			out.WriteString(text)
		case refsInput:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: reference %s was not resolved at plan", p.ref)
		}
	}
	return out.String(), nil
}

func refsStepValue(p refsPart, outputs map[string]json.RawMessage, decoded map[string]any) (any, error) {
	out, ok := decoded[p.step]
	if !ok {
		raw, found := outputs[p.step]
		if !found {
			return nil, errcode.New(errcode.ChildFailed, fmt.Sprintf("step %s has no output for %s", p.step, p.ref))
		}
		var err error
		if out, err = refsDecode(raw); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: output of step %s: %w", p.step, err)
		}
		decoded[p.step] = out
	}
	v, ok := refsLookup(out, p.path)
	if !ok {
		return nil, errcode.New(errcode.ChildFailed,
			fmt.Sprintf("the output of step %s has no %s, which %s needs", p.step, strings.Join(p.path, "."), p.ref))
	}
	return v, nil
}

// stepRefs lists the step ids tmpl references, each once, in the order they
// first appear (objects in key order). Escaped text is not a reference.
func stepRefs(tmpl json.RawMessage) ([]string, error) {
	t, err := refsDecode(tmpl)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: step template: %w", err)
	}
	var ids []string
	_, err = refsWalk(t, func(s string) (any, error) {
		parts, err := refsParse(s)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, p := range parts {
			if p.kind == refsSteps && !slices.Contains(ids, p.step) {
				ids = append(ids, p.step)
			}
		}
		return s, nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return ids, nil
}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (

// The composite fixture: module cst holds the step actions, all but one on
// the agent of testHost, and module cfx the composites, which run on a
// controller engine that reaches the agent engine through inprocChildren.
// Each engine has its own database and clock, so advancing the controller's
// clock never fires an agent timer.

var (
	refCstAdd  = core.ActionRef{Name: "cst.item.add", Version: 1}  // compensable, undo handler, converges
	refCstDel  = core.ActionRef{Name: "cst.item.del", Version: 1}  // compensable, forward only, converges
	refCstGet  = core.ActionRef{Name: "cst.item.get", Version: 1}  // read
	refCstWipe = core.ActionRef{Name: "cst.item.wipe", Version: 1} // irreversible
	refCstGate = core.ActionRef{Name: "cst.gate.set", Version: 1}  // revertible
	refCstFix  = core.ActionRef{Name: "cst.gate.fix", Version: 1}  // cst.gate.set's RepairedBy
	refCstNote = core.ActionRef{Name: "cst.note.get", Version: 1}  // controller-side read

	refCfxAdd    = core.ActionRef{Name: "cfx.deploy.add", Version: 1}    // reverse: a, b, c
	refCfxRemove = core.ActionRef{Name: "cfx.deploy.remove", Version: 1} // forward: x, y
	refCfxGate   = core.ActionRef{Name: "cfx.gate.add", Version: 1}      // reverse: read r, a, revertible g
	refCfxBad    = core.ActionRef{Name: "cfx.bad.run", Version: 1}       // reverse, steps set by the test
	refCfxDrop   = core.ActionRef{Name: "cfx.bad.drop", Version: 1}      // forward, steps set by the test

	cfxRoot = core.Principal{Actor: "user:root", UserID: "root", Scope: core.ScopeAdmin, Source: "test"}
)

// cstHost is the state the cst actions manage on testHost.
type cstHost struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	items    map[string]string
	gates    map[string]string
	failures map[string]int // the next n applies of a name fail before they change anything
	blocked  bool           // cst.item.add's free guard fails while set
	onPlan   func(name string)
	onApply  func(name string)
}

func newCstHost() *cstHost {
	return &cstHost{items: map[string]string{}, gates: map[string]string{}, failures: map[string]int{}}
}

func (h *cstHost) failing(name string) bool {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.failures[name] > 0 {
		h.failures[name]--
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (h *cstHost) setBlocked(v bool) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.blocked = v
}

func (h *cstHost) planning(name string) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	f := h.onPlan
	h.mu.Unlock()
	if f != nil {
		f(name)
	}
}

func (h *cstHost) applying(name string) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	f := h.onApply
	h.mu.Unlock()
	if f != nil {
		f(name)
	}
}

func (h *cstHost) item(name string) (string, bool) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	v, ok := h.items[name]
	return v, ok
}

func (h *cstHost) setItem(name, value string) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.items[name] = value
}

func (h *cstHost) gate(name string) (string, bool) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	v, ok := h.gates[name]
	return v, ok
}

type cstIn struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	Value  string `json:"value,omitempty"`
	Secret string `json:"secret,omitempty" secret:"true"`
	Remote bool   `json:"remote,omitempty"` // the add's effect is not Local
}

type cstOut struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Value string `json:"value"`
	Token string `json:"token" secret:"true"`
}

type cstView struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Value string `json:"value"`
}

type cstFixIn struct {
	Outcome string `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
}

type cstFixOut struct {
	RepairOutcome string `json:"repairOutcome"`
}

type cstGateSnap struct {
	Name, Value string
	Present     bool
}

var errCstFailed = errors.New("cst: the apply failed")

func cstJSON(v string) json.RawMessage {
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return b
}

// cstAdd creates an item and journals the creation, so the engine can undo
// it.
type cstAdd struct{ h *cstHost }

func (x cstAdd) Plan(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	x.h.planning(in.Name)
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	diff := []core.DiffLine{{Op: "+", Text: in.Name + "=" + in.Value}}
	if old, ok := x.h.items[in.Name]; ok {
		diff = append([]core.DiffLine{{Op: "-", Text: in.Name + "=" + old}}, diff...)
	}
	return core.PlanOutcome{
		Diff:      diff,
		Guards:    []core.Guard{{ID: "free", OK: !x.h.blocked, Message: "the host is blocked"}},
		StateHash: "item=" + x.h.items[in.Name],
	}, nil
}

func (x cstAdd) Apply(ctx context.Context, env core.Env, in cstIn) (cstOut, error) {
	x.h.applying(in.Name)
	seq, err := env.Effects.Intend(ctx, core.Effect{
		Kind: core.EffectCreate, Resource: "cst.item:?" + in.Name,
		Recovery: &core.RecoveryID{Kind: "name", Value: in.Name},
		Local:    !in.Remote, InverseLocal: true,
		Before: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")},
		After:  &core.StateDoc{State: cstJSON(in.Value)},
	}, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return cstOut{}, err
	}
	if x.h.failing(in.Name) {
		return cstOut{}, errCstFailed
	}
	x.h.setItem(in.Name, in.Value)
	if err := env.Effects.Made(ctx, seq, "cst.item:"+in.Name, core.StateDoc{State: cstJSON(in.Value)}); err != nil {
		return cstOut{}, err
	}
	return cstOut{Name: in.Name, Value: in.Value, Token: "tok-" + in.Name}, nil
}

func (x cstAdd) Verify(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn, _ cstOut) error {
	if v, ok := x.h.item(in.Name); !ok || v != in.Value {
		return errors.New("cst: the item is missing")
	}
	return nil
}

func (x cstAdd) Observe(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.Observation, error) {
	_, identity, _ := strings.Cut(e.Resource, ":")
	name := strings.TrimPrefix(identity, "?")
	v, ok := x.h.item(name)
	if !ok {
		return core.Observation{Current: core.StateDoc{State: json.RawMessage("null")}, Exclusive: true}, nil
	}
	return core.Observation{
		Current: core.StateDoc{State: cstJSON(v)}, Resource: "cst.item:" + name, Matches: 1, Exclusive: true,
	}, nil
}

func (x cstAdd) Inverse(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, e core.Effect) (core.InverseResult, error) {
	_, name, _ := strings.Cut(e.Resource, ":")
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	delete(x.h.items, name)
	return core.InverseResult{}, nil
}

// cstDel removes an item; repeated, it ends in the same state.
type cstDel struct{ h *cstHost }

func (x cstDel) Plan(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	v, ok := x.h.item(in.Name)
	if !ok {
		return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{}, StateHash: "absent"}, nil
	}
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{{Op: "-", Text: in.Name + "=" + v}}, StateHash: "item=" + v}, nil
}

func (x cstDel) Apply(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn) (cstView, error) {
	x.h.applying(in.Name)
	if x.h.failing(in.Name) {
		return cstView{}, errCstFailed
	}
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	delete(x.h.items, in.Name)
	return cstView{Name: in.Name}, nil
}

func (x cstDel) Verify(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn, _ cstView) error {
	if _, ok := x.h.item(in.Name); ok {
		return errors.New("cst: the item is still there")
	}
	return nil
}

type cstGet struct{ h *cstHost }

func (x cstGet) Read(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn) (cstView, error) {
	v, _ := x.h.item(in.Name)
	return cstView{Name: in.Name, Value: v}, nil
}

type cstWipe struct{}

func (cstWipe) Plan(context.Context, core.Env, cstIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{}, StateHash: "wipe", Confirmation: "wipe"}, nil
}

func (cstWipe) Apply(context.Context, core.Env, cstIn) (cstView, error) { return cstView{}, nil }

func (cstWipe) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, cstIn, cstView) error { return nil }

// cstGate sets a gate and reverts it from a snapshot.
type cstGate struct{ h *cstHost }

func (x cstGate) Plan(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	v, _ := x.h.gate(in.Name)
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{{Op: "+", Text: "gate " + in.Name + "=" + in.Value}}, StateHash: "gate=" + v}, nil
}

func (x cstGate) Apply(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn) (cstView, error) {
	x.h.applying(in.Name)
	if x.h.failing(in.Name) {
		return cstView{}, errCstFailed
	}
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	x.h.gates[in.Name] = in.Value
	return cstView{Name: in.Name, Value: in.Value}, nil
}

func (x cstGate) Verify(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn, _ cstView) error {
	if v, ok := x.h.gate(in.Name); !ok || v != in.Value {
		return errors.New("cst: the gate is not set")
	}
	return nil
}

func (x cstGate) Snapshot(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, in cstIn) ([]byte, error) {
	v, ok := x.h.gate(in.Name)
	return json.Marshal(cstGateSnap{Name: in.Name, Value: v, Present: ok})
}

func (x cstGate) Revert(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, snapshot []byte) (core.RevertOutcome, error) {
	var s cstGateSnap
	if err := json.Unmarshal(snapshot, &s); err != nil {
		return core.RevertOutcome{}, err
	}
	x.h.mu.Lock()
	defer x.h.mu.Unlock()
	if s.Present {
		x.h.gates[s.Name] = s.Value
	} else {
		delete(x.h.gates, s.Name)
	}
	return core.RevertOutcome{}, nil
}

type cstFix struct{}

func (cstFix) Plan(context.Context, core.Env, cstFixIn) (core.PlanOutcome, error) {
	return core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{}, StateHash: "fix"}, nil
}

func (cstFix) Apply(context.Context, core.Env, cstFixIn) (cstFixOut, error) {
	return cstFixOut{RepairOutcome: core.RepairKept}, nil
}

func (cstFix) Verify(context.Context, core.Env, cstFixIn, cstFixOut) error { return nil }

type cstNote struct{}

func (cstNote) Read(context.Context, core.Env, cstIn) (cstView, error) { return cstView{}, nil }

type cstModule struct{ h *cstHost }

func (m cstModule) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	return core.Manifest{ID: "cst", Version: 1, Actions: []core.ActionDef{
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refCstAdd.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent,
			LockKeys: []string{"cst"}, Converges: true,
		}, cstAdd{m.h}),
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refCstDel.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent,
			LockKeys: []string{"cst"}, ForwardOnly: true, Converges: true,
		}, cstDel{m.h}),
		core.DefineRead(core.ActionSpec{Name: refCstGet.Name, Version: 1, Side: core.SideAgent}, cstGet{m.h}),
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refCstWipe.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassIrreversible, Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: []string{"cst"},
		}, cstWipe{}),
		core.DefineRevertible(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refCstGate.Name, Version: 1, Side: core.SideAgent, LockKeys: []string{"cst-gate"},
			RepairedBy: refCstFix.Name, ApplyTimeout: 40 * time.Second,
		}, cstGate{m.h}),
		core.DefineMutating(core.ActionSpec{
			Name: refCstFix.Name, Version: 1, Class: core.ClassCompensable, Side: core.SideAgent,
			LockKeys: []string{"cst-gate"}, ForwardOnly: true, Converges: true,
		}, cstFix{}),
		core.DefineRead(core.ActionSpec{Name: refCstNote.Name, Version: 1, Side: core.SideController}, cstNote{}),
	}}
}

type cfxIn struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

type cfxOut struct {
	Steps map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"steps"`
}

type cfxComposer struct{ steps func() []core.Step }

func (c cfxComposer) Steps(context.Context, core.Env, cfxIn) ([]core.Step, error) { return c.steps(), nil }

func (cfxComposer) Output(_ context.Context, _ core.Env, _ cfxIn, steps map[string]json.RawMessage) (cfxOut, error) {
	return cfxOut{Steps: steps}, nil
}

// cfxSteps are the steps of cfx.bad.run and cfx.bad.drop, set by a test.
type cfxSteps struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	steps []core.Step
}

func (s *cfxSteps) set(steps ...core.Step) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.steps = steps
}

func (s *cfxSteps) get() []core.Step {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(s.steps)
}

// cstStep is a step of a cst action on testHost.
func cstStep(id string, ref core.ActionRef, input string, after ...string) core.Step {
	return core.Step{ID: id, Host: testHost, Action: ref, Input: json.RawMessage(input), After: after}
}

type cfxModule struct{ bad *cfxSteps }

func (m cfxModule) Manifest() core.Manifest {
	fixed := func(steps ...core.Step) cfxComposer {
		return cfxComposer{steps: func() []core.Step { return slices.Clone(steps) }}
	}
	return core.Manifest{ID: "cfx", Version: 1, Actions: []core.ActionDef{
		core.DefineComposite(core.ActionSpec{Name: refCfxAdd.Name, Version: 1, Unwind: core.UnwindReverse}, fixed(
			cstStep("a", refCstAdd, `{"name":"${input.name}-a","value":"1"}`),
			cstStep("b", refCstAdd, `{"name":"${input.name}-b","value":"2"}`, "a"),
			cstStep("c", refCstAdd, `{"name":"${input.name}-c","value":"${steps.a.output.name}"}`, "b"),
		)),
		core.DefineComposite(core.ActionSpec{Name: refCfxRemove.Name, Version: 1, Unwind: core.UnwindForward}, fixed(
			cstStep("x", refCstDel, `{"name":"${input.name}-a"}`),
			cstStep("y", refCstDel, `{"name":"${input.name}-b"}`, "x"),
		)),
		core.DefineComposite(core.ActionSpec{Name: refCfxGate.Name, Version: 1, Unwind: core.UnwindReverse}, fixed(
			cstStep("r", refCstGet, `{"name":"${input.name}-a"}`),
			cstStep("a", refCstAdd, `{"name":"${input.name}-a","value":"1"}`, "r"),
			cstStep("g", refCstGate, `{"name":"${input.name}","value":"${steps.a.output.name}"}`, "a"),
		)),
		core.DefineComposite(core.ActionSpec{Name: refCfxBad.Name, Version: 1, Unwind: core.UnwindReverse},
			cfxComposer{steps: m.bad.get}),
		core.DefineComposite(core.ActionSpec{Name: refCfxDrop.Name, Version: 1, Unwind: core.UnwindForward},
			cfxComposer{steps: m.bad.get}),
	}}
}

var errLostAnswer = errors.New("cfx: the answer was lost")

// inprocChildren is the Children of the controller engine: hostID "" is the
// controller engine itself, testHost the agent engine. While unreachable,
// every testHost call answers host.offline; a method named in lose makes
// its call and then answers errLostAnswer once.
type inprocChildren struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	ctrl, agent *Engine
	unreachable bool
	lose        map[string]bool
	calls       []string // "<method> <host>", in call order
}

func (c *inprocChildren) setEngines(ctrl, agent *Engine) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if ctrl != nil {
		c.ctrl = ctrl
	}
	if agent != nil {
		c.agent = agent
	}
}

func (c *inprocChildren) on(method, hostID string) (*Engine, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.calls = append(c.calls, method+" "+hostID)
	switch {
	case hostID == "":
		return c.ctrl, nil
	case hostID != testHost || c.unreachable:
		return nil, errcode.New(errcode.HostOffline, "host "+hostID+" is offline")
	}
	return c.agent, nil
}

// owner finds the engine holding changeID, the agent's first.
func (c *inprocChildren) owner(method, changeID string) (*Engine, error) {
	agent, err := c.on(method, testHost)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := agent.Change(context.Background(), changeID); err == nil {
		return agent, nil
	}
	return c.ctrl, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) answer(method string, err error) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.lose[method] {
		delete(c.lose, method)
		return errLostAnswer
	}
	return err
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Plan(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID string, a core.ActionRef, input json.RawMessage, opts core.PlanOptions) (core.PlanView, error) {
	e, err := c.on("Plan", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanView{}, err
	}
	v, err := e.Plan(ctx, p, a, input, opts)
	if err = c.answer("Plan", err); err != nil {
		return core.PlanView{}, err
	}
	return v, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Apply(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID string, _ core.ActionRef, planID string, opts core.ApplyOptions) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	e, err := c.on("Apply", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	v, err := e.Apply(ctx, p, planID, opts)
	if err = c.answer("Apply", err); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	return v, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Read(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID string, a core.ActionRef, input json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	e, err := c.on("Read", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out, err := e.Read(ctx, p, a, input)
	return out, c.answer("Read", err)
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Confirm(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	e, err := c.owner("Confirm", changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	v, err := e.Confirm(ctx, p, changeID)
	if err = c.answer("Confirm", err); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	return v, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Revert(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	e, err := c.owner("Revert", changeID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	v, err := e.Revert(ctx, p, changeID)
	if err = c.answer("Revert", err); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	return v, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Undo(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID, changeID string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	e, err := c.on("Undo", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	v, err := e.Undo(ctx, p, changeID, call)
	if err = c.answer("Undo", err); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	return v, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Release(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID, changeID, reason string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ReleaseResult, error) {
	e, err := c.on("Release", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, err
	}
	r, err := e.Release(ctx, p, changeID, reason, call)
	if err = c.answer("Release", err); err != nil {
		return core.ReleaseResult{}, err
	}
	return r, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Lookup(ctx context.Context, hostID, planID string, private bool) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	e, err := c.on("Lookup", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	}
	lk, err := e.Lookup(ctx, planID, private)
	if err = c.answer("Lookup", err); err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	}
	return lk, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) Retire(ctx context.Context, hostID, planID string) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	e, err := c.on("Retire", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	}
	lk, err := e.Retire(ctx, planID)
	if err = c.answer("Retire", err); err != nil {
		return core.PlanLookup{}, err
	}
	return lk, nil
}

func (c *inprocChildren) AckPrivate(ctx context.Context, hostID, changeID string, final bool) error {
	e, err := c.on("AckPrivate", hostID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return c.answer("AckPrivate", e.AckPrivate(ctx, changeID, final))
}

// cfxFixture is a controller engine running the cfx composites over an
// agent engine on testHost.
type cfxFixture struct {
	t                     *testing.T
	host                  *cstHost
	bad                   *cfxSteps
	reg                   *core.Registry
	ctrlClock, agentClock *coretest.FakeClock
	ctrlPath, agentPath   string
	ctrlDB, agentDB       *store.DB
	ctrl, agent           *Engine
	kids                  *inprocChildren
}

func newCfxFixture(t *testing.T) *cfxFixture {
	t.Helper()
	host, bad := newCstHost(), &cfxSteps{}
	reg, err := core.NewRegistry(cstModule{host}, cfxModule{bad})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	start := time.Date(2026, 10, 21, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	dir := t.TempDir()
	f := &cfxFixture{
		t: t, host: host, bad: bad, reg: reg,
		ctrlClock: coretest.NewFakeClock(start), agentClock: coretest.NewFakeClock(start),
		ctrlPath: filepath.Join(dir, "controller.db"), agentPath: filepath.Join(dir, "agent.db"),
		kids: &inprocChildren{lose: map[string]bool{}},
	}
	f.openAgent()
	f.openCtrl()
	return f
}

func (f *cfxFixture) openAgent() {
	f.t.Helper()
	f.agentDB = openDBAt(f.t, f.agentPath, store.SideAgent)
	eng, err := New(Config{
		Side: core.SideAgent, Registry: f.reg, Validator: coretest.Validator{}, Journal: NewAgentJournal(f.agentDB),
		Redact: testRedact,
		Base: core.Env{
			HostID: testHost, DB: f.agentDB, Sealer: coretest.Sealer{}, Clock: f.agentClock,
			Log: slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler),
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.t.Cleanup(eng.Close)
	if err := eng.Recover(context.Background()); err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.agent = eng
	f.kids.setEngines(nil, eng)
}

func (f *cfxFixture) ctrlConfig() Config {
	return Config{
		Side: core.SideController, Registry: f.reg, Validator: coretest.Validator{}, Journal: &coretest.MemJournal{},
		Redact: testRedact,
		Base: core.Env{
			DB: f.ctrlDB, Sealer: coretest.Sealer{}, Clock: f.ctrlClock, Log: slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler),
		},
	}
}

// openCtrl opens the controller database and a new controller engine over
// it with inprocChildren, and runs Recover; RecoverComposites is the test's.
func (f *cfxFixture) openCtrl() {
	f.t.Helper()
	f.ctrlDB = openDBAt(f.t, f.ctrlPath, store.SideController)
	eng, err := New(f.ctrlConfig())
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.t.Cleanup(eng.Close)
	f.kids.setEngines(eng, nil)
	eng.SetChildren(f.kids)
	if err := eng.Recover(context.Background()); err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.ctrl = eng
}

// planC plans a composite (or any controller action) as cfxRoot.
func (f *cfxFixture) planC(ref core.ActionRef, input string) (core.PlanView, error) {
	return f.ctrl.Plan(context.Background(), cfxRoot, ref, json.RawMessage(input), core.PlanOptions{})
}
```
