```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
)

// StepsGrace is added to the sum of a composite's step deadlines to bound
// its steps phase (1.3 Deadlines).
const StepsGrace = 5 * time.Minute

// Children is how the composite runner reaches its steps. The dispatcher
// implements it for every host, so a child is planned, applied, indexed and
// ingested like an operator's change; hostID is empty for a controller-side
// child.
type Children interface {
	Plan(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID string, a core.ActionRef, input json.RawMessage, opts core.PlanOptions) (core.PlanView, error)
	Apply(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID string, a core.ActionRef, planID string, opts core.ApplyOptions) (core.ChangeView, error)
	Read(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID string, a core.ActionRef, input json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
	Confirm(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) (core.ChangeView, error)
	Revert(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, changeID string) (core.ChangeView, error)
	Undo(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID, changeID string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ChangeView, error)
	Release(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID, changeID, reason string, call *core.CallContext) (core.ReleaseResult, error)
	Lookup(ctx context.Context, hostID, planID string, private bool) (core.PlanLookup, error)
	Retire(ctx context.Context, hostID, planID string) (core.PlanLookup, error)
	AckPrivate(ctx context.Context, hostID, changeID string, final bool) error
}

// SetChildren gives the engine the children its composites run through.
// The controller calls it once, before RecoverComposites; an engine without
// children refuses composites.
func (e *Engine) SetChildren(c Children) {
	e.compMu.Lock()
	defer e.compMu.Unlock()
	e.children = c
}

func (e *Engine) kids() (Children, error) {
	e.compMu.Lock()
	defer e.compMu.Unlock()
	if e.children == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composites need children; SetChildren was not called")
	}
	return e.children, nil
}

var stepIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$`)

// stepRefPattern is a string that is exactly one ${steps...} reference.
var stepRefPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{steps\.[a-z][a-z0-9]*\.output\.[^${}]+\}$`)

// redactedText is what Config.Redact writes in place of a secret.
const redactedText = "[redacted]"

// plannedStep is one step of a composite after its plan-time checks;
// Template is its input with ${input...} resolved.
type plannedStep struct {
	Step     core.Step
	Ordinal  int
	Def      core.ActionDef
	Template json.RawMessage
	Refs     []string
}

// compositePlan is a composite's plan (1.3 Preview). It checks the Steps
// result, resolves ${input...}, and dry-runs every step without an output
// reference as p. The dry-runs' guards join the composite's, prefixed with
// the step id, and their diff lines carry "[<step id>]". The state hash is
// SHA-256 over the input and each dry-run's input hash, diff and guards,
// which stand for its state hash because a plan view does not carry one.
// Dry-run plans are never applied; they expire unused.
func (e *Engine) compositePlan(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, def core.ActionDef, input json.RawMessage) (core.PlanOutcome, []plannedStep, error) {
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanOutcome{}, nil, err
	}
	steps, err := e.compositeSteps(ctx, p, def, input)
	if err != nil {
		return core.PlanOutcome{}, nil, err
	}
	ordinal := map[string]int{}
	for _, s := range steps {
		ordinal[s.Step.ID] = s.Ordinal
	}
	out := core.PlanOutcome{Diff: []core.DiffLine{}, Guards: []core.Guard{}}
	material := append([]byte(nil), input...)
	for _, s := range steps {
		name := s.Def.Ref().String()
		switch {
		case s.Def.Spec.Class == core.ClassRead:
			out.Diff = append(out.Diff, core.DiffLine{Op: " ", Text: fmt.Sprintf("read step %s: %s", s.Step.ID, name)})
		case len(s.Refs) > 0:
			after := s.Refs[0]
			for _, r := range s.Refs {
				if ordinal[r] > ordinal[after] {
					after = r
				}
			}
			out.Diff = append(out.Diff, core.DiffLine{Op: " ",
				Text: fmt.Sprintf("planned after step %s: %s %s", after, name, s.Template)})
		default:
			final, err := resolveStepRefs(s.Template, nil)
			if err != nil {
				return core.PlanOutcome{}, nil, err
			}
			v, err := kids.Plan(ctx, p, s.Step.Host, s.Def.Ref(), final, core.PlanOptions{
				Call: &core.CallContext{ParentAction: def.Spec.Name, StepID: s.Step.ID},
			})
			if err != nil {
				return core.PlanOutcome{}, nil, err
			}
			for _, d := range v.Diff {
				out.Diff = append(out.Diff, core.DiffLine{Op: d.Op, Text: "[" + s.Step.ID + "] " + d.Text})
			}
			for _, g := range v.Guards {
				g.ID = s.Step.ID + "/" + g.ID
				out.Guards = append(out.Guards, g)
			}
			fp, err := json.Marshal(struct {
				InputHash string
				Diff      []core.DiffLine
				Guards    []core.Guard
			}{v.InputHash, v.Diff, v.Guards})
			if err != nil {
				return core.PlanOutcome{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: encode the dry-run of step %s: %w", s.Step.ID, err)
			}
			material = append(append(material, 0), fp...)
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(material)
	out.StateHash = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	return out, steps, nil
}

// compositeSteps calls the composite's Steps and checks the result against
// 1.3's registry rules; a violation is a module bug, answered internal.
func (e *Engine) compositeSteps(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, def core.ActionDef, input json.RawMessage) ([]plannedStep, error) {
	var raw []core.Step
	err := e.protect(def.Ref(), "Steps", func() error {
		var err error
		raw, err = def.Handler.Steps(ctx, e.env(p), input)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	bug := func(format string, args ...any) error {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composite %s: %s", def.Ref(), fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
	}
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return nil, bug("Steps returned no step")
	}
	ordinal := map[string]int{}
	follows := map[string]map[string]bool{}
	revertible := -1
	steps := make([]plannedStep, 0, len(raw))
	for i, st := range raw {
		if !stepIDPattern.MatchString(st.ID) {
			return nil, bug("step id %q does not match [a-z][a-z0-9]*", st.ID)
		}
		if _, dup := ordinal[st.ID]; dup {
			return nil, bug("step id %s is used twice", st.ID)
		}
		set := map[string]bool{}
		for _, a := range st.After {
			if _, ok := ordinal[a]; !ok {
				return nil, bug("step %s follows %q, which is not an earlier step", st.ID, a)
			}
			set[a] = true
			for f := range follows[a] {
				set[f] = true
			}
		}
		ordinal[st.ID], follows[st.ID] = i, set
		cdef, ok := e.cfg.Registry.Action(st.Action)
		if !ok {
			return nil, bug("step %s: action %s is not registered", st.ID, st.Action)
		}
		switch {
		case cdef.Spec.Side == core.SideController && st.Host != "":
			return nil, bug("step %s: %s is a controller-side action and takes no host", st.ID, st.Action)
		case cdef.Spec.Side == core.SideAgent && st.Host == "":
			return nil, bug("step %s: %s is an agent action and needs a host", st.ID, st.Action)
		}
		switch cdef.Spec.Class {
		case core.ClassComposite, core.ClassIrreversible:
			return nil, bug("step %s: a step is never %s", st.ID, cdef.Spec.Class)
		case core.ClassRevertible:
			if revertible >= 0 {
				return nil, bug("step %s: a composite has at most one revertible step", st.ID)
			}
			revertible = i
		case core.ClassCompensable:
			if def.Spec.Unwind == core.UnwindReverse && cdef.Handler.Inverse == nil {
				return nil, bug("step %s: %s has no undo handler, which a reverse composite's compensable steps need", st.ID, st.Action)
			}
		}
		if def.Spec.Unwind == core.UnwindForward && cdef.Spec.Class != core.ClassRead && !cdef.Spec.Converges {
			return nil, bug("step %s: %s does not converge, and a forward composite repeats its steps", st.ID, st.Action)
		}
		tmpl, err := resolveInputRefs(st.Input, input)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		refs, err := stepRefs(tmpl)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, bug("step %s: %v", st.ID, err)
		}
		for _, r := range refs {
			if !set[r] {
				return nil, bug("step %s references step %s, which it does not follow", st.ID, r)
			}
		}
		if err := e.secretRefsOnly(cdef, tmpl); err != nil {
			return nil, bug("step %s: %v", st.ID, err)
		}
		if len(refs) == 0 {
			final, err := resolveStepRefs(tmpl, nil)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if err := e.cfg.Validator.ValidateInput(cdef, final); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		steps = append(steps, plannedStep{Step: st, Ordinal: i, Def: cdef, Template: tmpl, Refs: refs})
	}
	if revertible >= 0 && revertible != len(raw)-1 {
		return nil, bug("step %s: the revertible step must be the last", raw[revertible].ID)
	}
	return steps, nil
}

// secretRefsOnly refuses a template holding a literal value in a field the
// child's input marks secret: redacting the template must replace only
// ${steps...} references, whose values go only into the sealed input.
func (e *Engine) secretRefsOnly(def core.ActionDef, tmpl json.RawMessage) error {
	var orig, red any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(tmpl, &orig); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("the template is not JSON: %w", err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(e.cfg.Redact(def.InputType, tmpl), &red); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("the redacted template is not JSON: %w", err)
	}
	return secretPositions("", orig, red)
}

func secretPositions(path string, orig, red any) error {
	if s, ok := red.(string); ok && s == redactedText {
		if o, ok := orig.(string); ok && stepRefPattern.MatchString(o) {
			return nil
		}
		if path == "" {
			path = "/"
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("the secret field %s holds a literal value; only a ${steps...} reference may fill it", path)
	}
	switch r := red.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		o, _ := orig.(map[string]any)
		for k, v := range r {
			if err := secretPositions(path+"/"+k, o[k], v); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case []any:
		o, _ := orig.([]any)
		for i, v := range r {
			var ov any
			if i < len(o) {
				ov = o[i]
			}
			if err := secretPositions(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", path, i), ov, v); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// compositeTimeout is the length of a composite's steps phase: the sum of
// its steps' deadlines plus StepsGrace (1.3 Deadlines).
func (e *Engine) compositeTimeout(steps []plannedStep) time.Duration {
	d := StepsGrace
	for _, s := range steps {
		d += e.applyTimeout(s.Def)
	}
	return d
}
```

The runner is one state machine over the persisted step log. Each pass takes the composite's lock, reads its row, its direction, its cursor and the cursor step, and does exactly one thing: commit a boundary, make one child call, or apply one row of 1.3's transition tables to a lookup. The same machine serves the live run (`run` set: it plans and applies steps) and start-up recovery (`run` nil: it never plans a step and applies the "Between steps" rules), so this task implements both columns of the tables; Task 37 only adds what starts and wakes it. Its L2 declaration is `runComposite(id string, run *compositeRun)`, and it declares `ChildPoll` (Contracts L1), because the live run already waits for asynchronous children.

The names Tasks 36–38 use are listed in Contracts L2 under Task 35. The task relies on Task 11's engine field `runCtx` (cancelled by `Close`) and on `goRun` marking its goroutine done in a `defer`.

```go
func (h *cstHost) failNext(name string, n int) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.failures[name] = n
}

// setHooks sets functions that run at the start of cst.item.add's Plan and
// of every cst Apply, without mu held; nil removes one.
func (h *cstHost) setHooks(onPlan, onApply func(name string)) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.onPlan, h.onApply = onPlan, onApply
}

func (c *inprocChildren) callLog() []string {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(c.calls)
}

// cfxEvents records the controller engine's composite.step events. onEvent,
// when set, runs for each one on the publishing goroutine.
type cfxEvents struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	list    []StepEvent
	onEvent func(StepEvent)
}

func (r *cfxEvents) publish(eventType string, data any) {
	ev, ok := data.(StepEvent)
	if eventType != EventCompositeStep || !ok {
		return
	}
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.list = append(r.list, ev)
	on := r.onEvent
	r.mu.Unlock()
	if on != nil {
		on(ev)
	}
}

func (r *cfxEvents) of(changeID string) []StepEvent {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	var out []StepEvent
	for _, ev := range r.list {
		if ev.ChangeID == changeID {
			out = append(out, ev)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func (r *cfxEvents) setOnEvent(f func(StepEvent)) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.onEvent = f
}

// applyC plans and applies a composite as cfxRoot.
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Split `recheck` and route a composite's apply**

In `internal/core/lifecycle/apply.go`, move the comparison at the end of `recheck` (from `if out.StateHash != pl.stateHash {` to its final `return nil`) into a function of its own, and let `recheck` end with `return checkReplan(pl, out)`:

```go
// checkReplan is the comparison of apply's step 1: the apply is refused when
// the state hash changed or a guard that passed now fails
// (plan.state_changed), or a guard failed (plan.guard_failed).
func checkReplan(pl planRecord, out core.PlanOutcome) error {
	if out.StateHash != pl.stateHash {
		return errcode.New(errcode.PlanStateChanged, "the state changed since the plan was made; plan again")
	}
	passed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, g := range pl.guards {
		passed[g.ID] = g.OK
	}
	for _, g := range out.Guards {
		switch {
		case g.OK:
		case passed[g.ID]:
			return errcode.New(errcode.PlanStateChanged,
				fmt.Sprintf("guard %s passed when the plan was made and fails now; plan again", g.ID))
		default:
			return errcode.New(errcode.PlanGuardFailed, fmt.Sprintf("guard %s failed: %s", g.ID, g.Message))
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Write `composite_run.go`**

Create `internal/core/lifecycle/composite_run.go`:

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// ChildPoll is how often a composite looks up a child it waits for (1.3
// Child watcher).
const ChildPoll = 15 * time.Second

// EventCompositeStep is the event type of every committed composite step
// state (1.6).
const EventCompositeStep = "composite.step"

// StepEvent is the data of a composite.step event.
type StepEvent struct {
	ChangeID      string `json:"changeId"`
	StepID        string `json:"stepId"`
	State         string `json:"state"`
	ChildChangeID string `json:"childChangeId"`
}

// The directions of core_composites.
const (
	dirForward = "forward"
	dirUnwind  = "unwind"
)

func stepInputAD(id, stepID string) string  { return "core_composite_steps.input_ct." + id + "." + stepID }
func stepOutputAD(id, stepID string) string { return "core_composite_steps.output_ct." + id + "." + stepID }

// compositeRun is what a live runner has and recovery does not: the
// principal that plans and applies the children, and the options of the
// composite's apply, which reach its revertible step. A nil *compositeRun is
// recovery, which never plans a step.
type compositeRun struct {
	P    core.Principal
	Opts core.ApplyOptions
}

// compositeRow is a composite's change row with its core_composites row.
type compositeRow struct {
	ID, Action, PlanID, Actor, State, Owner string
	Version                                 int
	Direction                               string
	Cursor                                  int
	StepsDeadline                           time.Time
}

// stepRow is one row of core_composite_steps.
type stepRow struct {
	ID              string
	Ordinal         int
	Host            string
	Action          core.ActionRef
	After           []string
	Template        json.RawMessage
	State           string
	Attempt         int
	PlanID, ChildID string
	Earlier         []string
	InputCT         []byte
	OutputCT        []byte
	ChildDeadline   *time.Time
	Err             *core.ChangeError
}

// loadComposite reads composite id and its steps in ordinal order. A change
// that is not a composite is change.not_found.
func loadComposite(ctx context.Context, q queryer, id string) (compositeRow, []stepRow, error) {
	c := compositeRow{ID: id}
	var deadline string
	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx,
		`SELECT ch.action, ch.version, ch.plan_id, ch.actor, ch.state, ch.recovery_owner,
		 co.direction, co.cursor, co.steps_deadline
		 FROM core_changes ch JOIN core_composites co ON co.change_id = ch.id WHERE ch.id = ?`, id).
		Scan(&c.Action, &c.Version, &c.PlanID, &c.Actor, &c.State, &c.Owner, &c.Direction, &c.Cursor, &deadline)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return c, nil, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("no composite %s", id))
	case err != nil:
		return c, nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read composite %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	if c.StepsDeadline, err = parseTime(deadline); err != nil {
		return c, nil, err
	}
	rows, err := q.QueryContext(ctx,
		`SELECT step_id, ordinal, host_id, action, after_json, input_template, state, attempt, child_plan_id,
		 child_change_id, earlier_child_change_ids, input_ct, output_ct, child_deadline, error_code, error_message
		 FROM core_composite_steps WHERE change_id = ? ORDER BY ordinal`, id)
	if err != nil {
		return c, nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the steps of %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = rows.Close() }()
	var steps []stepRow
	for rows.Next() {
		var s stepRow
		var action, after, tmpl, earlier string
		var planID, childID, childDeadline, code, msg sql.NullString
		if err := rows.Scan(&s.ID, &s.Ordinal, &s.Host, &action, &after, &tmpl, &s.State, &s.Attempt, &planID,
			&childID, &earlier, &s.InputCT, &s.OutputCT, &childDeadline, &code, &msg); err != nil {
			return c, nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the steps of %s: %w", id, err)
		}
		if err := s.Action.UnmarshalText([]byte(action)); err != nil {
			return c, nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: step %s of %s: %w", s.ID, id, err)
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(after), &s.After); err != nil {
			return c, nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: step %s of %s: after: %w", s.ID, id, err)
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(earlier), &s.Earlier); err != nil {
			return c, nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: step %s of %s: earlier children: %w", s.ID, id, err)
		}
		s.Template, s.PlanID, s.ChildID = json.RawMessage(tmpl), planID.String, childID.String
		if childDeadline.Valid {
			t, err := parseTime(childDeadline.String)
			if err != nil {
				return c, nil, err
			}
			s.ChildDeadline = &t
		}
		if code.Valid {
			s.Err = &core.ChangeError{Code: code.String, Message: msg.String}
		}
		steps = append(steps, s)
	}
	return c, steps, rows.Err()
}

// stepUpdate is one committed change of a step row. State is always written;
// every other field is kept when nil, zero or empty. A PlanID or ChildID
// pointing at "" clears that column. Cursor and Direction move the
// core_composites row in the same transaction.
type stepUpdate struct {
	State         string
	Attempt       int
	PlanID        *string
	ChildID       *string
	Earlier       []string
	InputCT       []byte
	OutputCT      []byte
	ChildDeadline *time.Time
	Err           *core.ChangeError
	ClearErr      bool
	Cursor        *int
	Direction     string
}

func stepCursor(n int) *int { return &n }

// optText is a nullable column update: set reports whether to write, and
// value is NULL for "".
func optText(p *string) (set bool, value any) {
	switch {
	case p == nil:
		return false, nil
	case *p == "":
		return true, nil
	}
	return true, *p
}

func optBlob(b []byte) any {
	if len(b) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return b
}

// setStep commits u for step stepID of composite id when the step is in one
// of from, and then publishes the step's state; each step boundary is its
// own committed write, made before the act it announces. A step in another
// state is change.not_pending: another mechanism moved it first.
func (e *Engine) setStep(ctx context.Context, id, stepID string, from []string, u stepUpdate) error {
	var child string
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		var state string
		var stored sql.NullString
		err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx,
			"SELECT state, child_change_id FROM core_composite_steps WHERE change_id = ? AND step_id = ?", id, stepID).
			Scan(&state, &stored)
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("composite %s has no step %s", id, stepID))
		case err != nil:
			return err
		case !slices.Contains(from, state):
			return errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf("step %s of %s is %s", stepID, id, state))
		}
		child = stored.String
		if u.ChildID != nil {
			child = *u.ChildID
		}
		var attempt, earlier, deadline, code, msg any
		if u.Attempt > 0 {
			attempt = u.Attempt
		}
		if u.Earlier != nil {
			b, err := json.Marshal(u.Earlier)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			earlier = string(b)
		}
		if u.ChildDeadline != nil {
			deadline = formatTime(*u.ChildDeadline)
		}
		if u.Err != nil {
			code, msg = u.Err.Code, u.Err.Message
		}
		planSet, planID := optText(u.PlanID)
		childSet, childID := optText(u.ChildID)
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`UPDATE core_composite_steps SET state = ?, updated_at = ?,
			 attempt = coalesce(?, attempt),
			 child_plan_id = CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE child_plan_id END,
			 child_change_id = CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE child_change_id END,
			 earlier_child_change_ids = coalesce(?, earlier_child_change_ids),
			 input_ct = coalesce(?, input_ct),
			 output_ct = coalesce(?, output_ct),
			 child_deadline = coalesce(?, child_deadline),
			 error_code = CASE WHEN ? THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(?, error_code) END,
			 error_message = CASE WHEN ? THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(?, error_message) END
			 WHERE change_id = ? AND step_id = ?`,
			u.State, formatTime(e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()), attempt, planSet, planID, childSet, childID, earlier,
			optBlob(u.InputCT), optBlob(u.OutputCT), deadline, u.ClearErr, code, u.ClearErr, msg, id, stepID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if u.Cursor == nil && u.Direction == "" {
			return nil
		}
		var cursor, direction any
		if u.Cursor != nil {
			cursor = *u.Cursor
		}
		if u.Direction != "" {
			direction = u.Direction
		}
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			"UPDATE core_composites SET cursor = coalesce(?, cursor), direction = coalesce(?, direction) WHERE change_id = ?",
			cursor, direction, id)
		return err
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &coded):
		return err
	case err != nil:
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: record step %s of %s: %w", stepID, id, err)
	}
	e.publishStep(id, stepID, u.State, child)
	return nil
}

func (e *Engine) publishStep(id, stepID, state, childID string) {
	if e.cfg.Publish == nil {
		return
	}
	e.cfg.Publish(EventCompositeStep, StepEvent{ChangeID: id, StepID: stepID, State: state, ChildChangeID: childID})
}

// compLock serializes the acts on one composite. refs counts its holders
// and waiters, so the entry is dropped once the last one is done and the map
// does not grow with every composite ever run.
type compLock struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	refs int
}

// compWaker is the wake channel of a composite's runner. runners counts the
// runners of the composite, so the entry is dropped when the last one ends.
type compWaker struct {
	ch      chan struct{}
	runners int
}

// compositeLock serializes everything that acts on composite id in this
// process: the runner's passes, confirm, revert, repair and release.
func (e *Engine) compositeLock(id string) func() {
	e.compMu.Lock()
	if e.compLocks == nil {
		e.compLocks = map[string]*compLock{}
	}
	l, ok := e.compLocks[id]
	if !ok {
		l = &compLock{}
		e.compLocks[id] = l
	}
	l.refs++
	e.compMu.Unlock()
	l.mu.Lock()
	return func() {
		l.mu.Unlock()
		e.compMu.Lock()
		defer e.compMu.Unlock()
		if l.refs--; l.refs == 0 {
			delete(e.compLocks, id)
		}
	}
}

// compositeWaker registers a runner of composite id. It returns the channel
// the runner sleeps on and the function that unregisters the runner.
func (e *Engine) compositeWaker(id string) (chan struct{}, func()) {
	e.compMu.Lock()
	defer e.compMu.Unlock()
	if e.compWake == nil {
		e.compWake = map[string]*compWaker{}
	}
	w, ok := e.compWake[id]
	if !ok {
		w = &compWaker{ch: make(chan struct{}, 1)}
		e.compWake[id] = w
	}
	w.runners++
	return w.ch, func() {
		e.compMu.Lock()
		defer e.compMu.Unlock()
		if w.runners--; w.runners == 0 {
			delete(e.compWake, id)
		}
	}
}

// wakeComposite ends the current wait of composite id's runner, so it looks
// its child up now. A composite without a runner has nothing to wake.
func (e *Engine) wakeComposite(id string) {
	e.compMu.Lock()
	w := e.compWake[id]
	e.compMu.Unlock()
	if w == nil {
		return
	}
	select {
	case w.ch <- struct{}{}:
	default:
	}
}

// compositeSleep waits d on the engine's clock, or until wake receives or
// ctx ends.
func (e *Engine) compositeSleep(ctx context.Context, wake chan struct{}, d time.Duration) {
	timer := e.cfg.Base.Clock.AfterFunc(d, func() {
		select {
		case wake <- struct{}{}:
		default:
		}
	})
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
	case <-wake:
	}
}

// compositeWait ends a runner pass that waits for a child; the runner sleeps
// d before its next pass.
type compositeWait struct{ d time.Duration }

func (w *compositeWait) Error() string { return "lifecycle: the composite waits for a child" }

func waitChild(d time.Duration) error { return &compositeWait{d: d} }

// errCompositeDone ends the runner: the composite is terminal, needs repair,
// or another mechanism owns it.
var errCompositeDone = errors.New("lifecycle: the composite runner is done")

// runComposite runs composite id on the engine's run context, one pass at a
// time, until it is terminal or needs repair or the engine closes; Close
// leaves it as persisted, for RecoverComposites. run is nil at recovery.
func (e *Engine) runComposite(id string, run *compositeRun) {
	ctx := e.runCtx
	wake, done := e.compositeWaker(id)
	defer done()
	for ctx.Err() == nil {
		err := e.compositeStep(ctx, id, run)
		var wait *compositeWait
		switch {
		case err == nil:
		case errors.Is(err, errCompositeDone):
			return
		case errors.As(err, &wait):
			e.compositeSleep(ctx, wake, wait.d)
		default:
			e.cfg.Base.Log.Error("lifecycle: composite runner", "change", id, "error", err)
			e.compositeSleep(ctx, wake, ChildPoll)
		}
	}
}

// compositeStep is one pass of the runner, under the composite's lock.
func (e *Engine) compositeStep(ctx context.Context, id string, run *compositeRun) error {
	unlock := e.compositeLock(id)
	defer unlock()
	c, steps, err := loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if c.Owner != core.OwnerComposite {
		return errCompositeDone
	}
	if c.Direction == dirUnwind {
		return e.unwindStep(ctx, c, steps)
	}
	return e.forwardStep(ctx, c, steps, run)
}

func (e *Engine) forwardStep(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, steps []stepRow, run *compositeRun) error {
	if c.Cursor >= len(steps) {
		return e.completeComposite(ctx, c, steps, run)
	}
	s := steps[c.Cursor]
	switch s.State {
	case core.StepPending, core.StepPlanning, core.StepPlanned:
		switch {
		case run == nil:
			return e.betweenSteps(ctx, c, s)
		case s.State == core.StepPending && !e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now().Before(c.StepsDeadline):
			return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal-1, &core.ChangeError{Code: string(errcode.DeadlineExceeded),
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("the steps deadline passed before step %s (%s) started", s.ID, s.Action)})
		case e.isReadStep(s):
			return e.readStep(ctx, c, steps, s, run)
		}
		return e.startStep(ctx, c, steps, s, run)
	case core.StepApplying, core.StepConfirming, core.StepApplied:
		kids, err := e.kids()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lk, err := lookupChild(ctx, kids, s)
		if err != nil {
			return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		return e.observeChild(ctx, c.ID, lk)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composite %s: step %s is %s at the cursor", c.ID, s.ID, s.State)
}

func (e *Engine) stepCall(c compositeRow, s stepRow) *core.CallContext {
	return &core.CallContext{ParentChangeID: c.ID, ParentAction: c.Action, StepID: s.ID}
}

// startStep plans and applies step s (1.3 Step log and cursor): planning is
// committed before the plan request, planned with the plan id once it
// answered, and applying before the apply request, so only a recorded plan
// id is ever applied. The next pass looks the child up.
func (e *Engine) startStep(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, steps []stepRow, s stepRow, run *compositeRun) error {
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	def, ok := e.cfg.Registry.Action(s.Action)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composite %s: step %s: action %s is not registered", c.ID, s.ID, s.Action)
	}
	call := e.stepCall(c, s)
	if s.State == core.StepPending {
		if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepPending}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepPlanning}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		s.State = core.StepPlanning
	}
	if s.State == core.StepPlanning {
		input, err := e.stepInput(c, steps, s)
		if err == nil {
			err = e.cfg.Validator.ValidateInput(def, input)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return e.stepNotApplied(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		sealed, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Seal(stepInputAD(c.ID, s.ID), input)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: seal the input of step %s of %s: %w", s.ID, c.ID, err)
		}
		v, err := kids.Plan(ctx, run.P, s.Host, s.Action, input, core.PlanOptions{Call: call})
		if err != nil {
			return e.stepNotApplied(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepPlanning},
			stepUpdate{State: core.StepPlanned, PlanID: &v.PlanID, InputCT: sealed}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		s.State, s.PlanID = core.StepPlanned, v.PlanID
	}
	opts := core.ApplyOptions{Call: call}
	if def.Spec.Class == core.ClassRevertible {
		opts.ConfirmTimeout, opts.ConfirmNow = run.Opts.ConfirmTimeout, run.Opts.ConfirmNow
	}
	deadline := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now().Add(e.applyTimeout(def))
	if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepPlanned},
		stepUpdate{State: core.StepApplying, Attempt: s.Attempt + 1, ChildDeadline: &deadline}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, applyErr := kids.Apply(ctx, run.P, s.Host, s.Action, s.PlanID, opts)
	u := stepUpdate{State: core.StepApplying}
	switch {
	case applyErr != nil:
		// The answer may be lost after the child committed; the lookup decides.
		u.Err = e.stepError(s, applyErr)
	case v.ID != "":
		u.ChildID = &v.ID
		if len(v.Output) > 0 {
			sealed, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Seal(stepOutputAD(c.ID, s.ID), v.Output)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: seal the output of step %s of %s: %w", s.ID, c.ID, err)
			}
			u.OutputCT = sealed
		}
	}
	return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepApplying}, u)
}

// stepInput resolves s's template against the sealed unredacted outputs of
// the steps it references (1.3 References).
func (e *Engine) stepInput(c compositeRow, steps []stepRow, s stepRow) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	refs, err := stepRefs(s.Template)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	outputs := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for _, r := range refs {
		i := slices.IndexFunc(steps, func(o stepRow) bool { return o.ID == r })
		if i < 0 || len(steps[i].OutputCT) == 0 {
			return nil, errcode.New(errcode.ChildFailed, fmt.Sprintf("step %s has no output for step %s", r, s.ID))
		}
		raw, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(stepOutputAD(c.ID, r), steps[i].OutputCT)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open the output of step %s of %s: %w", r, c.ID, err)
		}
		outputs[r] = raw
	}
	return resolveStepRefs(s.Template, outputs)
}

// readStep runs a read step when the cursor reaches it (1.3 Read steps): no
// plan, no change; the result is sealed into the step row.
func (e *Engine) readStep(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, steps []stepRow, s stepRow, run *compositeRun) error {
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	input, err := e.stepInput(c, steps, s)
	if err != nil {
		return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal-1, e.stepError(s, err))
	}
	out, err := kids.Read(ctx, run.P, s.Host, s.Action, input)
	switch {
	case errcode.From(err).Code == errcode.HostOffline:
		return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
	case err != nil:
		return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal-1, e.stepError(s, err))
	}
	sealed, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Seal(stepOutputAD(c.ID, s.ID), out)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: seal the result of step %s of %s: %w", s.ID, c.ID, err)
	}
	return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepPending},
		stepUpdate{State: core.StepRead, OutputCT: sealed, Cursor: stepCursor(s.Ordinal + 1)})
}

// stepNotApplied ends a step that failed before its apply was sent: it is
// pending again with the error, and the composite moves on as for a child
// that was never applied.
func (e *Engine) stepNotApplied(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, cause error) error {
	cerr := e.stepError(s, cause)
	if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{s.State}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepPending, Err: cerr}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.State = core.StepPending
	return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal-1, cerr)
}

// stepFailed records cause on step s and moves the composite on by 1.3's
// tables: a reverse composite unwinds from ordinal down (failed when nothing
// there needs undoing), a forward composite needs repair at s.
func (e *Engine) stepFailed(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, ordinal int, cause *core.ChangeError) error {
	def, err := e.compositeDef(c)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if def.Spec.Unwind == core.UnwindForward {
		return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, s, cause)
	}
	if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{s.State}, stepUpdate{State: s.State, Err: cause}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := e.compositeCause(ctx, c.ID, cause); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return e.unwindFrom(ctx, c.ID, ordinal)
}

// stepFailure is a composite's error naming step s.
func stepFailure(s stepRow, why string) *core.ChangeError {
	where := "on host " + s.Host
	if s.Host == "" {
		where = "on the controller"
	}
	return &core.ChangeError{Code: string(errcode.ChildFailed), Message: fmt.Sprintf("step %s (%s %s): %s", s.ID, s.Action, where, why)}
}

func (e *Engine) stepError(s stepRow, err error) *core.ChangeError {
	ce := e.changeError(s.Action, err)
	return stepFailure(s, ce.Code+": "+ce.Message)
}

func childFailure(s stepRow, lk core.PlanLookup) *core.ChangeError {
	why := "child " + lk.ChangeID + " is " + lk.State
	if lk.Error != nil {
		why += ": " + lk.Error.Code + ": " + lk.Error.Message
	}
	return stepFailure(s, why)
}

// compositeCause records why the composite is unwinding; the terminal
// transition keeps it.
func (e *Engine) compositeCause(ctx context.Context, id string, cause *core.ChangeError) error {
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_changes SET error_code = ?, error_message = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
			cause.Code, cause.Message, formatTime(e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()), id)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: record the cause of composite %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// compositeNeedsRepair stops composite c at step s: needs_repair with
// cause, owner cleared, its composite lock kept; only an operator's repair
// or step decision moves it on.
func (e *Engine) compositeNeedsRepair(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, cause *core.ChangeError) error {
	if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{s.State}, stepUpdate{State: s.State, Err: cause}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err := e.transition(ctx, c.ID, transition{
		from: c.State, to: core.StateNeedsRepair, owner: newOwner(""), keepLocks: true,
		err:   &core.ChangeError{Code: string(errcode.NeedsRepair), Message: cause.Message, Cause: cause.Code},
		cause: cause.Code, phase: phaseApply, result: resultError, actor: c.Actor,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return errCompositeDone
}

func (e *Engine) compositeDef(c compositeRow) (core.ActionDef, error) {
	return e.action(core.ActionRef{Name: c.Action, Version: c.Version})
}

func (e *Engine) isReadStep(s stepRow) bool {
	def, ok := e.cfg.Registry.Action(s.Action)
	return ok && def.Spec.Class == core.ClassRead
}

// lookupChild looks step s's child up. A plan its side no longer holds was
// purged unapplied, since a plan with a change is kept, so it reads as
// retired.
func lookupChild(ctx context.Context, kids Children, s stepRow) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	lk, err := kids.Lookup(ctx, s.Host, s.PlanID, false)
	if errcode.From(err).Code == errcode.PlanNotFound {
		return core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupRetired}, nil
	}
	return lk, err
}

func retireChild(ctx context.Context, kids Children, s stepRow) (core.PlanLookup, error) {
	lk, err := kids.Retire(ctx, s.Host, s.PlanID)
	if errcode.From(err).Code == errcode.PlanNotFound {
		return core.PlanLookup{Status: core.LookupRetired}, nil
	}
	return lk, err
}

// childUnreachable is what a failed child call means for the runner: an
// unreachable host is waited for, and any other error is returned.
func (e *Engine) childUnreachable(_ context.Context, _ compositeRow, _ stepRow, err error) error {
	if errcode.From(err).Code == errcode.HostOffline {
		return waitChild(ChildPoll)
	}
	return err
}

// observeChild applies 1.3's transition tables, chosen by the persisted
// direction, to lk, a lookup of the cursor step's child. An absent plan is
// retired first, and the retire's answer is read in its place.
func (e *Engine) observeChild(ctx context.Context, id string, lk core.PlanLookup) error {
	c, steps, err := loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if c.Cursor < 0 || c.Cursor >= len(steps) {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composite %s has no step at cursor %d", id, c.Cursor)
	}
	s := steps[c.Cursor]
	if lk.Status == core.LookupAbsent {
		kids, err := e.kids()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if lk, err = retireChild(ctx, kids, s); err != nil {
			return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		if lk.Status == core.LookupAbsent {
			return waitChild(ChildPoll)
		}
	}
	if lk.ChangeID != "" && lk.ChangeID != s.ChildID {
		if err := e.setStep(ctx, id, s.ID, []string{s.State}, stepUpdate{State: s.State, ChildID: &lk.ChangeID}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		s.ChildID = lk.ChangeID
	}
	if c.Direction == dirUnwind {
		return e.unwindObserve(ctx, c, s, lk)
	}
	return e.forwardObserve(ctx, c, s, lk)
}

// forwardObserve is 1.3's table for the direction forward.
func (e *Engine) forwardObserve(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, lk core.PlanLookup) error {
	switch {
	case lk.Status == core.LookupRunning, lk.Status == core.LookupRecovering:
		return waitChild(ChildPoll)
	case lk.Status == core.LookupRetired:
		why := "its plan was retired without a change"
		if s.Err != nil {
			why += " after " + s.Err.Message
		}
		return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal-1, stepFailure(s, why))
	case lk.Unresolved > 0:
		return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, s,
			stepFailure(s, fmt.Sprintf("child %s has %d unresolved effects", lk.ChangeID, lk.Unresolved)))
	}
	switch {
	case lk.State == core.StateCompleted, lk.State == core.StateConfirmed,
		lk.State == core.StateRepaired && lk.RepairOutcome == core.RepairKept:
		return e.stepDone(ctx, c, s, lk)
	case lk.State == core.StatePending:
		return e.stepAwaiting(ctx, c, s, lk)
	case lk.State == core.StateReverted, lk.State == core.StateRepaired:
		return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal-1, childFailure(s, lk))
	case lk.State == core.StateFailed, lk.State == core.StateInterrupted:
		return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal, childFailure(s, lk))
	}
	return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, s, childFailure(s, lk))
}

// stepDone makes step s final and moves the cursor past it, sealing the
// child's output first when the apply answer did not carry it. An error a
// lost apply answer left on the step is cleared.
func (e *Engine) stepDone(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, lk core.PlanLookup) error {
	u := stepUpdate{State: core.StepApplied, Cursor: stepCursor(s.Ordinal + 1), ClearErr: true}
	if lk.State == core.StateConfirmed {
		u.State = core.StepConfirmed
	}
	if len(s.OutputCT) == 0 {
		raw := lk.Output
		if len(raw) == 0 {
			raw = json.RawMessage("null")
		}
		sealed, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Seal(stepOutputAD(c.ID, s.ID), raw)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: seal the output of step %s of %s: %w", s.ID, c.ID, err)
		}
		u.OutputCT = sealed
	}
	return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepApplying, core.StepConfirming, core.StepApplied}, u)
}

// stepAwaiting is the revertible last step's child pending: the step is
// applied and the composite awaits confirmation (1.3 Confirmation), while
// the runner keeps looking the child up.
func (e *Engine) stepAwaiting(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, lk core.PlanLookup) error {
	if s.State == core.StepApplying {
		if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepApplying},
			stepUpdate{State: core.StepApplied, ChildDeadline: lk.Deadline}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if c.State != core.StateAwaitingConfirmation {
		if _, err := e.transition(ctx, c.ID, transition{from: c.State, to: core.StateAwaitingConfirmation}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return waitChild(ChildPoll)
}

// betweenSteps is recovery at a cursor step whose apply was never sent (1.3
// Between steps): a planned plan is retired first, and the step counts as
// never applied.
func (e *Engine) betweenSteps(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow) error {
	if s.State == core.StepPlanned {
		kids, err := e.kids()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lk, err := retireChild(ctx, kids, s)
		if err != nil {
			return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		if lk.Status != core.LookupRetired {
			return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepPlanned}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepApplying})
		}
	}
	return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal-1, stepFailure(s, "the controller restarted before the step was applied"))
}

// completeComposite builds the output from every non-read step's redacted
// output and records the composite completed, releasing its lock.
func (e *Engine) completeComposite(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, steps []stepRow, run *compositeRun) error {
	def, err := e.compositeDef(c)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	outputs := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for _, s := range steps {
		sdef, ok := e.cfg.Registry.Action(s.Action)
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composite %s: step %s: action %s is not registered", c.ID, s.ID, s.Action)
		}
		if sdef.Spec.Class == core.ClassRead {
			continue
		}
		raw := json.RawMessage("null")
		if len(s.OutputCT) > 0 {
			if raw, err = e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(stepOutputAD(c.ID, s.ID), s.OutputCT); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open the output of step %s of %s: %w", s.ID, c.ID, err)
			}
		}
		outputs[s.ID] = e.cfg.Redact(sdef.OutputType, raw)
	}
	var ct []byte
	if err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT input_ct FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", c.PlanID).
		Scan(&ct); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read the input of composite %s: %w", c.ID, err)
	}
	input, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(planInputAD(c.PlanID), ct)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open the input of composite %s: %w", c.ID, err)
	}
	p := recoveryPrincipal
	if run != nil {
		p = run.P
	}
	env := e.changeEnv(p, def, c.ID, core.CallContext{})
	var out json.RawMessage
	err = e.protect(def.Ref(), "Output", func() error {
		var err error
		out, err = def.Handler.Output(ctx, env, input, outputs)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Error("lifecycle: composite output", "change", c.ID, "error", err)
		return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, steps[len(steps)-1],
			&core.ChangeError{Code: string(errcode.Internal), Message: "the composite's output could not be built"})
	}
	_, err = e.transition(ctx, c.ID, transition{
		from: c.State, to: core.StateCompleted, output: e.cfg.Redact(def.OutputType, out), owner: newOwner(""),
		release: true, phase: phaseApply, result: resultOK, actor: c.Actor,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return errCompositeDone
}

// planDef is the registered action of a stored plan; false when the plan or
// its action is unknown, which Apply then reports.
func (e *Engine) planDef(ctx context.Context, planID string) (core.ActionDef, bool) {
	var name string
	var version int
	if err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT action, version FROM core_plans WHERE id = ?", planID).
		Scan(&name, &version); err != nil {
		return core.ActionDef{}, false
	}
	return e.cfg.Registry.Action(core.ActionRef{Name: name, Version: version})
}

// applyComposite is Apply for a composite (1.3 Step log and cursor). Its
// intent writes the change (owner composite, its composite lock), every
// step row and the cursor in one transaction; the runner continues on the
// engine's run context, so the answer is the applying change.
func (e *Engine) applyComposite(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, planID string, opts core.ApplyOptions) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	e.applyMu.Lock()
	id, existing, err := e.beginComposite(ctx, p, planID)
	e.applyMu.Unlock()
	switch {
	case err != nil:
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	case existing != nil:
		return *existing, nil
	}
	v, err := e.Change(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	run := &compositeRun{P: p, Opts: opts}
	e.goRun(func() { e.runComposite(id, run) })
	return v, nil
}

// beginComposite runs a composite apply's checks, rechecks its plan by
// planning it again, and persists the intent. It runs under applyMu.
func (e *Engine) beginComposite(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, planID string) (string, *core.ChangeView, error) {
	db := e.cfg.Base.DB
	pl, err := e.loadPlan(ctx, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	if p.Actor != pl.actor {
		return "", nil, errcode.New(errcode.PlanPrincipalMismatch, "the plan was made by another principal")
	}
	existing, err := scanChange(db.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx,
		"SELECT "+changeColumns+" FROM core_changes WHERE plan_id = ?", planID))
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		return "", &existing, nil
	case !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read change of plan %s: %w", planID, err)
	}
	now := e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()
	if !now.Before(pl.expiresAt) {
		return "", nil, errcode.New(errcode.PlanExpired, "the plan expired; plan again")
	}
	def, err := e.action(core.ActionRef{Name: pl.action, Version: pl.version})
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	input, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Open(planInputAD(pl.id), pl.inputCT)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: open plan input: %w", err)
	}
	if err := locksFree(ctx, db.Read(), def.Spec.LockKeys); err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	out, steps, err := e.compositePlan(ctx, p, def, input)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	if err := checkReplan(pl, out); err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	id := e.newID(now)
	created := formatTime(now)
	deadline := formatTime(now.Add(e.compositeTimeout(steps)))
	err = db.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		epochs, err := takeLocks(ctx, tx, id, def.Spec.LockKeys, true)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		ej, err := json.Marshal(epochs)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`INSERT INTO core_changes (id, plan_id, host_id, action, version, class, compensated_by, actor, state,
			 input_json, recovery_owner, lock_epochs, created_at, updated_at)
			 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, '', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
			id, pl.id, e.cfg.Base.HostID, def.Spec.Name, def.Spec.Version, string(def.Spec.Class), p.Actor,
			core.StateApplying, string(e.cfg.Redact(def.InputType, input)), core.OwnerComposite, string(ej),
			created, created); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			"INSERT INTO core_composites (change_id, direction, cursor, steps_deadline) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?)",
			id, dirForward, deadline); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, s := range steps {
			after, err := json.Marshal(nonNil(s.Step.After))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
				`INSERT INTO core_composite_steps (change_id, step_id, ordinal, host_id, action, after_json,
				 input_template, state, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
				id, s.Step.ID, s.Ordinal, s.Step.Host, s.Def.Ref().String(), string(after), string(s.Template),
				core.StepPending, created); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	var coded *errcode.Error
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &coded):
		return "", nil, err
	case err != nil:
		return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: persist the composite intent: %w", err)
	}
	return id, nil, nil
}
```

```go
package lifecycle

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core"
	"github.com/darkraise/darkpanel/internal/core/errcode"
)

// unwindFrom starts unwinding composite id from step ordinal down (1.3
// Unwind). The start check comes first: a child that cannot be undone
// cleanly stops the composite in needs_repair before anything is undone, and
// a composite with nothing to undo is failed. Otherwise the direction turns
// to unwind and the composite is undoing, in one transaction.
func (e *Engine) unwindFrom(ctx context.Context, id string, ordinal int) error {
	c, steps, err := loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ordinal = min(ordinal, len(steps)-1)
	block, why, todo, err := e.unwindBlocker(ctx, c, steps, ordinal)
	switch {
	case err != nil:
		return err
	case block != nil:
		return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, *block, why)
	case !todo:
		if _, err := e.transition(ctx, id, transition{
			from: c.State, to: core.StateFailed, owner: newOwner(""), release: true,
			phase: phaseApply, result: resultError, actor: c.Actor,
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return errCompositeDone
	}
	err = e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_composites SET direction = ?, cursor = ? WHERE change_id = ?",
			dirUnwind, ordinal, id); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		res, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_changes SET state = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND state = ?",
			core.StateUndoing, formatTime(e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now()), id, c.State)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if n, err := res.RowsAffected(); err != nil || n != 1 {
			if err == nil {
				err = errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf("composite %s is no longer %s", id, c.State))
			}
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: start the unwind of %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// unwindBlocker is the start check over the steps from ordinal down: it
// looks up every applied step's child and returns the first step whose child
// has an unresolved effect, is in needs_repair, kept or abandoned, or is
// owned, with why. todo reports whether any child has something to undo. An
// absent plan is retired.
func (e *Engine) unwindBlocker(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, steps []stepRow, ordinal int) (*stepRow, *core.ChangeError, bool, error) {
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, false, err
	}
	todo := false
	for i := ordinal; i >= 0; i-- {
		s := steps[i]
		if s.PlanID == "" || e.isReadStep(s) || s.State == core.StepUndone {
			continue
		}
		lk, err := lookupChild(ctx, kids, s)
		if err == nil && lk.Status == core.LookupAbsent {
			lk, err = retireChild(ctx, kids, s)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, false, e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		switch {
		case lk.Status == core.LookupRetired, lk.State == core.StateReverted:
			continue
		case lk.Unresolved > 0, lk.Owner != "", lk.State == core.StateNeedsRepair,
			lk.State == core.StateKept, lk.State == core.StateAbandoned:
			return &steps[i], stepFailure(s, fmt.Sprintf("child %s cannot be undone cleanly: it is %s, owned by %q, with %d unresolved effects",
				lk.ChangeID, lk.State, lk.Owner, lk.Unresolved)), false, nil
		case (lk.State == core.StateFailed || lk.State == core.StateInterrupted) && lk.Made == 0:
			continue
		}
		todo = true
	}
	return nil, nil, todo, nil
}

// unwindStep is one runner pass in the direction unwind, from the cursor
// backwards: a read step is skipped, a step never applied counts undone, and
// any other step is marked undoing before its child is looked up.
func (e *Engine) unwindStep(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, steps []stepRow) error {
	if c.Cursor < 0 {
		_, err := e.transition(ctx, c.ID, transition{
			from: c.State, to: core.StateReverted, owner: newOwner(""), release: true,
			phase: phaseApply, result: resultError, actor: c.Actor,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return errCompositeDone
	}
	s := steps[c.Cursor]
	prev := c.Cursor - 1
	switch {
	case e.isReadStep(s), s.State == core.StepUndone:
		return e.moveCursor(ctx, c.ID, prev)
	case s.State == core.StepPending, s.State == core.StepPlanning:
		return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{s.State}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepUndone, Cursor: &prev})
	case s.State == core.StepUndoing:
		kids, err := e.kids()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		lk, err := lookupChild(ctx, kids, s)
		if err != nil {
			return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		return e.observeChild(ctx, c.ID, lk)
	}
	return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{s.State}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepUndoing})
}

func (e *Engine) moveCursor(ctx context.Context, id string, to int) error {
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_composites SET cursor = ? WHERE change_id = ?", to, id)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: move the cursor of %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// unwindObserve is 1.3's table for the direction unwind.
func (e *Engine) unwindObserve(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, lk core.PlanLookup) error {
	prev := s.Ordinal - 1
	undone := func() error {
		return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepUndoing}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepUndone, Cursor: &prev})
	}
	switch {
	case lk.Status == core.LookupRetired:
		return undone()
	case lk.Status == core.LookupRunning, lk.Status == core.LookupRecovering:
		return waitChild(ChildPoll)
	case lk.Unresolved > 0:
		return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, s,
			stepFailure(s, fmt.Sprintf("child %s has %d unresolved effects", lk.ChangeID, lk.Unresolved)))
	}
	switch lk.State {
	case core.StateCompleted:
		return e.sendUndo(ctx, c, s)
	case core.StateFailed, core.StateInterrupted:
		if lk.Made == 0 {
			return undone()
		}
		return e.sendUndo(ctx, c, s)
	case core.StatePending:
		return e.sendRevert(ctx, c, s, recoveryPrincipal)
	case core.StateReverted:
		return undone()
	case core.StateConfirmed:
		return e.confirmationWon(ctx, c, s)
	}
	return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, s, childFailure(s, lk))
}

// sendUndo undoes step s's child through the undo route as system:recovery
// with the composite as its parent. A refusal saying the child cannot be
// undone stops the unwind; anything else is settled by the next lookup.
func (e *Engine) sendUndo(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow) error {
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, err := kids.Undo(ctx, recoveryPrincipal, s.Host, s.ChildID, e.stepCall(c, s))
	switch code := errcode.From(err).Code; {
	case err == nil && v.State == core.StateReverted:
		prev := s.Ordinal - 1
		return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepUndoing}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepUndone, Cursor: &prev})
	case err == nil:
		return waitChild(ChildPoll)
	case code == errcode.UndoConflict, code == errcode.LockHeld, code == errcode.NeedsRepair:
		return e.compositeNeedsRepair(ctx, c, s, &core.ChangeError{Code: string(code),
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("step %s: the undo of child %s was refused: %s", s.ID, s.ChildID, errcode.From(err).Detail)})
	case code == errcode.HostOffline:
		return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
	}
	return waitChild(ChildPoll)
}

// sendRevert reverts the pending child of the revertible last step; the
// unwind waits for the lookup to show it reverted.
func (e *Engine) sendRevert(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, p core.Principal) error {
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, err := kids.Revert(ctx, p, s.ChildID)
	switch {
	case err == nil && v.State == core.StateReverted:
		prev := s.Ordinal - 1
		return e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepUndoing}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepUndone, Cursor: &prev})
	case errcode.From(err).Code == errcode.HostOffline:
		return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
	}
	return waitChild(ChildPoll)
}

// confirmationWon ends an unwind whose revertible child was confirmed first:
// the step is confirmed, the direction is forward again past the last step,
// and the stored cause is cleared, so the next pass completes the composite.
func (e *Engine) confirmationWon(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow) error {
	now := formatTime(e.cfg.Base.Clock.Now())
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Write(ctx, func(tx *sql.Tx) error {
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			"UPDATE core_composite_steps SET state = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE change_id = ? AND step_id = ?",
			core.StepConfirmed, now, c.ID, s.ID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, "UPDATE core_composites SET direction = ?, cursor = ? WHERE change_id = ?",
			dirForward, s.Ordinal+1, c.ID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
			`UPDATE core_changes SET state = ?, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, error_cause = NULL, updated_at = ?
			 WHERE id = ?`, core.StateApplying, now, c.ID)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: record the confirmation of %s: %w", c.ID, err)
	}
	e.publishStep(c.ID, s.ID, core.StepConfirmed, s.ChildID)
	return nil
}
```

**Files:**
- Modify: `internal/core/lifecycle/composite_run.go`, `internal/core/lifecycle/revert.go`
- Create: `internal/core/lifecycle/composite_confirm_test.go`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 35; Task 23's private outputs through `Children.Lookup(private)` and `AckPrivate`
- Produces: composite `Confirm`/`Revert`; L2 `compositeFinal` (`composite_run.go`); the change to `transition` (`revert.go`), which starts `compositeFinal` on `goRun` after a composite's terminal commit.

**Items:** 45

**Depends on:** Task 35

**Implementer:** dr-superpowers:impl-sonnet-high
**Evaluation:** files 1 - spec 0 - coupling 1 - risk 3 = 5

The rows of the unwind table for the revertible step (a `pending` child is sent `Revert`, a `confirmed` child stops the unwind) are already in Task 35's `unwindObserve`, `sendRevert` and `confirmationWon`; this task adds the entry points that reach them and tests them. It uses Task 35's names listed in Contracts L2 and produces `isComposite` and `compositeSecretType` for later tasks.

It also applies 1.2's second secret rule for steps: a made effect's sealed secret is cleared when its change is a step whose composite reached a terminal state. Every terminal transition of a composite (`completed` in `completeComposite`, `failed` and `reverted` at the end of an unwind, `abandoned` at the end of a release, Tasks 35 and 38) commits through `transition`, so `transition` (`revert.go`) starts `compositeFinal` on a tracked goroutine once such a commit returns. `compositeFinal` sends `Children.AckPrivate` with `final` set for every child of every step, earlier attempts included, outside any transaction; the executing side clears the child's made-effect secrets (Task 23). A child that cannot be reached keeps its secrets until its undo window closes and `Purge` clears them, so a failure is only logged. `sealedInputDone` (Task 11) is the list of terminal states.

```go
// loseNext makes the next call of method commit and then answer
// errLostAnswer.
func (c *inprocChildren) loseNext(method string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.lose[method] = true
}

// awaitingGate applies cfx.gate.add with a 15-minute confirm timeout and
// waits until it awaits confirmation.
func awaitingGate(t *testing.T, f *cfxFixture) (core.ChangeView, stepRow) {
	t.Helper()
	v := f.applyC(refCfxGate, `{"name":"web"}`, core.ApplyOptions{ConfirmTimeout: 15 * time.Minute})
	f.await(v.ID, core.StateAwaitingConfirmation)
	g := f.stepsOf(v.ID)["g"]
	if g.State != core.StepApplied || f.agentChange(g.ChildID).State != core.StatePending {
		t.Fatalf("step g = %s, child %s, want applied with a pending child", g.State, f.agentChange(g.ChildID).State)
	}
	return v, g
}

	v, g := awaitingGate(t, f)

	if err != nil || got.State != core.StateCompleted || got.Owner != "" {
		t.Fatalf("Confirm = %s owner %q, %v; want completed and unowned", got.State, got.Owner, err)
	}
	if child := f.agentChange(g.ChildID); child.State != core.StateConfirmed {
		t.Errorf("child of g = %s, want confirmed", child.State)

		t.Errorf("output steps = %v, want a and g without the read step", out.Steps)

	if v, _ := f.host.gate("web"); v != "web-a" {

func TestCompositeRevertUnwinds(t *testing.T) {

func TestCompositeTerminalClearsStepSecrets(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCfxFixture(t)
	secrets := func() int {
		t.Helper()
		var n int
		if err := f.agentDB.Read().QueryRow("SELECT count(*) FROM core_effects WHERE secret_ct IS NOT NULL").Scan(&n); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return n
	}
	// When step c applies, the children of steps a and b are made; their
	// effects get the sealed secret an inverse that needs one stores.
	f.host.mu.Lock()
	f.host.onApply = func(name string) {
		if name != "web-c" {
			return
		}
		res, err := f.agentDB.Writer().Exec("UPDATE core_effects SET secret_ct = X'01' WHERE state = ?",
			string(core.EffectMade))
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		if n, err := res.RowsAffected(); err != nil || n != 2 {
			t.Errorf("seeded the secrets of %d made effects (%v), want 2", n, err)
		}
	}
	f.host.mu.Unlock()
	v := f.applyC(refCfxAdd, `{"name":"web"}`, core.ApplyOptions{})
	if done := f.await(v.ID, core.StateCompleted, core.StateReverted); done.State != core.StateCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("composite = %s (%+v), want completed", done.State, done.Error)
	}
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for n := secrets(); n != 0; n = secrets() {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("%d effects of the steps keep their secrets after the composite completed", n)
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// lossyChildren loses the answer of the loseAt-th Apply after deleting the
// child's private output, so the output is gone before it was sealed.
type lossyChildren struct {
	*inprocChildren
	db      *store.DB
	mu      sync.Mutex
	applies int
	loseAt  int
}

func (l *lossyChildren) Apply(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, hostID string, a core.ActionRef, planID string, opts core.ApplyOptions) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	v, err := l.inprocChildren.Apply(ctx, p, hostID, a, planID, opts)
	l.mu.Lock()
	l.applies++
	n := l.applies
	l.mu.Unlock()
	if err != nil || n != l.loseAt {
		return v, err
	}
	if _, err := l.db.Writer().ExecContext(ctx,
		"UPDATE core_changes SET private_output_ct = NULL, private_output_at = NULL WHERE id = ?", v.ID); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	return core.ChangeView{}, errLostAnswer
}

func TestCompositeOutputLostUnwinds(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCfxFixture(t)
	f.ctrl.SetChildren(&lossyChildren{inprocChildren: f.kids, db: f.agentDB, loseAt: 2})
	v := f.applyC(refCfxAdd, `{"name":"web"}`, core.ApplyOptions{})
	done := f.await(v.ID, core.StateReverted, core.StateCompleted, core.StateNeedsRepair, core.StateFailed)
	if done.State != core.StateReverted || done.Error == nil || done.Error.Code != string(errcode.ChildFailed) ||
		!strings.Contains(done.Error.Message, "step b ") || !strings.Contains(done.Error.Message, "lost") {
		t.Fatalf("composite = %s (%+v), want reverted with core.child_failed: step b's output lost", done.State, done.Error)
	}
	b := f.stepsOf(v.ID)["b"]
	if b.State != core.StepUndone || f.agentChange(b.ChildID).State != core.StateReverted {
		t.Errorf("step b = %s with child %s, want undone with its child reverted", b.State, f.agentChange(b.ChildID).State)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"web-a", "web-b"} {
		if _, ok := f.host.item(name); ok {
			t.Errorf("item %s is still there", name)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// stepDone makes step s final and moves the cursor past it. When the apply
// answer did not carry the child's output, it is taken from the lookup or,
// for an output type with secret fields, from the private output (1.3 Child
// results); a private output gone before it was sealed is output-lost, and
// the composite never continues with a redacted value. The private output is
// acknowledged once sealed. An error a lost apply answer left on the step is
// cleared.
func (e *Engine) stepDone(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, lk core.PlanLookup) error {
	sdef, ok := e.cfg.Registry.Action(s.Action)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: composite %s: step %s: action %s is not registered", c.ID, s.ID, s.Action)
	}
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	secret := compositeSecretType(sdef.OutputType)
	u := stepUpdate{State: core.StepApplied, Cursor: stepCursor(s.Ordinal + 1), ClearErr: true}
	if lk.State == core.StateConfirmed {
		u.State = core.StepConfirmed
	}
	if len(s.OutputCT) == 0 {
		raw := lk.Output
		if secret {
			priv, err := kids.Lookup(ctx, s.Host, s.PlanID, true)
			if err != nil {
				return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
			}
			if len(priv.Private) == 0 {
				return e.stepFailed(ctx, c, s, s.Ordinal,
					stepFailure(s, fmt.Sprintf("the output of child %s was lost before it was sealed", lk.ChangeID)))
			}
			raw = priv.Private
		}
		if len(raw) == 0 {
			raw = json.RawMessage("null")
		}
		sealed, err := e.cfg.Base.Sealer.Seal(stepOutputAD(c.ID, s.ID), raw)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: seal the output of step %s of %s: %w", s.ID, c.ID, err)
		}
		u.OutputCT = sealed
	}
	if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepApplying, core.StepConfirming, core.StepApplied}, u); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if secret {
		// An unacknowledged private output is cleared after PrivateOutputTTL
		// anyway, so a failed acknowledgement is only logged.
		if err := kids.AckPrivate(ctx, s.Host, s.ChildID, false); err != nil {
			e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: acknowledge a child's private output",
				"change", c.ID, "step", s.ID, "child", s.ChildID, "error", err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
// stepAwaiting is the revertible last step's child pending: the step is
// applied and the composite awaits confirmation (1.3 Confirmation), while
// the runner keeps looking the child up. A step confirming had its confirm
// sent, and the answer was lost or the confirm never arrived: it is sent
// again.
func (e *Engine) stepAwaiting(ctx context.Context, c compositeRow, s stepRow, lk core.PlanLookup) error {
	if s.State == core.StepConfirming {
		kids, err := e.kids()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = kids.Confirm(ctx, recoveryPrincipal, s.ChildID)
		switch {
		case err == nil:
			return nil
		case errcode.From(err).Code == errcode.HostOffline:
			return e.childUnreachable(ctx, c, s, err)
		}
		return waitChild(ChildPoll)
	}
	if s.State == core.StepApplying {
		if err := e.setStep(ctx, c.ID, s.ID, []string{core.StepApplying},
			stepUpdate{State: core.StepApplied, ChildDeadline: lk.Deadline}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if c.State != core.StateAwaitingConfirmation {
		if _, err := e.transition(ctx, c.ID, transition{from: c.State, to: core.StateAwaitingConfirmation}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return waitChild(ChildPoll)
}
```

```go
// isComposite reports whether changeID is a composite of this engine; an
// unknown change is not, and its own path answers change.not_found.
func (e *Engine) isComposite(ctx context.Context, changeID string) (bool, error) {
	var class string
	err := e.cfg.Base.DB.Read().QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT class FROM core_changes WHERE id = ?", changeID).Scan(&class)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
		return false, nil
	case err != nil:
		return false, fmt.Errorf("lifecycle: read change %s: %w", changeID, err)
	}
	return core.Class(class) == core.ClassComposite, nil
}

// compositeSecretType reports whether values of t carry a field tagged
// secret:"true" at any depth.
func compositeSecretType(t reflect.Type) bool {
	return compositeSecretIn(t, map[reflect.Type]bool{})
}

func compositeSecretIn(t reflect.Type, seen map[reflect.Type]bool) bool {
	for t != nil && (t.Kind() == reflect.Pointer || t.Kind() == reflect.Slice || t.Kind() == reflect.Array || t.Kind() == reflect.Map) {
		t = t.Elem()
	}
	if t == nil || t.Kind() != reflect.Struct || seen[t] {
		return false
	}
	seen[t] = true
	for i := range t.NumField() {
		f := t.Field(i)
		if f.Tag.Get("secret") == "true" || compositeSecretIn(f.Type, seen) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// confirmComposite confirms a composite awaiting confirmation through its
// revertible child (1.3 Confirmation): the step is confirming, committed,
// before the confirm is sent, and the lookup, never a deadline, settles an
// answer that was lost.
func (e *Engine) confirmComposite(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, id string) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	ctx = context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
	unlock := e.compositeLock(id)
	defer unlock()
	c, steps, err := loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	if c.State != core.StateAwaitingConfirmation || c.Cursor < 0 || c.Cursor >= len(steps) {
		return core.ChangeView{}, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf("change %s is %s", id, c.State))
	}
	s := steps[c.Cursor]
	if s.State == core.StepApplied {
		if err := e.setStep(ctx, id, s.ID, []string{core.StepApplied}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepConfirming}); err != nil {
			return core.ChangeView{}, err
		}
	}
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	if _, err := kids.Confirm(ctx, p, s.ChildID); err != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: confirm a composite's child", "change", id, "child", s.ChildID, "error", err)
	}
	if err := e.settleComposite(ctx, id, &compositeRun{P: p}); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	e.wakeComposite(id)
	return e.Change(ctx, id)
}

// settleComposite looks the cursor step's child up and applies the tables
// once, completing the composite when its last step became final. A child
// that cannot be looked up now is left to the runner.
func (e *Engine) settleComposite(ctx context.Context, id string, run *compositeRun) error {
	c, steps, err := loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	lk, err := lookupChild(ctx, kids, steps[c.Cursor])
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	err = e.observeChild(ctx, id, lk)
	var wait *compositeWait
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &wait), errors.Is(err, errCompositeDone):
		return nil
	case err != nil:
		return err
	}
	if c, steps, err = loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if c.Owner == core.OwnerComposite && c.Direction == dirForward && c.Cursor >= len(steps) {
		if err := e.completeComposite(ctx, c, steps, run); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errCompositeDone) {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// revertComposite reverts a composite awaiting confirmation (1.3 States):
// its unwind starts at the revertible step, whose child p reverts now; the
// runner undoes the steps before it.
func (e *Engine) revertComposite(ctx context.Context, p core.Principal, id string) (core.ChangeView, error) {
	ctx = context.WithoutCancel(ctx)
	unlock := e.compositeLock(id)
	defer unlock()
	c, steps, err := loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id)
	if err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	if c.State != core.StateAwaitingConfirmation || c.Cursor < 0 || c.Cursor >= len(steps) {
		return core.ChangeView{}, errcode.New(errcode.ChangeNotPending, fmt.Sprintf("change %s is %s", id, c.State))
	}
	s := steps[c.Cursor]
	if err := e.compositeCause(ctx, id, stepFailure(s, "reverted by "+p.Actor)); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	var wait *compositeWait
	if err := e.unwindFrom(ctx, id, s.Ordinal); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errCompositeDone) && !errors.As(err, &wait) {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	if c, steps, err = loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id); err != nil {
		return core.ChangeView{}, err
	}
	if c.State == core.StateUndoing && c.Cursor == s.Ordinal {
		s = steps[c.Cursor]
		if err := e.setStep(ctx, id, s.ID, []string{s.State}, stepUpdate{State: core.StepUndoing}); err != nil {
			return core.ChangeView{}, err
		}
		if err := e.sendRevert(ctx, c, s, p); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errCompositeDone) && !errors.As(err, &wait) {
			return core.ChangeView{}, err
		}
	}
	e.wakeComposite(id)
	return e.Change(ctx, id)
}
```

Append to `internal/core/lifecycle/composite_run.go`:

```go
// compositeFinal tells the executing side of every child of composite id,
// now terminal, that its composite is terminal: a final AckPrivate, after
// which the child's made effects drop their sealed secrets (spec 1.2). A
// child that cannot be told keeps its secrets until its undo window closes
// and Purge clears them, so a failure is only logged.
func (e *Engine) compositeFinal(id string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(e.runCtx, CleanupTxTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	kids, err := e.kids()
	if err != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: tell a terminal composite's children", "change", id, "error", err)
		return
	}
	_, steps, err := loadComposite(ctx, e.cfg.Base.DB.Read(), id)
	if err != nil {
		e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: tell a terminal composite's children", "change", id, "error", err)
		return
	}
	for _, s := range steps {
		for _, child := range append([]string{s.ChildID}, s.Earlier...) {
			if child == "" {
				continue
			}
			if err := kids.AckPrivate(ctx, s.Host, child, true); err != nil {
				e.cfg.Base.Log.Warn("lifecycle: tell a child its composite is terminal",
					"change", id, "step", s.ID, "child", child, "error", err)
			}
		}
	}
}
```

- Produces: L1 `Engine.RecoverComposites`, `Engine.Wake`, `Engine.CompositesRecovered`, `UnreachableGrace`, `UnreachablePoll` (`ChildPoll` is Task 35's).

**Items:** 45

**Depends on:** Task 36

**Implementer:** dr-superpowers:impl-opus-high
**Evaluation:** files 1 - spec 0 - coupling 2 - risk 3 = 6

`ChildPoll` is already declared by Task 35. The watcher is the runner of Task 35: it keeps running while a composite is `applying`, `undoing`, `awaiting_confirmation`, `recovering` or `releasing` and polls the cursor step's child every `ChildPoll`, so this task adds what it lacks: `Wake`, the unreachable-agent rule, recovery at start (which starts the runner with a nil `*compositeRun`, so Task 35's recovery column and "Between steps" rules apply) and admission. A composite in `needs_repair` is unowned and has no runner; nothing about it changes until an operator acts, so the watcher does not poll its children.

`RecoverComposites` returns once its claims are committed and the runners are started on `goRun` (which `Close` waits for). The controller can therefore call it in line after the agent listener opens (Task 40), and `CompositesRecovered` turns true as the runners settle. The admission gate applies only to an engine with children (`SetChildren` called), so test engines and the agent engine are never gated.

```go
func (c *inprocChildren) setUnreachable(v bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.unreachable = v
}

// reopenCtrl closes the controller engine and opens a new one over the same
// database, as a controller restart does; RecoverComposites is the caller's.
func (f *cfxFixture) reopenCtrl() {
	f.t.Helper()
	f.ctrl.Close()
	f.openCtrl()
}

// cutAt stops the runner right after it commits step stepID in state (with
// a child recorded when withChild), as if the controller died there. The
// returned channel is closed once the runner is gone.
func cutAt(f *cfxFixture, stepID, state string, withChild bool) <-chan struct{} {
	cut := make(chan struct{})
	var once sync.Once
	f.events.setOnEvent(func(ev StepEvent) {
		if ev.StepID != stepID || ev.State != state || (ev.ChildChangeID != "") != withChild {
			return
		}
		fired := false
		once.Do(func() {
			fired = true
			close(cut)
		})
		if fired {
			runtime.Goexit()
		}
	})
	return cut
}

// restartAfter waits for cut, restarts the controller and runs composite
// recovery.
func restartAfter(t *testing.T, f *cfxFixture, cut <-chan struct{}) {
	t.Helper()
	select {
	case <-cut:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("the runner never reached the cut-off point")
	}
	f.events.setOnEvent(nil)
	f.reopenCtrl()
	if err := f.ctrl.RecoverComposites(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestCompositeRecoveryAfterACutOff(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name       string
		ref        core.ActionRef
		failItem   string // an item whose apply fails, so the composite unwinds
		step       string
		state      string
		withChild  bool
		want       string
		undone     []string
		retiredB   bool // step b's plan is retired, never applied
	}{
		{"before b's plan request", refCfxAdd, "", "b", core.StepPlanning, false, core.StateReverted, []string{"a"}, false},
		{"after b's plan answered", refCfxAdd, "", "b", core.StepPlanned, false, core.StateReverted, []string{"a"}, true},
		{"before b's apply request", refCfxAdd, "", "b", core.StepApplying, false, core.StateReverted, []string{"a"}, true},
		{"after b's apply answered", refCfxAdd, "", "b", core.StepApplying, true, core.StateReverted, []string{"a", "b"}, false},
		{"while undoing b", refCfxAdd, "web-c", "b", core.StepUndoing, true, core.StateReverted, []string{"a", "b"}, false},
		{"forward, before y's plan request", refCfxRemove, "", "y", core.StepPlanning, false, core.StateNeedsRepair, nil, false},
		{"forward, after y's apply answered", refCfxRemove, "", "y", core.StepApplying, true, core.StateCompleted, nil, false},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newCfxFixture(t)
			if c.ref == refCfxRemove {
				f.host.setItem("web-a", "1")
				f.host.setItem("web-b", "2")
			}
			if c.failItem != "" {
				f.host.failNext(c.failItem, 1)
			}
			cut := cutAt(f, c.step, c.state, c.withChild)
			v := f.applyC(c.ref, `{"name":"web"}`, core.ApplyOptions{})
			restartAfter(t, f, cut)
			plans := f.agentPlans()
			done := f.await(v.ID, core.StateReverted, core.StateFailed, core.StateNeedsRepair, core.StateCompleted)
			if done.State != c.want {
				t.Fatalf("composite = %s (%+v), want %s", done.State, done.Error, c.want)
			}
			if n := f.agentPlans(); n != plans {
				t.Errorf("recovery made %d plans; it never plans a step", n-plans)
			}
			steps := f.stepsOf(v.ID)
			for _, id := range c.undone {
				if steps[id].State != core.StepUndone {
					t.Errorf("step %s = %s, want undone", id, steps[id].State)
				}
			}
			if c.retiredB {
				lk, err := f.agent.Lookup(context.Background(), steps["b"].PlanID, false)
				if err != nil || lk.Status != core.LookupRetired {
					t.Errorf("b's plan lookup = %+v, %v; want retired", lk, err)
				}

					if _, ok := f.host.item(name); ok {
						t.Errorf("item %s is still there", name)
					}
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
```
